CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER MRP_ATTACH_MOVES_I_CODE_UNT
BEFORE INSERT
ON MRP_ITEM_ATTACH_MOVES
REFERENCING NEW AS NEW OLD AS OLD
FOR EACH ROW
DECLARE
V_I_CODE VARCHAR2(30);
V_ITM_UNT VARCHAR2(10);
BEGIN
GNR_PKG.PRC_GET_ITEM_INV_DATA (P_ITM_CODE => :NEW.ITEM_CODE,
P_INV_I_CODE=> V_I_CODE ,
P_UNIT_CODE => V_ITM_UNT);
:NEW.I_CODE:=V_I_CODE;
END;

before insert on MRP_CRP_BD_RCRD
for each row
begin
:new.BD_REC_SER:= get_new_seq ('MRP_CRP_BD_RCRD','BD_REC_SER'
,'6',:new.CMP_NO,:new.BRN_NO,:new.BD_TRX_NO,:new.SHF_CODE,:new.REC_SER,:new.RCE_SER,0,1,0,NULL ,:New.Brn_No,NULL,NULL) ;
ysec_pack.set_ser(:new.BD_REC_SER); --ysec_pack.set_ser(ltrim(:new.BD_REC_SER,0 ),0);
end;
CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER MRP_CRP_RES_LOC_SET_SEQ_BI_TRG
before insert on MRP_CRP_RESOURCES_LOC
declare
V_SEQ NUMBER;
SELECT MAX(NVL(SEQ,0)) INTO V_SEQ
FROM MRP_CRP_RESOURCES_LOC
WHERE CMP_NO = :NEW.CMP_NO AND BRN_NO = :NEW.BRN_NO ;
IF V_SEQ IS NULL THEN
:NEW.SEQ := 1;
ELSE
:NEW.SEQ := V_SEQ +1;
END IF;

CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER MRP_ITEM_ATTACH_MOV_AD_TRG /* LAST UPDATE 21-2-2011*/
FTER DELETE
ON MRP_ITEM_ATTACH_MOVES REFERENCING NEW AS NEW OLD AS OLD
GenParaMRP_SFC_PROD_CONS MRP_SGS_GENERAL_PARAMETARS.MRP_SFC_PROD_CONS%TYPE :=GNR_PKG.FNC_GET_PRMTR_VAL( :OLD.CMP_NO,:OLD.BRN_NO ,'MRP_SFC_PROD_CONS');
GenParaMRP_SFC_USE_ITEM_PART MRP_SGS_GENERAL_PARAMETARS.MRP_SFC_USE_ITEM_PART%TYPE:=GNR_PKG.FNC_GET_PRMTR_VAL( :OLD.CMP_NO,:OLD.BRN_NO ,'MRP_SFC_USE_ITEM_PART');
Begin
IF GenParaMRP_SFC_PROD_CONS =1 and GenParaMRP_SFC_USE_ITEM_PART =1 AND :OLD.TRANS_TYPE=6
THEN
DELETE MRP_SFC_WIP_MAT_CONSUMP
WHERE
CMP_NO = :OLD.CMP_NO AND
BRN_NO = :OLD.BRN_NO AND
WORK_ORDER = :OLD.WORK_ORDER AND
YIELD_SEQ = :OLD.TRANSD_NO AND
SF_SEQ = :OLD.TRANSM_NO AND
ATT_SEQ = :OLD.ATTACH_SEQ;
IF GenParaMRP_SFC_PROD_CONS =1 and GenParaMRP_SFC_USE_ITEM_PART =1 AND :OLD.TRANS_TYPE=5
SCAP_SEQ = :OLD.TRANSD_NO AND
EXCEPTION
WHEN OTHERS THEN
NULL;-- Raise_application_error(-20021,SQLERRM);
END ;

BEFORE UPDATE OF APP_USR
VOLDCST NUMBER;
--GenParaMRP_SFC_PR_INCCST_TYPE VARCHAR2(100) :=GNR_PKG.FNC_GET_PRMTR_VAL(:OLD.CMP_NO ,:OLD.BRN_NO,'MRP_SFC_PR_INCCST_TYPE');

G_CODE,JOB_CODE,ITEM_MAIN, CUST_ID, CUST_ORDER, ORDER_SER

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
CURSOR CONSCR(seq number) IS
SELECT CMP_NO,BRN_NO, AVG_COST,ITEM_CODE,TOT_QTY ,WH_CODE,CON_SEQ,WORK_ORDER,SHF_CODE,LN_CODE,STG_CODE,JOB_CODE,RCE_SER

:OLD.YER_CODE, :OLD.PERIOD_CODE, NULL, NULL, IY.BOM_CODE, IY.PRD_TYPE, IY.ITEM_MAIN ,VMSG_NO ) <>1 THEN
---NOt realte FIFO
IY.ITEM_CODE,
IY.YIELD_SEQ ,
IY.WH_CODE ,
IY.QTY,
IY.CST,
-- IF GenParaMRP_SFC_PR_INCCST_TYPE = 6 OR GenParaMRP_SFC_PR_INCCST_TYPE =10 THEN
SELECT NVL(CST_LAST_PROD,0)
INTO VOLDCST
FROM MRP_CRP_ITEMS_DETAILS
AND ITEM_CODE=IY.ITEM_CODE ;

SET LSTPRDCST_BFR = VOLDCST ,

ORDER_SER = IY.ORDER_SER

AND ATTCH_DESC_NO =TO_NUMBER(DECODE(I,1,SUBSTR(ATT,2,3) ,2,SUBSTR(ATT,6,3),3,SUBSTR(ATT,10,3) ,4,SUBSTR(ATT,13,3),5,SUBSTR(ATT,16,3)));
RETURN SQLERRM;
ALLATTDESCALL :=ALLATTDESCALL||'-'||ALLATTDESC;
RETURN SUBSTR(ALLATTDESCALL,2,LENGTH(ALLATTDESCALL));

-- To insert all final Products with its requirement quantity
TYPE FINAL_PRODUCT_REC IS RECORD
F_ASS VARCHAR2(200),
F_BOM VARCHAR2(200),
R_QTY NUMBER,
F_PLN NUMBER,
CMP NUMBER,
BRN NUMBER,

YSATT_SQ NUMBER
TYPE FINAL_PRODUCT IS TABLE OF FINAL_PRODUCT_REC;
PROCEDURE INSERT_FINAL_PRODUCT( FP IN OUT FINAL_PRODUCT,FPR IN OUT FINAL_PRODUCT_REC,

---- Some procedure to rollup the requirement analysis
PROCEDURE LISTING_ITEM_ROW_FROM_MAIN_BOM(FP IN OUT FINAL_PRODUCT,TYP NUMBER,USR VARCHAR2
,P_LANG NUMBER,W_ORD VARCHAR2) IS
NUM NUMBER:= 1;

DELETE FROM MRP_MRP_BOM_ROW_TEMP
WHERE USR_NAME = USR
AND CMP_NO = FP(1).CMP
AND BRN_NO = FP(1).BRN; --To delete all the Resul
t about old Final Products for this user
COMMIT; --
--13-01-2008 /*
DELETE FROM MRP_MRP_SEIZED_MATERIALS --
AND BRN_NO = FP(1).BRN; -- Delete all calculation for this user
--13-01-2008 */
OP := OPRTON(); --//
--// To inilial opreation array
FOR N IN 1..FP.COUNT LOOP --//
--// To Loop for all final products
IF FP(N).F_PLN IS NULL THEN --
-- To specifythe analysis by period or no
V_PLN := 0; --//
--// This mean general analysis
V_PLN := FP(N).F_PLN; --//
--// This mean analysis by period
G_CMP := FP(N).CMP;
G_BRN := FP(N).BRN;
G_SEQ := FP(N).SEQ;
G_WRK := FP(N).WRKD;
G_ASS := FP(N).F_ASS;
G_FASS := FP(N).FIN_ASS;
G_YLD := FP(N).YLD_SQ;
G_SRP := FP(N).SRP_SQ;
G_FDAT := FP(N).F_DAT;
G_TDAT := FP(N).T_DAT;
C_ATT := FP(N).ATT;
-- Loop for all final products to store their job in opreation array
FOR J IN ( SELECT DISTINCT BOM_CODE,ITEM_CODE,JOB_CODE
FROM MRP_BOM_BOM_ROW
WHERE ITEM_CODE = FP(N).F_ASS
AND BOM_CODE = FP(N).F_BOM
AND CMP_NO = FP(N).CMP
AND BRN_NO = FP(N).BRN ) LOOP
INSRT_OPERATION( OP,OPR,J.BOM_CODE,J.ITEM_CODE,J.JOB_CODE,V_PLN,OP.COUNT+1);
--NUM := NUM + 1;
-- Listing all Row of the main BOM
FOR I IN ( SELECT R.CMP_NO,R.BRN_NO,R.BOM_CODE,R.ITEM_CODE,
R.SHF_CODE,R.LN_CODE,R.STG_CODE,
R.JOB_CODE ,R.ITEM_ROW,R.BOM_ROW,
DECODE(TYP,0,SUM(R.QTY),(SUM(R.QTY)/M.BOM_QTY)* R.QTY_F * FP(N).R_QTY)QTY,
R.SCRAP_PER,R.OPTIONAL,R.MUT_EXC
FROM MRP_BOM_BOM_ROW R,
MRP_BOM_BOM_MSTR M,
S_CMPNY C,S_BRN B
WHERE M.ITEM_CODE = R.ITEM_CODE AND
M.BOM_CODE = R.BOM_CODE AND
M.CMP_NO = C.CMP_NO AND
R.CMP_NO = C.CMP_NO AND
M.BRN_NO = B.BRN_NO AND
R.BRN_NO = B.BRN_NO AND
R.ITEM_CODE = FP(N).F_ASS AND
M.BOM_CODE = FP(N).F_BOM AND
M.CMP_NO = FP(N).CMP AND
M.BRN_NO = FP(N).BRN AND
R.ATP = 0
GROUP BY R.CMP_NO,R.BRN_NO,R.BOM_CODE,R.ITEM_CODE,
R.JOB_CODE ,R.ITEM_ROW,R.BOM_ROW,M.BOM_QTY,R.QTY_F,R.SCRAP_PER,R.OPTIONAL,R.MUT_EXC )LOOP
R_DSC := GIVE_ITEM_DESCRIPTION(I.ITEM_ROW,P_LANG,G_CMP,G_BRN);
INSERT INTO MRP_MRP_BOM_ROW_TEMP
( CMP_NO,BRN_NO,BOM_CODE,ITEM_CODE,SHF_CODE,LN_CODE,STG_CODE,
JOB_CODE ,ITEM_ROW,QTY_R,QTY_S,QTY_N,QTY_V,QTY_D,
QTY_A,QTY_F,QTY_W,OPTIONAL,ATP,BOM_ROW,ME,FLAGE,
FINAL_ITEM,FINAL_BOM,LVL,ROW_TYP,USR_NAME,ROW_DESC,PLN,ATTACH )
VALUES ( I.CMP_NO,I.BRN_NO,I.BOM_CODE,I.ITEM_CODE,I.SHF_CODE,I.LN_CODE,
I.STG_CODE,I.JOB_CODE,I.ITEM_ROW,I.QTY,I.SCRAP_PER,0,0,0,0,0,0,
I.OPTIONAL,0,I.BOM_ROW,I.MUT_EXC,0,
FP(N).F_ASS,FP(N).F_BOM,1,0,USR,R_DSC,V_PLN,C_ATT );
-- COMMIT;
BRN := I.BRN_NO;
RTRN := LISTING_ITEM_ROW_FROM_SUB_BOM(TYP,USR,P_LANG,W_ORD); -- To list the Row of Sub BOM
CHK_ATT := GNR_PKG.FNC_GET_PRMTR_VAL(G_CMP,G_BRN,'MRP_SFC_USE_ITEM_PART');
IF CHK_ATT = 1 THEN
ATTACHMENET (USR);

RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20001,'There is error in package');

AND FINAL_ITEM= FIC

ELSIF TYP = 9 THEN
-- 14-01-2008 */

SELECT NVL(SUM(QTY),0)
INTO WIP
WHERE ITEM_CODE = IROW

IF WIP < 0 THEN
WIP := 0;
END IF;-- ADD 12/4/2010
-- Calcu the reserve from the material

-- subtract the WIP onhand - the reserved

INV_SEL := GNR_PKG.GET_ITM_QTY (P_ITM_CODE =>IROW); --
INVTRY := INVTRY + INV_SEL;
INVTRY := INVTRY;
-- Calcu the material reserved
AND MRS_TYPE = 1;
INVTRY := INVTRY - RES_QTY;

--STD := F_QTY + (F_SCR/100
); --//OLD

IF ADDTON < 0 THEN--
STD := STD + 1;
ADDTON := 1 - ADDTON;
ADDTON := 0;
-- Insert the
final Qty reqirement, and final Scrape Qty reqirement for the Row
INVTRY:= 0;

END ; --04-10-2011

INTO SQTY

((SUM(R.QTY)/M.BOM_QTY)*R.QTY_F*RSLT)QTY,
R.BOM_ROW, R.SCRAP_PER SCR,
R.OPTIONAL,R.MUT_EXC
WHERE M.CMP_NO = C.CMP_NO AND
M.ITEM_CODE = IC AND
M.BOM_CODE = BR AND
R.ITEM_CODE = IC AND
R.BOM_CODE = BR AND
M.CMP_NO = G_CMP AND
M.BRN_NO = G_BRN AND
R.JOB_CODE ,R.ITEM_ROW,M.BOM_QTY,R.QTY_F,R.BOM_ROW, R.SCRAP_PER,R.OPTIONAL,R.MUT_EXC ) LOOP
IF RTYP = 2 THEN
RT := 2;
RT := 0;
R_DSC := GIVE_ITEM_DESCRIPTION(J.ITEM_ROW,P_LANG,G_CMP,G_BRN);
QTY_A,QTY_F,QTY_W,OPTIONAL,ATP,BOM_ROW, ME,FLAGE,
VALUES ( J.CMP_NO,J.BRN_NO,J.BOM_CODE,J.ITEM_CODE,J.SHF_CODE,J.LN_CODE,
J.STG_CODE,J.JOB_CODE,J.ITEM_ROW,J.QTY,
J.SCR,0,0,0,0,0,0,J.OPTIONAL,0,DECODE(J.BOM_ROW,NULL,NULL,J.BOM_ROW),
J.MUT_EXC,0,F_ITM,F_BOM,LV,RT,USR,R_DSC,V_PLN,ATT);
N := OP.COUNT +1;
FOR K IN ( SELECT DISTINCT BOM_CODE,ITEM_CODE,JOB_CODE
WHERE ITEM_CODE = J.ITEM_CODE
AND BOM_CODE = J.BOM_CODE
AND BRN_NO = G_BRN ) LOOP
INSRT_OPERATION(OP,OPR,K.BOM_CODE,K.ITEM_CODE,K.JOB_CODE,V_PLN,OP.COUNT+1);
--N := N + 1;
UPDT_DLT_IR_BOM(IC ,SQTY ,NET ,IR,BR,F_ITM,F_BOM,V_PLN,USR,ATT);
-- If we have enough Qty in Inventory
USR VARCHAR2,P_LANG NUMBER,W_ORD VARCHAR2,V_PLN NUMBER, ATT VARCHAR2) IS
-- To list the Row of sub BOM If there isn't overplus Qty in any storage
((SUM(R.QTY)/M.BOM_QTY)*R.QTY_F*RQTY)QTY,
R.BOM_ROW, (R.SCRAP_PER*DECODE(SCRAP,0,1,SCRAP)) SCR, -- UPDATE BY ABDULLAH OMAR IN 22/10/2007
FINAL_ITEM,FINAL_BOM,LVL,ROW_TYP,USR_NAME,ROW_DESC,PLN,ATTACH)
-- Adding the operations of sub BOM to the view
INSRT_OPERATION( OP,OPR,K.BOM_CODE,K.ITEM_CODE,K.JOB_CODE,V_PLN,OP.COUNT+1);
-- After Listing the Row
of sub BOM.System will update the maim Row that it has BOM
SET FLAGE = 1
WHERE ITEM_ROW = IR
AND BOM_ROW = BR
AND FINAL_ITEM = F_ITM
AND FINAL_BOM = F_BOM
F_ITM VARCHAR2,F_BOM VARCHAR2,V_PLN NUMBER,USR VARCHAR2,ATT VARCHAR2) IS
-- Update overplus Qty, after taking the Net --
UPDATE MRP_MRP_SEIZED_MATERIALS
SET QTY = (SQTY - NET)
-- Delete the main Row which it has BOM, after listing it Row
UPDATE MRP_MRP_BOM_ROW_TEMP --

PROCEDURE CHECK_WIP_INV(ITM_OPTN VARCHAR2,V_QTY NUMBER,SRG NUMBER,USR VARCHAR2) IS
SELECT COUNT(ITM_OPTN) -- Check If Row Qty used by anther BOM
AND SM_TYPE = SRG
-- If it is true will store in onhand
IF CHK = 0 THEN --
FROM MRP_MRP_SEIZED_MATERIALS;
VALUES (G_CMP,G_BRN,SQE,ITM_OPTN,V_QTY,ITM_OPTN,SRG,USR);
-- If it is false will update the onhand
ELSE --
SET QTY = V_QTY
FUNCTION CALC_FORCAST(IROW VARCHAR2,V_PLN NUMBER,SNDR NUMBER)RETURN NUMBER IS
-- SNDR for differentiate between
-- production plan
-- and
FLG NUMBER; -- sales plan /* It will be usage later*/
SEL VARCHAR2(4000);
FD VARCHAR2(12);
TD VARCHAR2(12);
FRCST NUMBER := 0;
--// This condition will be true if analysis by period
IF V_PLN IS NOT NULL THEN --
SELECT TO_CHAR(P.DATE_F,'DD-MM-YYYY'),TO_CHAR(P.DATE_T,'DD/MM/YYYY')
INTO FD,TD
FROM MRP_SGS_PERIOD_COSTONG P,MRP_YEAR Y
WHERE P.PERIOD_CODE = V_PLN
AND P.YER_CODE = Y.YER_CODE
AND Y.P_CLS = 0;
SELECT TO_CHAR(P.DATE_T,'DD/MM/YYYY')
INTO TD
WHERE P.PERIOD_CODE IN( SELECT MAX(PERIOD_CODE)
FROM MRP_SGS_PERIOD_COSTONG P ,MRP_YEAR Y
WHERE P.YER_CODE = Y.YER_CODE
AND Y.P_CLS = 0 )
SELECT TO_CHAR(P.DATE_F,'DD-MM-YYYY')
INTO FD
WHERE P.PERIOD_CODE IN
(SELECT MIN(PERIOD_CODE)
FLG := GNR_PKG.FNC_GET_PRMTR_VAL(G_CMP,G_BRN,'MRP_ONX_VERSION');
-- calculate the onhand from item in forecast storage
IF FLG = 0 THEN
SEL := 'SELECT SUM(P_ORDER_DETAIL.I_QTY)-SUM(GRN_DETAIL.I_QTY)R_QTY
FROM GRN_DETAIL,P_ORDER,
P_ORDER_DETAIL
WHERE P_ORDER.PO_NO=P_ORDER_DETAIL.PO_NO
AND GRN_DETAIL.PO_NO=P_ORDER.PO_NO
AND NVL(P_ORDER.PO_CLOSED,0)=0
AND P_ORDER_DETAIL.I_CODE=GRN_DETAIL.I_CODE
AND P_ORDER_DETAIL.I_CODE='''||IROW||
''' AND P_ORDER.PO_DATE BETWEEN '''||FD||''' AND '''||TD||'''';
ELSIF FLG = 1 THEN
SEL := 'SELECT SUM(D.I_QTY)
FROM IAS_PI_BILL_MST M,
IAS_PI_BILL_DTL D
WHERE M.PUR_TYPE = D.PUR_TYPE AND
M.BILL_DOC_TYPE = D.BILL_DOC_TYPE AND
M.BILL_NO = D.BILL_NO AND
M.BILL_SER = D.BILL_SER AND
M.BILL_GOOD_REC = 0 AND
D.I_CODE ='''||IROW||'''';
FRCST := FRCST + RUN_SELECT( SEL ); -- This fuction run the select statement where its come as string
FRCST := FRCST;
RETURN(FRCST);
PROCEDURE CALC_SFC_REQ (FP IN OUT FINAL_PRODUCT,TYP NUMBER,USR VARCHAR2,W_ORD VARCHAR2)IS
REQ NUMBER;
FRM_ACTUAL := 1; --
-- This for take the onhand quantity in Onyx
LISTING_ITEM_ROW_FROM_MAIN_BOM(FP,TYP,USR,1,W_ORD);
CALCULATE_ROW_STANDARD_QTY(TYP,USR,1,W_ORD);
IF TYP = 1 THEN -- From WIP and Onyx --
FOR V IN ( SELECT CMP_NO, BRN_NO, BOM_CODE, ITEM_CODE,
WHERE USR_NAME = USR AND ROW_TYP <> 1
AND CMP_NO = G_CMP AND BRN_NO = G_BRN ) LOOP
REQ := ( V.QTY_W + V.QTY_V ) - V.QTY_N;
IF REQ < 0 AND REQ <> V.QTY_N AND V.BOM_ROW IS NOT NULL THEN
REQ := V.QTY_V;
REQ := V.QTY_N - V.QTY_W;
IF REQ <= 0 THEN
REQ := 0;
UDAT_QTY_D(REQ ,V.CMP_NO,V.BRN_NO,V.BOM_CODE,V.ITEM_CODE,V.SHF_CODE,
V.LN_CODE,V.STG_CODE,V.JOB_CODE,V.ITEM_ROW,
V.ROW_TYP,V.USR_NAME,V.FINAL_ITEM,V.FINAL_BOM,V.HEAD,V.ATTACH);
-------------------------------------------------------
ELSIF TYP = 8 THEN -- From WIP only --
----------------------------------------------------
ELSIF TYP = 2 THEN -- From Onyx only --
REQ := V.QTY_V - V.QTY_N;
REQ := V.QTY_N;
UDAT_QTY_D(REQ,V.CMP_NO,V.BRN_NO,V.BOM_CODE,V.ITEM_CODE,V.SHF_CODE,
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
ELSIF (TYP = 4 OR TYP = 6 )THEN -- To calculate the Requirement Qty for shop floor card from WIP
REQ := V.QTY_N - V.QTY_W ;
IF REQ < 0 THEN
ELSIF ( TYP = 5) THEN -- To calculate the Requirement Qty for
-- Consumption and Standard subtract from WIP
OPTIONAL, ATP, BOM_ROW,ME, FLAGE, FINAL_ITEM, FINAL_BOM,
IF REQ < 0 AND REQ <> V.QTY_N AND V.BOM_ROW IS NOT NULL THEN*/
REQ := V.QTY_N;/*
REQ := V.QTY_W;
ELSIF TYP = 9 THEN -- 3/5/2010
-- This operation will calculte the qty that receive to WIP for each product. After that the qty will use to calculte the direct cost
FUNCTION RUN_SELECT( SEL IN VARCHAR2 ) RETURN NUMBER IS
RES NUMBER;
EXECUTE IMMEDIATE SEL
INTO RES ;
IF RES IS NULL THEN
RETURN(RES);
FUNCTION GIVE_UOM (IRW VARCHAR2,P_LANG NUMBER,CMP NUMBER,BRN NUMBER) RETURN VARCHAR IS
R_DESC VARCHAR2(200);
SELECT D.UNIT_CODE
INTO R_DESC
FROM MRP_CRP_ITEMS_DETAILS D
AND CMP_NO = CMP
AND BRN_NO = BRN;
RETURN(R_DESC);
FUNCTION GIVE_BOM_DESCRIPTION (BOM VARCHAR2,P_LANG NUMBER,CMP NUMBER,BRN NUMBER) RETURN VARCHAR IS
SELECT DECODE(P_LANG,1,BOM_NAME_A,BOM_NAME_F)
FUNCTION GIVE_ITEM_DESCRIPTION (IRW VARCHAR2,P_LANG NUMBER, CMP NUMBER,BRN NUMBER) RETURN VARCHAR IS
SELECT DECODE(P_LANG,1,ITEM_NAME_A,ITEM_NAME_F)
FUNCTION CHK_MTRL_BOM(WR_ODR VARCHAR2,IRW VARCHAR2,USR VARCHAR2,CMP NUMBER,BRN NUMBER) RETURN BOOLEAN IS
V_NDX NUMBER := 1;
FP := FINAL_PRODUCT();
--// List all product that related to work order
FOR I IN ( SELECT ITEM_CODE,BOM_CODE FROM MRP_MPS_WORK_ORDR_DTLS --
WHERE WORK_ORDER = WR_ODR
AND BRN_NO = BRN
AND BOM_CODE IS NOT NULL
AND ITEM_MAIN = ITEM_CODE )LOOP
FP(V_NDX).F_ASS := I.ITEM_CODE;
FP(V_NDX).F_BOM := I.BOM_CODE;
FP(V_NDX).R_QTY := 1;
FP(V_NDX).CMP := CMP;
FP(V_NDX).BRN := BRN;
V_NDX := V_NDX + 1;
LISTING_ITEM_ROW_FROM_MAIN_BOM(FP,3,USR,1,NULL);
CALCULATE_ROW_STANDARD_QTY(3,USR,1,NULL);
-- check the item if it is in analysis data,it will return yes else return false

FUNCTION CONSUMPTION_WIP( IC VARCHAR2 ) RETURN NUMBER IS
RSLT NUMBER := 0;
-- Calculate the quantity by consumption in WIP onhand storage
SELECT
( SELECT SUM(QTY)*-1
WHERE TRANS_TYPE IN (51,7)
AND TRANS_DATE BETWEEN G_FDAT AND G_TDAT
and ITEM_CODE NOT IN (SELECT ITEM_CODE
WHERE PRD_TYPE = 0
AND BRN_NO = G_BRN))
( SELECT SUM(M.QTY)*-1
FROM MRP_SFC_WHM_ITEMS_MOVE M, MRP_CRP_ITEMS_CATEGORY G
WHERE M.TRANS_TYPE = 2
AND M.ITEM_CODE = IC
AND M.CMP_NO = G.CMP_NO
AND M.BRN_NO = G.BRN_NO
AND M.ITEM_CODE = G.ITEM_CODE
AND M.TRANS_DATE BETWEEN G_FDAT AND G_TDAT
AND G.CTGR = 3
AND M.ITEM_CODE IN ( SELECT Y.ITEM_CODE
FROM MRP_CRP_ITEMS_CATEGORY Y
WHERE Y.CTGR = 2) )
INTO RSLT
IF RSLT < 0 THEN
RSLT := 0;
IF RSLT IS NULL THEN
RETURN(RSLT);
END; -- 16-01-2008*/

PROCEDURE ATTACHMENET (USR VARCHAR2)IS
QTY_ATT NUMBER;

NUMBER;

V_TYP NUMBER;

V_HEAD VARCHAR2(200);
V_ATT VARCHAR2(200);
FOR I IN ( SELECT DISTINCT FINAL_ITEM,FINAL_BOM,PLN,ATTACH,USR_NAME
WHERE ATTACH IS NOT NULL AND USR_NAME = USR
FOR J IN ( SELECT DISTINCT ITEM_CODE,BOM_CODE,ITEM_ROW,ITEM_MAIN,
SCRAP_PER,QTY
WHERE ITEM_CODE = I.FINAL_ITEM AND BOM_CODE = I.FINAL_BOM
AND ATT = I.ATTACH
SELECT (T.QTY_R/D.QTY)/M.BOM_QTY,T.CMP_NO,T.BRN_NO,
T.ITEM_CODE,T.BOM_CODE,T.SHF_CODE,T.LN_CODE,T.STG_CODE,
T.JOB_CODE,QTY_S,QTY_N,QTY_V,QTY_D,QTY_A,T.QTY_F,
QTY_W,T.OPTIONAL,T.ATP,T.BOM_ROW,ME,FLAGE,FINAL_ITEM,
FINAL_BOM,LVL,ROW_TYP,USR_NAME,ROW_DESC,PLN,HEAD,ATTACH
INTO QTY_ATT,V_CMP,V_BRN,V_ITEM,V_BOM,V_SHF,V_LN,
V_STG,V_JOB,V_S,V_N,V_V,V_D,V_A,V_F,V_W,V_OPTN,V_ATP,
V_BR,V_ME,V_FLG,V_FITEM,V_FBOM,V_LVL,V_TYP,V_USR,V_DESC,
V_PLN,V_HEAD,V_ATT
FROM MRP_MRP_BOM_ROW_TEMP T,MRP_BOM_BOM_MSTR M,MRP_BOM_BOM_ROW D
WHERE T.ITEM_CODE = J.ITEM_CODE
AND T.BOM_CODE = J.BOM_CODE
AND T.ITEM_ROW = J.ITEM_MAIN
AND T.FINAL_ITEM= J.ITEM_CODE
AND T.FINAL_BOM = J.BOM_CODE
AND DECODE(I.PLN,NULL,'1',PLN) = DECODE(I.PLN,NULL,'1',I.PLN)
AND T.USR_NAME = I.USR_NAME
AND T.ITEM_CODE = M.ITEM_CODE
AND T.BOM_CODE = M.BOM_CODE
AND T.ITEM_CODE = D.ITEM_CODE
AND T.BOM_CODE = D.BOM_CODE
AND T.ITEM_ROW = D.ITEM_ROW
AND T.CMP_NO = D.CMP_NO
AND T.BRN_NO = D.BRN_NO
AND T.CMP_NO = M.CMP_NO
AND T.BRN_NO = M.BRN_NO
AND T.CMP_NO = G_CMP
AND T.BRN_NO = G_BRN;
SET ITEM_ROW = J.ITEM_ROW, QTY_R = J.QTY * QTY_ATT,
QTY_S = J.SCRAP_PER
AND ITEM_ROW = J.ITEM_MAIN
AND FINAL_ITEM= J.ITEM_CODE
AND FINAL_BOM = J.BOM_CODE
AND USR_NAME = I.USR_NAME;
ETR := 0;
ETR := 1;
IF ETR = 1 THEN
INSERT INTO MRP_MRP_BOM_ROW_TEMP (CMP_NO,BRN_NO,ITEM_CODE,BOM_CODE,

ITEM_ROW,QTY_R,QTY_S,QTY_N,QTY_V,QTY_D,
QTY_A,QTY_F,QTY_W,OPTIONAL,ATP,BOM_ROW,
ME,FLAGE,FINAL_ITEM,FINAL_BOM,LVL,ROW_TYP,
USR_NAME,ROW_DESC,PLN,HEAD,ATTACH)
VALUES(V_CMP,V_BRN,V_ITEM,V_BOM,V_SHF,V_LN,
V_STG,V_JOB,J.ITEM_ROW,(J.QTY * QTY_ATT),
J.SCRAP_PER,V_N,V_V,V_D,V_A,V_F,V_W,V_OPTN,
V_ATP,V_BR,V_ME,V_FLG,V_FITEM,V_FBOM,V_LVL,
V_TYP,V_USR,V_DESC,V_PLN,V_HEAD,V_ATT);
FOR L IN ( SELECT DISTINCT ITEM_ROW FROM MRP_BOM_SUB_ITEMS
WHERE ITEM_CODE = I.FINAL_ITEM
AND CMP_NO = G_CMP AND BRN_NO = G_BRN )LOOP
SELECT DISTINCT BOM_CODE
INTO BCOD
WHERE ITEM_CODE = L.ITEM_ROW
AND FINAL_ITEM= I.FINAL_ITEM
AND FINAL_BOM = I.FINAL_BOM
AND LVL > 1
BCOD := NULL;
WHERE ITEM_CODE = L.ITEM_ROW AND BOM_CODE = BCOD
AND T.FINAL_ITEM= I.FINAL_ITEM
AND T.FINAL_BOM = I.FINAL_BOM
_CODE,LN_CODE,STG_CODE,JOB_CODE,

FUNCTION FNC_GET_SHF_CODE_BOM(P_CMP_NO NUMBER, P_BRN_NO NUMBER, P_BOM IN VARCHAR2, P_ITEM VARCHAR2 ) RETURN NUMBER IS

P_SHF_CODE NUMBER ) RETURN NUMBER IS
QTY_Y NUMBER := 0; -- DEFAULT VALUE WHENEVER THE "G_WRK" WORK ORDER IS NULL
IF G_WRK is Not Null Then
SELECT SUM(D.QTY)
INTO QTY_Y
FROM MRP_SFC_WIP_MASTER_YIELD D,
MRP_SFC_WIP_MASTER M
WHERE M.CMP_NO = D.CMP_NO
AND M.BRN_NO = D.BRN_NO
AND M.SF_SEQ = D.SF_SEQ
AND M.WORK_ORDER = D.WORK_ORDER
AND M.WORK_ORDER = G_WRK
AND M.CMP_NO = P_CMP_NO
AND M.BRN_NO = P_BRN_NO
AND M.SHF_CODE = P_SHF_CODE
AND D.BOM_CODE = P_BOM_ROW
AND D.ITEM_CODE = P_ITEM_ROW
-- INCASE OF SUB PRODUCT YIELD , NOT OF FINISH PRODUCT YIELD
AND D.PRD_TYPE = 0
AND DECODE(G_SEQ,NULL,0, M.SF_SEQ) <= DECODE(G_SEQ,NULL,0, G_SEQ)
AND DECODE(G_YLD,NULL,0,D.YIELD_SEQ) <> DECODE(G_YLD,NULL,-1,G_YLD)
AND M.APP_USR IS NULL
AND M.APP_DATE IS NULL ;
RETURN QTY_Y;
END FNC_GET_QTY_YIELD;
) RETURN NUMBER IS

INTO QTY_S

FUNCTION FNC_GET_QTY_WIP(P_CMP_NO NUMBER, P_BRN_NO NUMBER, P_ITEM_ROW VARCHAR2 , P_BOM_ROW VARCHAR2 ,P_FP_REC FINAL_PRODUCT_REC) RETURN NUMBER IS
V_QTY NUMBER := 0; -- QTY FROM ITEM MOVE TABLE
V_QTY_CONSPTION NUMBER := 0; -- QTY OF CONSUMPTION FROM CONSUPTION TABLE
V_QTY_Y NUMBER:= 0; -- QTY PRODUCING BUT NOT APPROVED YET;
V_QTY_S NUMBER:= 0; -- QTY SCRAPING BUT NOT APPROVED YET;
IF P_BOM_ROW IS NOT NULL THEN
V_SHF_CODE := FNC_GET_SHF_CODE_BOM(P_CMP_NO , P_BRN_NO , P_BOM_ROW , P_ITEM_ROW);
V_SHF_CODE := FNC_GET_SHF_CODE_BOM(P_CMP_NO , P_BRN_NO , P_FP_REC.F_BOM, P_FP_REC.F_ASS);
IF G_WRK IS NULL THEN
--#-------------------------------------------#--
INTO V_QTY
WHERE CMP_NO = P_CMP_NO
AND BRN_NO = P_BRN_NO
AND SHF_CODE = V_SHF_CODE
AND ITEM_CODE = P_ITEM_ROW
AND DECODE(BOM_CODE,NULL,'-1',BOM_CODE) = DECODE(BOM_CODE,NULL,'-1',P_BOM_ROW)
AND WORK_ORDER IS NULL
AND TO_DATE(TRANS_DATE,'DD/MM/YYYY') <= NVL(TO_DATE(P_FP_REC.F_DAT,'DD/MM/YYYY'),TO_DATE(TRANS_DATE,'DD/MM/YYYY') ) ;
AND WORK_ORDER IS NOT NULL
AND DECODE(BOM_CODE,NULL,'-1',BOM_CODE) = DECODE(BOM_CODE,NULL,'-1',P_BOM_ROW);
-- AND TO_DATE(TRANS_DATE,'DD/MM/YYYY') <= NVL(TO_DATE(P_FP_REC.F_DAT,'DD/MM/YYYY'),TO_DATE(TRANS_DATE,'DD/MM/YYYY') ) ;
--#-------------------------------------------#-
INTO V_QTY_CONSPTION
AND NVL(WORK_ORDER,'-1') = DECODE(G_WRK,NULL,'-1', G_WRK )
AND DECODE(G_SEQ,NULL,0, SF_SEQ) <= DECODE(G_SEQ,NULL,0, G_SEQ)
AND DECODE(G_YLD,NULL,0,YIELD_SEQ) <> DECODE(G_YLD,NULL,-1,G_YLD)
AND DECODE(G_SRP,NULL,0,SCAP_SEQ) <> DECODE(G_SRP,NULL,-1,G_SRP)
AND DECODE(G_YSATT,NULL,'-1',ATT_SEQ) <> DECODE(G_YSATT,NULL,'-2',G_YSATT)
(SELECT CMP_NO,BRN_NO,WORK_ORDER,SF_SEQ,
SHF_CODE
AND APP_DATE IS NULL
--AND TO_DATE(SF_DATE,'DD/MM/YYYY') <= NVL(TO_DATE(P_FP_REC.F_DAT,'DD/MM/YYYY'),TO_DATE(SF_DATE,'DD/MM/YYYY'))
V_QTY_Y := FNC_GET_QTY_YIELD ( P_CMP_NO , P_BRN_NO ,
P_ITEM_ROW ,
P_BOM_ROW ,
V_SHF_CODE
V_QTY_S:= FNC_GET_QTY_SCRAP ( P_CMP_NO , P_BRN_NO ,
IF P_BOM_ROW IS NULL THEN
V_QTY_S :=0;
IF ( NVL(V_QTY,0) + NVL(V_QTY_Y,0) ) - (NVL(V_QTY_CONSPTION,0) +NVL(V_QTY_S,0) ) < 0 THEN
RETURN ( NVL(V_QTY,0) + NVL(V_QTY_Y,0) ) - (NVL(V_QTY_CONSPTION,0) +NVL(V_QTY_S,0) ) ;
END FNC_GET_QTY_WIP ;
P_FP_REC FINAL_PRODUCT_REC) IS
V_QTY_STOCK NUMBER;
V_ITEM_OPTION MRP_CRP_ITEMS_CLASS_OPTIONS.ITEM_OPTION%TYPE:= NULL;
V_QTY_V NUMBER:= 0;
V_QTY_W NUMBER:= 0;
V_FP_REC FINAL_PRODUCT_REC := P_FP_REC;
V_BEST_ITEM VARCHAR2(30):= NULL;
V_INDX NUMBER:= 0;
V_FND_ENGHT_QTY NUMBER:= 0;
V_QTY_N NUMBER ; --REQUIREMNT QTY IN BOM OF ITEM ROW WHICH HAS ALTERNATIVE . IT HOULD BE * BY THE OFFSET OF ALTERNATIVE .
V_OFFSET NUMBER:= 1;--DEFAULT VALUE;
V_PRIR NUMBER;
------------------
CURSOR CUR_ITEMS_ALT IS
SELECT CMP_NO, BRN_NO, MRP_ITEM_CODE, ITEM_OPTION ,OFFSET ,PRIORITY
WHERE MRP_ITEM_CODE = P_ITEM_ROW
AND CMP_NO = P_CMP_NO
ORDER BY NVL(PRIORITY,1) ASC;
CUR_ITEMS_REC CUR_ITEMS_ALT%ROWTYPE;
MRP_ITEM_CODE = P_ITEM_ROW AND
USR_NAME = G_USR_NAME ;
V_FND_ENGHT_QTY := 0;
OPEN CUR_ITEMS_ALT ;
FETCH CUR_ITEMS_ALT INTO CUR_ITEMS_REC;
WHILE CUR_ITEMS_ALT%FOUND AND V_FND_ENGHT_QTY = 0
V_ITEM_OPTION := CUR_ITEMS_REC.ITEM_OPTION;
V_OFFSET := NVL(CUR_ITEMS_REC.OFFSET,1);
v_qty_v := 0;
V_QTY_W:= FNC_GET_QTY_WIP(P_CMP_NO, P_BRN_NO,V_ITEM_OPTION, P_BOM_ROW, P_FP_REC ) ;
IF NVL(V_QTY_W,0) <= 0 THEN
V_QTY_W := 0;
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN V_QTY_W := 0;
V_QTY_N := P_QTY_N * NVL(V_OFFSET,1);
IF V_FP_REC.SEQ IS NULL THEN
V_QTY_V :=GNR_PKG.GET_ITM_QTY (P_ITM_CODE =>V_ITEM_OPTION);
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN V_QTY_V := 0;
IF NVL(V_QTY_V,0) + NVL(V_QTY_W,0) >= NVL(V_QTY_N,P_QTY_N) THEN
V_FND_ENGHT_QTY:= 1;
IF NVL(V_QTY_W,0) >= V_QTY_N THEN
END IF; --IF SEQ IS NULL
EXIT WHEN V_FND_ENGHT_QTY = 1 ;
INSERT INTO MRP_BEST_CLASS_OPTIONS_TEMP(USR_NAME, CMP_NO, BRN_NO, PRIORITY, OFFSET, MRP_ITEM_CODE, ITEM_OPTION,QTY_W, QTY_V, QTY_N)
VALUES(G_USR_NAME,
CUR_ITEMS_REC.CMP_NO,
CUR_ITEMS_REC.BRN_NO,
CUR_ITEMS_REC.PRIORITY,
CUR_ITEMS_REC.OFFSET,
CUR_ITEMS_REC.MRP_ITEM_CODE,
CUR_ITEMS_REC.ITEM_OPTION,
NVL(V_QTY_W,0), NVL(V_QTY_V,0), NVL(V_QTY_N,0)
EXIT WHEN CUR_ITEMS_ALT%NOTFOUND;
CLOSE CUR_ITEMS_ALT;
IF NVL(V_FND_ENGHT_QTY,0) = 1 THEN
P_ITEM_OPTION := V_ITEM_OPTION;
P_QTY_N :=V_QTY_N ;
P_QTY_V := V_QTY_V;
P_QTY_W := V_QTY_W;
FROM MRP_BEST_CLASS_OPTIONS_TEMP
USR_NAME = G_USR_NAME AND
NVL(QTY_W,0) >0;
IF V_CNT > 0 THEN
SELECT ITEM_OPTION, MAX(QTY_W), MAX(QTY_V), MAX(QTY_N)
INTO V_ITEM_OPTION, V_QTY_W, V_QTY_V,V_QTY_N
NVL(QTY_W,0) > 0 AND
ROWNUM<=1
GROUP BY ITEM_OPTION ;
IF V_QTY_W <> 0 THEN
SELECT DISTINCT ITEM_OPTION
INTO V_ITEM_OPTION
AND EXISTS ( SELECT NVL(MIN(NVL(PRIORITY,1) ),1) FROM MRP_CRP_ITEMS_CLASS_OPTIONS
AND ROWNUM<=1 ;
P_QTY_V := 0;
P_QTY_W := 0;
P_ITEM_OPTION := NULL;
P_QTY_W :=V_QTY_W;
P_QTY_N := V_QTY_N;
RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR (-20021,
'There is An Error in PRC_GET_BEST_CLASS_OPTION: :' || SQLERRM
END PRC_GET_BEST_CLASS_OPTION;
PROCEDURE SET_GENERAL_VARIBLES(P_FP_REC FINAL_PRODUCT_REC) IS
G_CMP := P_FP_REC.CMP; -- COMPANY PARAMETER
G_BRN := P_FP_REC.BRN; -- BRANCH PARAMETER
G_ASS := P_FP_REC.F_ASS; -- CURRENT PRODUCT (OR SUB PRODUCT) TO BE ANALYST
G_BOM := P_FP_REC.F_BOM; -- CURRENT PRODUCT BOM (OR SUB PRODUCT BOM ) TO BE ANALYST
G_QTY := P_FP_REC.R_QTY; -- QTY OF PRODUCT OR SUB PRODUCT TO BE ANALYST
G_FASS := P_FP_REC.FIN_ASS; -- FINAL PRODUCT TO BE ANALYST
G_FBOM := P_FP_REC.FIN_BOM; -- FINAL PRODUCT BOM TO BE ANALYST
G_WRK := P_FP_REC.WRKD; -- WORK ORDER TO BE ANLAYST
G_SEQ := P_FP_REC.SEQ; -- SEQ OF SHOP FLOOR CARD TRANSACTION IN MRPSFC025.FMX SCREEN
G_YLD := P_FP_REC.YLD_SQ; -- SEQ OF YILED IN CONSUMPTION TABLE
G_SRP := P_FP_REC.SRP_SQ; -- SEQ OF SCRAP IN CONSUMPTION TABLE
G_ATT := P_FP_REC.ATT;
G_YSATT := P_FP_REC.YSATT_SQ; -- ATTACHMENT SEQ IN CONSUMPTION TABLE EITHER YIELD OF EVEN SCRAP
G_FDAT := P_FP_REC.F_DAT;
G_TDAT := P_FP_REC.T_DAT;
G_CMP := NULL;
G_BRN := NULL;
G_ASS := NULL;
G_BOM := NULL;
G_QTY := NULL;
G_FASS := NULL;
G_FBOM := NULL;
G_WRK := NULL;
G_SEQ := NULL;
G_YLD := NULL;
G_SRP := NULL;
G_YSATT := NULL;
G_FDAT := NULL;
G_TDAT := NULL;
G_ATT := NULL;
PROCEDURE PRC_START_CALCULATION( FP FINAL_PRODUCT,
P_LANG NUMBER,W_ORD VARCHAR2) IS
--#-----------------------#--
V_FP FINAL_PRODUCT;
V_FP_REC FINAL_PRODUCT_REC;
V_ATT VARCHAR2(30) := NULL;
V_BOM_QTY NUMBER; -- QTY OF MSTR BOM FOR THE CURENT ROW ITEM;
V_ITEM_ROW VARCHAR2(40):= NULL;
V_ITEM_ROW_BOM VARCHAR2(40):= NULL;
V_ROW_TYP NUMBER(1); -- 0= ROW OR SUB PRODYCT ; 1 = ITEM HAS CTGR = 8 ; 2 = ROW IS ALTERNATIVE OF ROW HAS CTGR = 8
V_USR VARCHAR2(100):= USR;
V_LVL NUMBER:= LVL ;
V_LANG NUMBER:= P_LANG;
V_W_ORD VARCHAR2(50):= W_ORD;
--#--------------------
---#--
V_QTY_R NUMBER; -- QTY_R IN TEMPORARY TABLE FOR THE RaW MATERIAL
V_QTY_S NUMBER;
V_QTY_D NUMBER;
V_QTY_F NUMBER;
V_QTY_N NUMBER;
V_QTY_V NUMBER;
V_QTY_W NUMBER;
V_QTY_MIN NUMBER;--11-09-2013
V_QTY_MAX NUMBER;--11-09-2013
V_ATT_QTY_MAX NUMBER;--11-09-2013
V_ATT_QTY_MIN NUMBER;--11-09-2013
V_QTY_WEIGHT NUMBER;--24-02-2012
V_QTY_S_WEIGHT NUMBER;--24-02-2012
V_ATT_QTY NUMBER;
V_ATT_SCRAP NUMBER;
V_CMT NUMBER(1):= 0;
VEXP_INSERT_FAILD EXCEPTION;
FOR INDX IN 1..FP.COUNT LOOP
V_FP_REC := FP(INDX);
SET_GENERAL_VARIBLES(V_FP_REC);
FOR J IN ( SELECT CMP_NO, BRN_NO,
ROW_ORDER,
ITEM_CODE, BOM_CODE,
SHF_CODE,
LN_CODE,
STG_CODE,
JOB_CODE,
ITEM_ROW, BOM_ROW,
SCRAP_PER,
NVL(MIN_QTY,0) MIN_QTY,
NVL(MAX_QTY,0) MAX_QTY ,
MUT_EXC,
NVL(ATP,0) ATP,
NVL(OPTIONAL,0) OPTIONAL
WHERE CMP_NO = V_FP_REC.CMP
AND BRN_NO = V_FP_REC.BRN
AND ITEM_CODE = V_FP_REC.F_ASS
AND BOM_CODE = V_FP_REC.F_BOM
AND NVL(ATP,1) = 0
ORDER BY CMP_NO, BRN_NO, ITEM_CODE, BOM_CODE,
SHF_CODE, LN_CODE, STG_CODE, JOB_CODE,
ITEM_ROW ,
BOM_ROW NULLS LAST
V_BOM_QTY := FNC_GET_MSTR_BOM_QTY(J.CMP_NO, J.BRN_NO, J.ITEM_CODE, J.BOM_CODE);
IF NVL(V_BOM_QTY,0) = 0 THEN
RETURN;
END IF ;
V_QTY_R := (J.QTY / V_BOM_QTY) * V_FP_REC.R_QTY;
V_QTY_MAX := (J.MAX_QTY / V_BOM_QTY) * V_FP_REC.R_QTY;
V_QTY_MIN := (J.MIN_QTY / V_BOM_QTY) * V_FP_REC.R_QTY;
-- CHECK IF THE ROW HAS CTGR = 8 "CLASS OPTION" ; IF THEN GET THE ALTERNATIVE ROW
IF GNR_PKG.FNC_is_Item_class_option( J.CMP_NO, J.BRN_NO, J.ITEM_ROW ) THEN
V_ROW_TYP := 2;
PRC_GET_BEST_CLASS_OPTION( P_CMP_NO => J.CMP_NO ,
P_BRN_NO
=> J.BRN_NO ,
P_ITEM_CODE => J.ITEM_CODE ,
P_BOM_CODE => J.BOM_CODE ,
P_ITEM_ROW => J.ITEM_ROW ,
P_BOM_ROW => J.BOM_ROW ,
P_QTY_N => V_QTY_R ,
P_ITEM_OPTION => V_ITEM_ROW ,
P_QTY_V => V_QTY_V ,
P_QTY_W => V_QTY_W ,
P_FP_REC => V_FP_REC
-- INCASE OF THERE IS NO ALTERNATIVE MATERILAS FOR THIS ITEM ROW
IF V_ITEM_ROW IS NULL THEN
V_ITEM_ROW := J.ITEM_ROW;
V_QTY_V := 0;
V_ITEM_ROW_BOM := J.BOM_ROW;
IF NVL(J.SCRAP_PER,0) > 0 THEN
V_QTY_S := ( (V_QTY_R * J.SCRAP_PER) /100 ) * 1/ (1 - (J.SCRAP_PER/100));
V_QTY_S := 0;
V_QTY_N := V_QTY_R + V_QTY_S ;
ELSIF G_MRP_USE_ATTCH = 1 AND V_FP_REC.ATT IS NOT NULL AND
J.ITEM_CODE = V_FP_REC.F_ASS AND NVL(J.BOM_CODE,'-1') = V_FP_REC.F_BOM AND
ATT_PKG.FNC_ITM_ATTCH_CNT( P_CMP_NO => J.CMP_NO ,P_BRN_NO => J.BRN_NO ,P_ITEM_CODE => J.ITEM_CODE ) >= 1
ATT_PKG.PRC_GET_ROW_IN_ATT_BOM( P_CMP_NO => J.CMP_NO ,
P_BRN_NO => J.BRN_NO ,
P_ITEM_MAIN => J.ITEM_ROW ,
P_ATT => V_FP_REC.ATT,
P_ATT_ROW => V_ITEM_ROW ,
P_ATT_ROW_BOM => V_ITEM_ROW_BOM ,
P_ATT_QTY => V_ATT_QTY ,
P_ATT_SCRAP => V_ATT_SCRAP ,
P_ATT_QTY_MAX => V_ATT_QTY_MAX ,
P_ATT_QTY_MIN => V_ATT_QTY_MIN) ;
IF V_ITEM_ROW IS NOT NULL THEN -- AND NVL(V_ATT_QTY,0) > 0 THEN
IF NVL(V_ATT_QTY,0) > 0 THEN
V_QTY_R := (V_ATT_QTY / V_BOM_QTY) * V_FP_REC.R_QTY;
V_QTY_MAX := (V_ATT_QTY_MAX / V_BOM_QTY) * V_FP_REC.R_QTY;
V_QTY_MIN := (V_ATT_QTY_MIN / V_BOM_QTY) * V_FP_REC.R_QTY;
V_QTY_S := ( (V_QTY_R * V_ATT_SCRAP)/100 ) *1/ (1 - (V_ATT_SCRAP/100)) ;
V_QTY_V :=GNR_PKG.GET_ITM_QTY (P_ITM_CODE =>V_ITEM_ROW);
V_QTY_W := NVL(FNC_GET_QTY_WIP(J.CMP_NO , J.BRN_NO ,V_ITEM_ROW , J.BOM_ROW, V_FP_REC ),0);
V_QTY_V := GNR_PKG.GET_ITM_QTY (P_ITM_CODE =>V_ITEM_ROW );
V_ROW_TYP := 0;
V_QTY_V := GNR_PKG.GET_ITM_QTY (P_ITM_CODE =>J.ITEM_ROW );
V_QTY_W := NVL(FNC_GET_QTY_WIP(J.CMP_NO , J.BRN_NO , J.ITEM_ROW , J.BOM_ROW, V_FP_REC ),0);
IF NVL(V_QTY_W,0) < 0 THEN
-- INCASE OF SHOP FLOOR CARD SCREEN MRPSFC025
IF G_WRK IS NOT NULL THEN
-- THIS MEANS THAT THERE IS LOSS QTY, IT CAN NOT BE CONTINE PRODUCING
IF ((V_QTY_R - NVL(V_QTY_MIN,0) ) - NVL(V_QTY_W,0) ) > 0 THEN
V_QTY_D := (V_QTY_R - NVL(V_QTY_MIN,0) ) - V_QTY_W;
V_QTY_D := 0;-- THATS MEAN QTY WIP >= QTY_R
IF (V_QTY_R - NVL(V_QTY_MIN,0) ) - (NVL(V_QTY_V,0) + NVL(V_QTY_W,0) ) > 0 THEN
V_QTY_D := (V_QTY_R - NVL(V_QTY_MIN,0) ) - (NVL(V_QTY_V,0) + NVL(V_QTY_W,0) );
IF V_ITEM_ROW IS NOT NULL THEN
--24-02-2012
IF NVL(G_MRP_USE_WEIGHT,0) = 1 THEN
V_QTY_WEIGHT := WEIGHT_PKG.FNC_GET_ITEM_QTY_WEIGHT(P_CMP_NO => J.CMP_NO, P_BRN_NO => J.BRN_NO , P_ITEM_CODE => V_ITEM_ROW, P_QTY=> V_QTY_R);
V_QTY_S_WEIGHT := WEIGHT_PKG.FNC_GET_ITEM_QTY_WEIGHT(P_CMP_NO => J.CMP_NO, P_BRN_NO => J.BRN_NO , P_ITEM_CODE => V_ITEM_ROW, P_QTY=> V_QTY_S);
V_QTY_WEIGHT := 0;
V_QTY_S_WEIGHT := 0;
INSERT INTO MRP_MRP_BOM_ROW_TEMP(CMP_NO,
FINAL_ITEM,
FINAL_BOM,
ITEM_CODE,
BOM_CODE,
ITEM_ROW,
HEAD,
ROW_TYP,
ROW_DESC,
QTY_R,
QTY_S,
QTY_N,
QTY_V,
QTY_D,
QTY_A,
QTY_F,
QTY_W,
QTY_WEIGHT,
QTY_S_WEIGHT,
MAX_QTY ,
MIN_QTY ,
OPTIONAL,
ATP,
LVL,
USR_NAME,
PLN,
ATTACH
( J.CMP_NO, J.BRN_NO,
V_FP_REC.FIN_ASS ,
V_FP_REC.FIN_BOM,
J.ITEM_CODE,
J.BOM_CODE,
J.SHF_CODE, J.LN_CODE, J.STG_CODE, J.JOB_CODE,
V_ITEM_ROW,
V_ITEM_ROW_BOM,
DECODE(V_ROW_TYP,2,J.ITEM_ROW,NULL), -- HEAD
V_ROW_TYP,--ROW_TYP
J.ROW_ORDER,
'', --ROW_DESC
ROUND(V_QTY_R, G_QTY_ROW_DGT),
ROUND(V_QTY_S, G_QTY_ROW_DGT),
ROUND(V_QTY_N, G_QTY_ROW_DGT),
ROUND(NVL(V_QTY_V,0), G_QTY_ROW_DGT) ,
ROUND(NVL(V_QTY_D,0), G_QTY_ROW_DGT),
0,--QTY_A
0, --QTY_F
ROUND(NVL(V_QTY_W,0), G_QTY_ROW_DGT),
ROUND(NVL(V_QTY_WEIGHT,0), G_QTY_ROW_DGT),--24-02-2012
ROUND(NVL(V_QTY_S_WEIGHT,0), G_QTY_ROW_DGT),--24-02-2012
ROUND(NVL(V_QTY_MAX,0), G_QTY_ROW_DGT) ,
ROUND(NVL(V_QTY_MIN,0), G_QTY_ROW_DGT) ,
J.OPTIONAL,
J.ATP,
J.MUT_EXC,
0, --FLAGE
V_LVL , --LVL
V_USR, --USR_NAME
NVL(V_FP_REC.F_PLN,0),
V_FP_REC.ATT
IF SQL%NOTFOUND THEN
RAISE VEXP_INSERT_FAILD;
V_CMT := 1;
IF ROW IS SUB PRODUCT THEN ANALYS TO ITS RaW MATERILAS
BY CALL THIS PRCEDURE RECURSION WITH V_FP LIST
WHICH CONTAINS ONLY THE SUB PRODUCT
IF V_ITEM_ROW_BOM IS NOT NULL THEN -- ROW IS SUB PRODUCT ;
V_FP := BOM_PKG_NEW.FINAL_PRODUCT();
V_FP.EXTEND();
--#----------------#--
V_FP(1).CMP := V_FP_REC.CMP;
V_FP(1).BRN := V_FP_REC.BRN;
V_FP(1).FIN_ASS := V_FP_REC.FIN_ASS;
V_FP(1).FIN_BOM := V_FP_REC.FIN_BOM;
V_FP(1).F_ASS := V_ITEM_ROW;
V_FP(1).F_BOM := V_ITEM_ROW_BOM;
V_FP(1).R_QTY := V_QTY_R;
V_FP(1).SEQ := V_FP_REC.SEQ;
V_FP(1).WRKD := V_FP_REC.WRKD;
V_FP(1).YLD_SQ := V_FP_REC.YLD_SQ;
V_FP(1).SRP_SQ := V_FP_REC.SRP_SQ;
V_FP(1).F_DAT := V_FP_REC.F_DAT;
V_FP(1).T_DAT := V_FP_REC.T_DAT;
V_FP(1).F_PLN := NVL(V_FP_REC.F_PLN,0);
V_FP(1).ATT := V_FP_REC.ATT;
V_FP(1).YSATT_SQ := V_FP_REC.YSATT_SQ;
PRC_START_CALCULATION ( FP => V_FP,
LVL => V_LVL +1,
USR => V_USR,
P_LANG => V_LANG ,
W_ORD => V_W_ORD) ;
V_FP.DELETE();
IF V_CMT = 1 THEN
EXCEPTION WHEN VEXP_INSERT_FAILD THEN
ROLLBACK;
'There is An Error in PRC_CALCULATE_ROW_ITEMS: :' || SQLERRM

--******************************************************--
Select
QTY_ROW_DGT --
InTo
G_QTY_ROW_DGT

IF FP.COUNT < 1 THEN
--To delete all the Result about old Final Products for this user
AND BRN_NO = FP(1).BRN;

G_MRP_USE_WEIGHT := NVL(GNR_PKG.FNC_GET_PRMTR_VAL(P_CMP => FP(1).CMP, P_BRN => FP(1).BRN, P_FLD => 'MRP_USE_WEIGHT'),0);--24-02-2012
G_USR_NAME := USR;
PRC_START_CALCULATION( FP => FP,
LVL => LVL ,
USR => USR,
P_LANG => P_LANG ,
W_ORD => W_ORD);
PDATE MRP_MRP_BOM_ROW_TEMP
CREATE_FORMULA_PKG
"PKG INIT"CREATE_FORMULA_PKG""
CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE Formula_PKG IS
FUNCTION TOTAL_TIME_FNC (OFFICIAL_TIME NUMBER ,OVER_TIME NUMBER ) RETURN NUMBER ;
FUNCTION AVALIVALE_TIME_FNC ( OFFICIAL_TIME NUMBER ,OVER_TIME NUMBER, ALLOWSTOP_TIME NUMBER ) RETURN NUMBER ;
FUNCTION EXPECTED_PRODUCTION_FNC ( Standerd NUMBER , AVALIVALE_TIME NUMBER ) RETURN NUMBER;
FUNCTION PLAND_PRODUCTION_FNC ( EXPECTED_PRODUCTION NUMBER , PRODUCTIVITY_PLANED NUMBER ) RETURN NUMBER;
FUNCTION ACTUAL_PRODUCTIVITY_FNC ( ACTUAL_PRODUCTION NUMBER ,EXPECTED_PRODUCTION NUMBER ) RETURN NUMBER ;
FUNCTION SHIFT_HOURS( VCMP_NO S_BRN.CMP_NO%TYPE,
VBRN_NO S_BRN.BRN_NO%TYPE,
VSHF_CODE MRP_SGS_SHOPS_FLOOR_CODING.SHF_CODE%TYPE,
VSHIFT_CODE MRP_SGS_SHIFTS_MAST.SHIFT_CODE%TYPE,
VSHIFT_COUNT NUMBER DEFAULT 1,
VP_HUR_MNT NUMBER DEFAULT 1
) RETURN NUMBER ;
END Formula_PKG;
CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE BODY Formula_PKG IS
FUNCTION TOTAL_TIME_FNC (OFFICIAL_TIME NUMBER ,OVER_TIME NUMBER ) RETURN NUMBER IS
TOTAL_TIME NUMBER;
--totale time = offcial time + over time
TOTAL_TIME :=OFFICIAL_TIME +OVER_TIME;
RETURN TOTAL_TIME;
FUNCTION AVALIVALE_TIME_FNC ( OFFICIAL_TIME NUMBER ,OVER_TIME NUMBER, ALLOWSTOP_TIME NUMBER ) RETURN NUMBER IS
AVALIVALE_TIME NUMBER;
--avilabe time = (offcial time + over time ) -allowed stop
AVALIVALE_TIME :=(OFFICIAL_TIME +OVER_TIME ) - ALLOWSTOP_TIME ;
RETURN AVALIVALE_TIME;
FUNCTION EXPECTED_PRODUCTION_FNC ( Standerd NUMBER , AVALIVALE_TIME NUMBER ) RETURN NUMBER IS
EXPECTED_PRODUCTION NUMBER;
--expected Producation = Standerd * avilabletime
EXPECTED_PRODUCTION :=Standerd * AVALIVALE_TIME;
END EXPECTED_PRODUCTION_FNC;
FUNCTION PLAND_PRODUCTION_FNC ( EXPECTED_PRODUCTION NUMBER , PRODUCTIVITY_PLANED NUMBER ) RETURN NUMBER IS
PLAND_PRODUCTION NUMBER;
(/100
PLAND_PRODUCTION :=(EXPECTED_PRODUCTION * PRODUCTIVITY_PLANED)*100;
END PLAND_PRODUCTION_FNC;
FUNCTION ACTUAL_PRODUCTIVITY_FNC ( ACTUAL_PRODUCTION NUMBER ,EXPECTED_PRODUCTION NUMBER ) RETURN NUMBER IS
ACTUAL_PRODUCTIVITY NUMBER;
*100
ACTUAL_PRODUCTIVITY :=(ACTUAL_PRODUCTION /EXPECTED_PRODUCTION)*100;
END ACTUAL_PRODUCTIVITY_FNC;
FUNCTION deviance_PRODUCTIVITY_FNC ( ACTUAL_PRODUCTIVITY NUMBER ,EXPECTED_PRODUCTIVITY NUMBER ) RETURN NUMBER IS
deviance_PRODUCTIVITY NUMBER;
deviance_PRODUCTIVITY :=EXPECTED_PRODUCTIVITY -ACTUAL_PRODUCTIVITY;
END deviance_PRODUCTIVITY_FNC;
VP_HUR_MNT NUMBER DEFAULT
SHIFHOURS NUMBER;
SELECT ROUND(TO_NUMBER(TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(TIME_T,'HH24:MI'),'HH24:MI')-
TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(TIME_F,'HH24:MI'),'HH24:MI')
INTO SHIFHOURS
FROM MRP_SGS_SHIFTS_MAST
CMP_NO =VCMP_NO
AND BRN_NO =VBRN_NO
AND SHIFT_CODE =VSHIFT_CODE
AND SHF_CODE =VSHF_CODE
AND P_CNTU =0
AND IND_OVERTIME =0; -- OFFCIAL
RETURN abs(SHIFHOURS)*VSHIFT_COUNT*VP_HUR_MNT; --13-7-2010
TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(TIME_F,'HH24:MI'),'HH24:MI'))*24,2)
FROM MRP_SGS_SHIFTS_MAINT
AND P_CNTU =0;
RETURN SHIFHOURS*VSHIFT_COUNT *VP_HUR_MNT;--13-7-2010
CREATE_GNR_PKG

CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE BODY GNR_PKG AS
FUNCTION FNC_USR_NM (P_USR_NO USER_R.U_ID%TYPE, P_LANG NUMBER) RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
V_USR_NAME USER_R.U_A_NAME%TYPE := NULL;
SELECT DECODE(P_LANG ,1,U_A_NAME, NVL(U_E_NAME,U_A_NAME) ) INTO V_USR_NAME
FROM USER_R
WHERE U_ID = P_USR_NO
RETURN V_USR_NAME ;
END FNC_USR_NM;
FUNCTION FNC_MCHN_SHFTS_HRS(P_CMP_NO NUMBER , P_BRN_NO NUMBER , P_SHF_CODE MRP_SGS_SHOPS_FLOOR_CODING.SHF_CODE%TYPE, P_RCE_SER MRP_CRP_RESOURCES.RCE_SER%TYPE) RETURN NUMBER IS
V_HRS NUMBER:= 0;
SELECT SUM(M.SHIFT_HRS) INTO V_HRS
FROM MRP_SGS_SHIFTS_MAST M
SHF_CODE = P_SHF_CODE AND
P_CNTU = 0 AND
(SHF_CODE, SHIFT_CODE ) IN
( SELECT SHF_CODE, SHIFT_CODE
FROM MRP_CRP_RECE_SHIFTS
RCE_SER = P_RCE_SER
RETURN V_HRS ;
V_HRS := 0;
END FNC_MCHN_SHFTS_HRS;
FUNCTION FNC_GET_TIME_HRS(FTIME DATE , TTIME DATE ) RETURN NUMBER IS
IF TO_DATE( '01/01/2000 ' || TO_CHAR(FTIME,'HH24:MI:SS') ,'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI:SS') <=
TO_DATE( '01/01/2000 ' || TO_CHAR(TTIME,'HH24:MI:SS') ,'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI:SS') THEN
V_HRS:= (
TO_DATE( '01/01/2000 ' || TO_CHAR(TTIME,'HH24:MI:SS'),'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI:SS' ) -
TO_DATE( '01/01/2000 ' || TO_CHAR(FTIME,'HH24:MI:SS'),'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI:SS' )
) * 24;
) * 24 + 24;
RETURN V_HRS;
END FNC_GET_TIME_HRS;

--------------#--
FUNCTION FNC_ONX_ITEM(P_CMP_NO NUMBER , P_BRN_NO NUMBER, P_ITEM_CODE VARCHAR2) RETURN NUMBER IS
V_SLCT VARCHAR2(2000):= NULL;
V_cnt varchar2(20):= null;
V_INV_I_CODE VARCHAR2(30);
V_UNIT_CODE VARCHAR2(10);
GNR_PKG.PRC_GET_ITEM_INV_DATA ( P_ITM_CODE => P_ITEM_CODE
,P_INV_I_CODE => V_INV_I_CODE
,P_UNIT_CODE => V_UNIT_CODE );
V_SLCT := 'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ITEM_DETAILS WHERE
I_CODE = '||CHR(295)||V_INV_I_CODE ||CHR(295)||
' AND UNIT = '||CHR(295)||V_UNIT_CODE ||CHR(295)||
' AND ROWNUM<=1 ';
V_cnt := GNR_PKG.FNC_RUN_SEL(V_SLCT);
Exception When Others Then
V_cnt := 0;
IF nvl(V_cnt,0) = 0 then
Else
RETURN 1;
END FNC_ONX_ITEM;

FUNCTION FNC_DAY_OFF(P_CMP_NO NUMBER , P_BRN_NO NUMBER , P_DATE DATE ) RETURN NUMBER IS
V_RET NUMBER := 0;
FOR I IN ( SELECT
SC_SATURDAY, SC_SUNDAY, SC_TUESDAY,
SC_MONDAY, SC_WEDNESDAY, SC_THURSDAY,
SC_FRIDAY
FROM MRP_SGS_SCHDUL_CLNDR_MSTR
YER_CODE IN ( SELECT YER_CODE FROM MRP_YEAR WHERE P_CNTU = 0 AND P_CLS = 0 AND CMP_NO = P_CMP_NO AND BRN_NO = P_BRN_NO)
IF LTRIM(RTRIM(TO_CHAR(P_DATE,'DAY'))) = 'SATURDAY' AND I.SC_SATURDAY = 0 THEN V_RET := 1;
ELSIF LTRIM(RTRIM(TO_CHAR(P_DATE,'DAY'))) = 'SUNDAY' AND I.SC_SUNDAY = 0 THEN V_RET := 1;
ELSIF LTRIM(RTRIM(TO_CHAR(P_DATE,'DAY'))) = 'MONDAY' AND I.SC_MONDAY = 0 THEN V_RET := 1;
ELSIF LTRIM(RTRIM(TO_CHAR(P_DATE,'DAY'))) = 'TUESDAY' AND I.SC_TUESDAY = 0 THEN V_RET := 1;
ELSIF LTRIM(RTRIM(TO_CHAR(P_DATE,'DAY'))) = 'WEDNESDAY' AND I.SC_WEDNESDAY = 0 THEN V_RET := 1;
ELSIF LTRIM(RTRIM(TO_CHAR(P_DATE,'DAY'))) = 'THURSDAY' AND I.SC_THURSDAY = 0 THEN V_RET := 1;
ELSIF LTRIM(RTRIM(TO_CHAR(P_DATE,'DAY'))) = 'FRIDAY' AND I.SC_FRIDAY = 0 THEN V_RET := 1;
ELSE V_RET := 0;
IF V_RET = 0 THEN
SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_RET
FROM MRP_SGS_SCHDUL_CLNDR_DTLS
WHERE BRN_NO = P_BRN_NO AND P_DATE BETWEEN FRM_DATE AND TO_DATE AND ROWNUM<=1;
RETURN V_RET;
END FNC_DAY_OFF;

v_cnt number:= 0;
v_typ number:= 0;
Select COUNT(*) into v_cnt
From MRP_CRP_ITEMS_CATEGORY
Where CMP_NO = P_CMP
AND BRN_NO = P_BRN
AND ITEM_CODE = P_Item_code
AND CTGR IN(0,1,2,5,10,11)
AND ROWNUM <= 1;
If NVL(v_cnt,0) >= 1 THEN
return 1;
else
return 0;
End FNC_GET_ITEM_TYPE;

FUNCTION FNC_GET_STG_DSC (P_CMP S_CMPNY.CMP_NO%TYPE, P_BRN S_BRN.BRN_NO%TYPE,P_LANG LANG_DEF.LANG_NO%TYPE,P_SHF MRP_SGS_SHOPS_FLOOR_CODING.SHF_CODE%TYPE, P_LN MRP_SGS_LINES_CODING.LN_CODE%TYPE,P_STG IN MRP_SGS_STAGES_CODING.STG_CODE%TYPE ) RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
R_DESC MRP_SGS_STAGES_DEFINITION.STG_NAME_A%TYPE;
SELECT DECODE(P_LANG,1,STG_NAME_A,NVL(STG_NAME_F,STG_NAME_A) )
FROM MRP_SGS_STAGES_CODING A , MRP_SGS_STAGES_DEFINITION B
WHERE A.CMP_NO = P_CMP
AND A.BRN_NO = P_BRN
AND B.CMP_NO = A.CMP_NO
AND B.BRN_NO = A.BRN_NO
AND B.STG_CODE = A.STG_CODE
AND DECODE(P_SHF,NULL,'1',A.SHF_CODE) = DECODE(P_SHF,NULL,'1',P_SHF)
AND DECODE(P_LN,NULL,'1',A.LN_CODE) = DECODE(P_LN,NULL,'1',P_LN)
AND A.STG_CODE = P_STG;
RETURN (R_DESC);
END FNC_GET_STG_DSC;

FUNCTION FNC_GET_RCE_DSC (P_CMP S_CMPNY.CMP_NO%TYPE, P_BRN S_BRN.BRN_NO%TYPE,P_LANG LANG_DEF.LANG_NO%TYPE,P_SHF MRP_SGS_SHOPS_FLOOR_CODING.SHF_CODE%TYPE, P_LN MRP_SGS_LINES_CODING.LN_CODE%TYPE,P_STG IN MRP_SGS_STAGES_CODING.STG_CODE%TYPE DEFAULT NULL ,P_JOB IN MRP_CRP_OPERATIONS_JOBS.JOB_CODE%TYPE DEFAULT NULL,P_RCE_SER MRP_CRP_RESOURCES.RCE_SER%TYPE) RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
R_DESC MRP_CRP_RESOURCES.RCE_ADES%TYPE;
DECODE(P_LANG,1,M.RCE_ADES,NVL(M.RCE_EDES,M.RCE_ADES) )
FROM MRP_CRP_RESOURCES M, MRP_CRP_RESOURCES_LOC D
WHERE M.CMP_NO = P_CMP
AND M.BRN_NO = P_BRN
AND M.RCE_SER = P_RCE_SER
AND M.CMP_NO = D.CMP_NO
AND M.RCE_SER = D.RCE_SER
AND DECODE(P_SHF,NULL,'-1',M.SHF_CODE) = DECODE(P_SHF,NULL,'-1',P_SHF)
AND DECODE(P_LN ,NULL,'-1',D.LN_CODE) = DECODE(P_LN,NULL ,'-1',P_LN)
AND DECODE(P_STG,NULL,'-1',D.STG_CODE) = DECODE(P_STG,NULL,'-1',P_STG)
AND DECODE(P_JOB,NULL,'-1',D.JOB_CODE) = DECODE(P_JOB,NULL,'-1',P_JOB);
END FNC_GET_RCE_DSC;

PROCEDURE PRC_GET_MAT_BOM (P_CMP S_CMPNY.CMP_NO%TYPE ,
P_BRN S_BRN.BRN_NO%TYPE ,
P_LANG LANG_DEF.LANG_NO%TYPE ,
P_ITEM MRP_CRP_ITEMS_DETAILS.ITEM_CODE%TYPE ,
PO_BOM_CD OUT MRP_BOM_BOM_MSTR.BOM_CODE%TYPE ,
PO_BOM_NM OUT MRP_BOM_BOM_MSTR.BOM_NAME_A%TYPE ,
P_MSG_NO OUT NUMBER
SELECT BOM_CODE , DECODE(P_LANG,1,BOM_NAME_A,NVL(BOM_NAME_F,BOM_NAME_A) ) BOM_NAME
INTO PO_BOM_CD , PO_BOM_NM
FROM MRP_CRP_ITEMS_DETAILS ITM , MRP_BOM_BOM_MSTR MST
ITM.CMP_NO = MST.CMP_NO
AND ITM.BRN_NO = MST.BRN_NO
AND ITM.ITEM_CODE = MST.ITEM_CODE
AND MST.P_CNTU = 0
AND MST.IND_DEFAULT= 0
AND ITM.CMP_NO = P_CMP
AND ITM.BRN_NO = P_BRN
AND ITM.ITEM_CODE = P_ITEM
AND ROWNUM = 1;
P_MSG_NO :=2313;---- ?????? ?????? ???? ?????? ????? ?????? ??? @ ???? ????? ?? ???? ??????? ..........
----The BOM Material No @ Doesnt Defiend In Manufacuring System
PRC_GET_MAT_BOM;

FUNCTION FNC_GET_ACTV_YER(P_CMP_NO NUMBER, P_BRN_NO NUMBER) RETURN NUMBER IS
V_YER_CODE NUMBER;
SELECT YER_CODE INTO V_YER_CODE
FROM MRP_YEAR
WHERE CMP_NO = P_CMP_NO AND BRN_NO = P_BRN_NO AND P_CLS = 0 AND P_CNTU = 0 AND ROWNUM<=1;
IF NVL(V_YER_CODE,0) > 0 THEN
RETURN V_YER_CODE;
ELSE RETURN 0;
--->
P_UNIT_CODE OUT VARCHAR2) IS
IF P_ITM_CODE IS NOT NULL THEN
SELECT INV_I_CODE, UNIT_CODE
INTO P_INV_I_CODE, P_UNIT_CODE
WHERE ITEM_CODE = P_ITM_CODE
Raise_application_error(-20101, SQLCODE || ' : ' || SQLERRM);
END PRC_GET_ITEM_INV_DATA;
FUNCTION PRC_GET_ITEM_CODE (P_INV_I_CODE IN VARCHAR2, P_UNIT_CODE IN VARCHAR2) RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
V_ITM_CODE VARCHAR2(30);
IF P_INV_I_CODE IS NOT NULL AND P_UNIT_CODE IS NOT NULL THEN
SELECT ITEM_CODE
INTO V_ITM_CODE
WHERE INV_I_CODE = P_INV_I_CODE
AND UNIT_CODE = P_UNIT_CODE
AND ROWNUM <=1;
RETURN(V_ITM_CODE);
EPTION
Raise_application_error(-20101, 'ERR WHEN PRC_GET_ITEM_CODE :' || SQLERRM);
END PRC_GET_ITEM_CODE;

FUNCTION GET_ITM_QTY (P_ITM_CODE VARCHAR2) RETURN NUMBER IS
GNR_PKG.PRC_GET_ITEM_INV_DATA ( P_ITM_CODE => P_ITM_CODE

WHERE I_CODE = V_INV_I_CODE
AND ITM_UNT= V_UNIT_CODE
RETURN(V_QTY);
Raise_appl
ication_error(-20101, 'ERR WHEN GET_ITM_QTY' || ' : ' || SQLERRM);
END GET_ITM_QTY;

FUNCTION FNC_TRNS_USED(P_CMP_NO IN NUMBER, P_BRN_NO IN NUMBER, P_TRN_TYPE IN NUMBER, P_TRN_SEQ IN NUMBER) RETURN NUMBER IS
V_USED NUMBER:= 0;
v_REQ_LVL NUMBER:= nvl(GNR_PKG.FNC_GET_PRMTR_VAL(P_CMP =>P_CMP_NO, P_BRN => P_BRN_NO, P_FLD => 'MRP_SFC_MRQ_LVL'),0);
IF P_TRN_TYPE = 2 THEN-- RECEIVED TRANSACTIONS.
IF v_REQ_LVL = 0 THEN -- WORK ORDER LEVEL
SELECT 1 INTO V_USED
FROM MRP_SFC_MATERIALS_RECEIVE_MSTR m
WHERE m.MRC_SQ = P_TRN_SEQ
AND m.CMP_NO = P_CMP_NO
AND m.BRN_NO = P_BRN_NO
AND m.WORK_ORDER IS NOT NULL
AND EXISTS
( SELECT 1 FROM MRP_SFC_WIP_MASTER
AND WORK_ORDER = m.WORK_ORDER
AND ROWNUM<=1 )
AND rownum<=1;
ELSIF v_REQ_LVL = 1 tHEN --Product Level
FROM MRP_SFC_MATERIALS_RECEIVE_MSTR m,
MRP_SFC_MATERIALS_REQUEST_MSTR mr
AND m.CMP_NO = mr.CMP_NO
AND m.BRN_NO = mr.BRN_NO
AND M.MR_SQ = MR.MR_SQ
AND MR.WORK_ORDER IS NOT NULL
AND M.WORK_ORDER = MR.WORK_ORDER
AND MR.ITEM_CODE IS NOT NULL
( SELECT 1 FROM MRP_SFC_WIP_MASTER_YIELD
AND WORK_ORDER = mr.WORK_ORDER
AND item_code = MR.ITEM_CODE
ELSIF v_REQ_LVL = 2 THEN -- BAtch Level
AND M.WOR
K_ORDER = MR.WORK_ORDER
AND batch_no = mr.BATCH_NO
--#--------------------------------------------------------------------------------#--
ELSIF P_TRN_TYPE = 3 THEN-- REQUEST TRANSACTIONS.
FROM MRP_SFC_MATERIALS_REQUEST_MSTR m
WHERE m.MR_SQ = P_TRN_SEQ
( SELECT 1 FROM MRP_SFC_MATERIALS_RECEIVE_MSTR
WHERE MR_SQ = m.MR_SQ
AND ROWNUM<=1
RETURN V_USED;
END FNC_TRNS_USED;
/* This Function check That the date in open active year and period return 1 if its in open active year and period */
FUNCTION FNC_ITS_OPN_ACTV_YR ( P_CMP S_CMPNY.CMP_NO%TYPE, P_BRN S_BRN.BRN_NO%TYPE,P_DATE DATE,PO_MSGNO OUT NUMBER ) RETURN NUMBER
VAL NUMBER:=0;
FROM MRP_YEAR M, MRP_SGS_PERIOD_COSTONG D
AND M.YER_CODE = D.YER_CODE
AND M.CMP_NO = P_CMP
AND M.P_CLS = 0 -- OPEN YEAR
AND M.P_CNTU = 0 --ACTIV YEAR
AND D.P_CLS = 0 --OPEN PERIOD
AND D.P_CNTU = 0 --ACTV PERIOD
AND P_DATE BETWEEN D.DATE_F AND D.DATE_T
AND ROWNUM =1;
IF VAL=1 THEN
PO_MSGNO := NULL;
ELSE PO_MSGNO :=419;--
--The Date Deos not Belong to the active Period
PO_MSGNO :=419;
END FNC_ITS_OPN_ACTV_YR ;

/*This Function return false if the work order IS 3 Completed ,4 Close ,5 Inactive else return true */
FUNCTION FNC_WO_STS (P_CMP S_CMPNY.CMP_NO%TYPE, P_BRN S_BRN.BRN_NO%TYPE, P_SHF MRP_SGS_SHOPS_FLOOR_CODING.SHF_CODE%TYPE,P_WO MRP_MPS_WORK_OR
DR_MSTR.WORK_ORDER%TYPE ,P_TYP NUMBER DEFAULT NULL ,PO_MSGNO OUT NUMBER )RETURN BOOLEAN --P_TYP TO CHECK IF WORK ORDER IS WIP NOT COLSE OR COMPLATE OR INACTIVE
VSTS NUMBER(1);
IF P_WO IS NOT NULL THEN
SELECT IND_STATUS
INTO VSTS
FROM MRP_MPS_WORK_ORDR_MSTR
AND SHF_CODE =DECODE( P_SHF ,NULL,SHF_CODE,P_SHF)
AND WORK_ORDER = P_WO ;
IF P_TYP IS NULL THEN
IF VSTS IN (3,4,5) THEN --'W_O_S' -- 0 Released ,1 Approved ,2 WIP ,3 Completed ,4 Close ,5 Inactive
PO_MSGNO :=2315;--
--The Work Order No @1 It Was Closed Or Complate So Ask The Administrator This Prosses Dont Allowed
ELSE RETURN TRUE;
IF VSTS IN (4,5) THEN
PO_MSGNO :=2315;
THEN PO_MSGNO :=2315;
END FNC_WO_STS;
FUNCTION FNC_CHK_OBJ_FOUND (P_OBJ USER_OBJECTS.OBJECT_NAME%TYPE, P_TYP USER_OBJECTS.OBJECT_TYPE%TYPE) RETURN BOOLEAN
VFOUND NUMBER (1);
FROM USER_OBJECTS
WHERE OBJECT_TYPE = P_TYP AND OBJECT_NAME = P_OBJ AND ROWNUM <= 1;
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
THEN RETURN TRUE;
ELSE RETURN FALSE;
WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN RETURN FALSE;
WHEN OTHERS THEN raise_application_error ( -20009, 'MPS_PKG.OBJECTFOUND' || SUBSTR (SQLERRM, 1, 60)); RETURN FALSE;
END FNC_CHK_OBJ_FOUND;
FUNCTION FNC_CHK_MOV_DLT (P_TAB VARCHAR2,P_WHR VARCHAR2,P_WHR2 VARCHAR2, P_ERR_TYP OUT NUMBER) RETURN NUMBER
IS --17-4-2010
VCNT NUMBER;
VCNT1 NUMBER;
EXECUTE IMMEDIATE 'SELECT COUNT (*) FROM ' || P_TAB || ' WHERE ' || P_WHR INTO VCNT;
IF VCNT > 0 THEN
EXECUTE IMMEDIATE 'SELECT COUNT (*) FROM ' || P_TAB || ' WHERE ' || P_WHR2 INTO VCNT1;
IF VCNT1 > 0 THEN
P_ERR_TYP := 1; --There Is dtl Data but there Qty =0
RETURN 0; -- NOT DONE
P_ERR_TYP := 0; -- NO ERROR
RETURN 1; -- Done Successfully
P_ERR_TYP := 1; -- ERROR :There Is No Dtl Data
WHEN
OTHERS THEN
P_ERR_TYP := 1; -- ERROR
RETURN 9;
END FNC_CHK_MOV_DLT;
FUNCTION FNC_CHK_ALL_OBJ_FOUND(P_TYP NUMBER) RETURN BOOLEAN
IF P_TYP = 2 AND FNC_CHK_OBJ_FOUND ('MRP_TRG_REC_SET_ITEM_MOV', 'TRIGGER') THEN RETURN TRUE;
ELSIF P_TYP = 3 AND FNC_CHK_OBJ_FOUND ('MRP_TRG_WIP_SET_ITM_MOV' , 'TRIGGER') THEN RETURN TRUE;
ELSIF P_TYP = 4 AND FNC_CHK_OBJ_FOUND ('MRP_TRG_TRS_SET_ITEM_MOV', 'TRIGGER') THEN RETURN TRUE;
ELSIF P_TYP = 6 AND FNC_CHK_OBJ_FOUND ('MRP_TRG_ADJ_SET_ITEM_MOV', 'TRIGGER') THEN RETURN TRUE;
ELSIF P_TYP IN (1,5, 7,8, 9,10) THEN RETURN TRUE;
END FNC_CHK_ALL_OBJ_FOUND;

ELSIF P_TYP =8 THEN
ELSIF P_TYP =9 AND FNC_CHK_MOV_DLT (U
PPER ('MRP_SFC_SP_DTLS'), ' CMP_NO = ' || P_CMP || ' AND BRN_NO = ' || P_BRN || ' AND SP_SQ = ' || P_TRNNO, ' CMP_NO = ' || P_CMP || ' AND BRN_NO = ' || P_BRN || ' AND SP_SQ = ' || P_TRNNO || ' AND QTY =0 ', P_ERR) = 1 THEN
ELSIF P_TYP =10 AND FNC_CHK_MOV_DLT ( UPPER ('MRP_SFC_RE_DTLS'), ' CMP_NO = ' || P_CMP || ' AND BRN_NO = ' || P_BRN || ' AND RE_SQ = ' || P_TRNNO, ' CMP_NO = ' || P_CMP || ' A
ND BRN_NO = ' || P_BRN || ' AND RE_SQ = ' || P_TRNNO || ' AND QTY =0 ',P_ERR) = 1

FUNCTION FNC_CHK_WH_TYP (P_CMP S_CMPNY.CMP_NO%TYPE, P_BRN S_BRN.BRN_NO%TYPE, P_TYP NUMBER)
IF P_TYP = 1
SELECT DISTINCT 1
FROM MRP_CRP_WAREHOUSES_DTLS
WHERE WH_POSITION IN (0, 2) --Inside FRONT
AND ROWNUM <= 1
THEN raise_application_error (-20009, 'MPS_PKG. chk_front_wh1' || SQLERRM);
ELSIF P_TYP = 2
FROM mrp_crp_warehouses_dtls
WHERE wh_position IN (2, 1) --Inside BACK
AND cmp_no = P_CMP --23-5-2010
AND brn_no = P_BRN; --23-5-2010
raise_application_error (-20009,
'MPS_PKG. chk_front_wh2' || SQLERRM);
ELSIF P_TYP = 3
WHERE wh_position IN (2, 1, 0) --Inside BACK front
AND cmp_no = P_CMP
AND brn_no = P_BRN;
raise_applic
ation_error (-20009,
'MPS_PKG. chk_front_wh3' || SQLERRM);
END FNC_CHK_WH_TYP;

app_usr = NULL,

ork order is wip you can approve or diapproce --the request else you can not

PROCEDURE update_stoping_in_card (procapp_unapp NUMBER,cmp NUMBER, brn NUMBER, shf NUMBER, stopno NUMBER)
CURSOR stopwo_ln_stg_job
SELECT work_order,
job_co
FROM mrp_crp_bd_lnstgop
WHERE cmp_no = cmp
AND brn_no = brn
AND shf_code = shf
AND bd_trx_no = stopno; -- To Get Wo
CURSOR stophourbystgjob (
vwork_order mrp_crp_bd_lnstgop.work_order%TYPE,
vln_code mrp_crp_bd_lnstgop.ln_code%TYPE,
vstg mrp_crp_bd_lnstgop.stg_code%TYPE,
vjob mrp_crp_bd_lnstgop.job_code%TYPE,
groupby NUMBER)
SELECT SUM (tot) totsum,
DECODE (groupby, 0, m.stg_code, m.job_code),
d.bd_rec_fdate,
d.bd_rec_tdate,
d.bd_rec_ftime,
d.bd_rec_ttime
FROM mrp_crp_bd_rcrd d, mrp_crp_bd_lnstgop m
WHERE m.cmp_no = cmp
AND m.brn_no = brn
AND m.shf_code = shf
AND m.bd_trx_no = stopno
AND m.ln_code = vln_code
AND m.work_order = vwork_order
AND DECODE (groupby, 0, m.stg_code, 1) =
DECODE (groupby, 0, vstg, 1)
AND DECODE (groupby, 1, m.job_code, 1) =
DECODE (groupby, 1, vjob, 1)
AND m.bd_trx_no = d.bd_trx_no
AND m.rec_ser = d.rec_ser
GROUP BY DECODE (groupby, 0, m.stg_code, m.job_code),
d.bd_rec_ttime;
CURSOR opreationhourbystgjob (
vstg mrp_sfc_wip_master_stg.stg_code%TYPE,
vjob mrp_sfc_wip_master_job.job_code%TYPE,
vrec_fdate mrp_crp_bd_rcrd.bd_rec_fdate%TYPE,
vrec_tdate mrp_crp_bd_rcrd.bd_rec_tdate%TYPE,
vrec_ftime mrp_crp_bd_rcrd.bd_rec_ftime%TYPE,
vrec_ttime mrp_crp_bd_rcrd.bd_rec_ttime%TYPE)
SELECT m.sf_seq
FROM mrp_sfc_wip_master m
AND m.fdate <= vrec_fdate
AND m.tdate >= vrec_tdate
AND TO_CHAR (m.ftime, 'HH24:MI') <=
TO_CHAR (vrec_ftime, 'HH24:MI')
AND TO_CHAR (m.ttime, 'HH24:MI') >=
TO_CHAR (vrec_ttime, 'HH24:MI');
FOR w IN stopwo_ln_stg_job
LOOP -
- Get Wo
FOR i IN stophourbystgjob (w.work_order,
w.ln_code,
w.stg_code,
w.job_code,
-- If ProcApp_Unapp =0 Then --??????
FOR j IN opreationhourbystgjob (w.work_order,
i.bd_rec_fdate,
i.bd_rec_tdate,
i.bd_rec_ftime,
i.bd_rec_ttime)
UPDATE mrp_sfc_wip_master_stg stg
SET stg_bd =
DECODE (procapp_unapp,
0, NVL (stg_bd, 0) + i.totsum,
1, NVL (stg_bd, 0) - i.totsum)
AND work_order = w.work_order
AND ln_code = w.ln_code
AND stg_code = w.stg_code
AND sf_seq = j.sf_seq;
UPDATE mrp_sfc_wip_master_job
SET job_bd =
0, NVL (job_bd, 0) + i.totsum,
1, NVL (job_bd, 0) - i.totsum)
AND job_code = w.job_code

/* This Function To Get The Cost Value For Items FORM mrp_crp_items_details B y Cost type 1 avrage cost 2--lastproduct cost 3 standers cost 4 --begin cost*/
FUNCTION FNC_GET_ITM_CST ( P_CMP_NO S_CMPNY.CMP_NO%TYPE , P_BRN_NO S_BRN.BRN_NO%TYPE , P_LANG LANG_DEF.LANG_NO%TYPE , P_ITEM_CODE MRP_CRP_ITEMS_DETAILS.ITEM_CODE%TYPE , P_CST_TYP NUMBER /* 1 avrage cost 2--lastproduct cost 3 standers cost 4 --begin cost 5- COST PERCENTAGE 6- INDERTCT COST*/ ) RETURN NUMBER
IS V_CST NUMBER;
SELECT DECODE (P_CST_TYP ,1, CST_AVG, 2, CST_LAST_PROD,3, CST_STANDR, 4, CST_BEGIN,5, CST_PER , 6, CST_INDRCT )
INTO V_CST
AND ITEM_CODE = P_ITEM_CODE
RETURN ( V_CST);
/*This Function return item Quantiy on hand by specific warehouse if it is specify or all warehouses if not*/
FUNCTION MRP_FUNC_GET_ITEM_QTYHND ( P_ITEM MRP_CRP_ITEMS_DETAILS.ITEM_CODE%TYPE ,
V_SIGN VARCHAR2 DEFAULT NULL )
From MRP_SFC_WHM_ITEMS_MOVE
Where cmp_no = :V_CMP
And brn_no = :V_BRN
And ITEM_CODE = :P_ITEM
And WH_CODE = NVL(:V_WH_CODE,WH_CODE) '
|| V_SIGN
USING V_CMP, V_BRN, P_ITEM, V_WH_CODE;
RETURN (V_QTY);
v_tbl_nm Varchar2(60):= null;
v_seqm_fld Varchar2(60):= null;
v_seqd_fld Varchar2(60):= null;
v_item_fld Varchar2(60):= null;
v_qty_fld Varchar2(60):= null;
v_weight_fld Varchar2(60):= null;
V_WEIGHT NUMBER;
Select Decode(P_TRANS_TYPE,1,'MRP_SFC_MATERIALS_TRANSMT_DTLS',
2,'MRP_SFC_MATERIALS_RECEIVE_DTLS',
3,'MRP_SFC_MATERIALS_TRANSMT_DTLS',
4,'MRP_SFC_WIP_MASTER_SCRAP',
6,'MRP_SFC_WIP_MASTER_YIELD',
7,'MRP_SFC_WIP_MAT_CONSUMP',
31,'MRP_SFC_MATERIALS_TRANSMT_DTLS',
32,'MRP_SFC_MATERIALS_TRANSMT_DTLS'
Decode(P_TRANS_TYPE,1,'MT_SQ',
2,'MRC_SQ',
3,'MT_SQ',
4,'SF_SEQ',
6,'SF_SEQ',
7,'SF_SEQ',
31,'MT_SQ',
32,'MT_SQ'
) seqm,
Decode(P_TRANS_TYPE,1,'MT_D_SQ',
2,'MRC_D_SQ',
3,'MT_D_SQ',
4,'SCAP_SEQ',
6,'YIELD_SEQ',
7,'CON_SEQ',
31,'MT_D_SQ',
32,'MT_D_SQ'
)seqd,
Decode(P_TRANS_TYPE,1,'ITEM_CODE',
2,'ITEM_CODE',
3,'ITEM_CODE',
4,'ITEM_SCRAP',
6,'ITEM_CODE',
7,'ITEM_CODE',
31,'ITEM_CODE',
32,'ITEM_CODE'
)item_code,
Decode(P_TRANS_TYPE,1,'QTY',
2,'QTY',
3,'QTY',
4,'QTY',
6,'QTY',
7,'TOT_QTY',
31,'QTY',
32,'QTY'
)qty,
Decode(P_TRANS_TYPE,1,'QTY_WEIGHT',
2,'QTY_WEIGHT',
3,'QTY_WEIGHT',
4,'QTY_WEIGHT',
6,'QTY_WEIGHT',
7,'TOT_QTY_WEIGHT',
31,'QTY_WEIGHT',
32,'QTY_WEIGHT'
)weight
Into v_tbl_nm, v_seqm_fld, v_seqd_fld,v_item_fld, v_qty_fld,v_weight_fld
From Dual;
If v_tbl_nm is not Null Then
EXECUTE IMMEDIATE ' Select NVL(SUM(NVL('||v_weight_fld||',0)),0)
From '||v_tbl_nm||'
Where cmp_no = :P_CMP
And brn_no = :P_BRN
and '||v_seqm_fld||' = :P_TRANSM_SEQ
and '||v_seqd_fld||' = :P_TRANSD_SEQ
and '||v_item_fld||' = :P_ITEM_CODE
and '||v_qty_fld ||' = :P_QTY '
INTO V_WEIGHT
USING P_CMP, P_BRN, P_TRANSM_SEQ,P_TRANSD_SEQ,P_ITEM_CODE,P_QTY;
IF P_TRANS_TYPE MOD 2 = 0 THEN
RETURN V_WEIGHT;
RETURN V_WEIGHT * -1;
end If;
END FNC_GET_WEIGHT_ITEM_TRANS;

FUNCTION MRP_PROC_SET_ITEM_MOVE ( P_CMP S_CMPNY.CMP_NO%TYPE,
V_QTY NUMBER,
V_CST NUMBER,

V_TRANS_TYPE NUMBER,

V_PRD_CODE NUMBER,
V_FT DATE,
V_TT DATE,
V_BOM_CODE VARCHAR2,
V_PRD_TYPE NUMBER ,
VITEM_GRAND VARCHAR2 DEFAULT NULL,
)RETURN NUMBER
V_SIZE NUMBER:=1;
V_QTY_WEIGHT NUMBER;
IF FNC_CHK_MVQTY_VLD ( P_CMP , P_BRN , V_ITEM_CODE , V_WH_CODE , V_QTY , V_WORK_ORDER, V_TRANS_TYPE ,VMSG_NO ) THEN
V_QTY_WEIGHT := FNC_GET_WEIGHT_ITEM_TRANS(P_CMP ,
P_BRN ,
V_ITEM_CODE ,
V_QTY ,
V_TRANSM_SEQ,
V_TRANSD_SEQ,
V_TRANS_TYPE
NSERT INTO MRP_SFC_WHM_ITEMS_MOVE (CMP_NO, BRN_NO,
--IM_SQ,
IM_DATE,
CST, WH_CODE, --Warehouse
TRANS_DATE, --Transaction Date
TRANS_TYPE, --Transaction Type
TRANS_CODE, --Transaction Code
TRANSM_SEQ, --Transaction Mastre Seq
TRANSD_SEQ, --Transcation Details Seq
MATERIAL_RECIVE,
MATERIAL_TRANSMIT,
MATERIAL_EXPORT,
MATERIAL_ADJ,
MATERIAL_YIELD,
MATERIAL_SCRAP,
MATERIAL_CONS,
ITEM_GRAND, G_SIZE,
G_QTY, WORK_ORDER,
SHIFT_CODE, SHF_CODE, LN_CODE, STG_CODE,
JOB_CODE, RCE_SER, ITEM_YIELD,
ITEM_SCRAP, SR_CODE, YER_CODE, PERIOD_CODE,
F_TIME, T_TIME, BOM_CODE, PRD_TYPE,
QTY_WEIGHT
VALUES (P_CMP , P_BRN, SYSDATE, V_ITEM_CODE,
DECODE (MOD (V_TRANS_TYPE, 2), 0, V_QTY, (DECODE (SIGN (V_QTY), -1, (-1 * V_QTY), V_QTY)) * -1 ),
NVL (V_CST, 0), V_WH_CODE, V_TRANS_DATE,
V_TRANS_TYPE, V_TRANS_CODE, V_TRANSM_SEQ,
DECODE (V_TRANS_TYPE, 2, V_TRANSD_SEQ, NULL),
-- MATERIAL_RECIVE
DECODE (V_TRANS_TYPE, 1, V_TRANSD_SEQ, --- MATERIAL_TRANSMIT
3, V_TRANSD_SEQ, 31, V_TRANSD_SEQ,
32, V_TRANSD_SEQ, NULL ),
NULL, DECODE (V_TRANS_TYPE, 51, V_TRANSD_SEQ, 52, V_TRANSD_SEQ, NULL ),
DECODE (V_TRANS_TYPE, 6, V_TRANSD_SEQ, NULL),
DECODE (V_TRANS_TYPE, 4, V_TRANSD_SEQ, NULL),
DECODE (V_TRANS_TYPE, 7, V_TRANSD_SEQ, NULL),
VITEM_GRAND , V_SIZE, NVL (V_QTY, 0) * NVL (V_SIZE, 0), V_WORK_ORDER,
V_SHIFT_CODE, V_SHF_CODE, V_LN_CODE, V_STG_CODE, V_JOB_CODE, V_RCE_SER, V_ITEM_YIELD,
V_ITEM_SCRAP, V_SR_CODE, V_YER_CODE, V_PRD_CODE, V_FT, V_TT, V_BOM_CODE, V_PRD_TYPE ,NVL(V_QTY_WEIGHT,0) );
IF SQL%FOUND THEN
P_MSG_NO := NULL;
IF ( GNR_PKG.FNC_GET_PRMTR_VAL(P_CMP, P_BRN, 'MRP_SFC_USE_ITEM_PART') =1 AND V_TRANS_TYPE IN (6,4,5) ) Then
SET APP_FLG = 1
MRP_ITEM_ATTACH_MOVES.CMP_NO = P_CMP AND
MRP_ITEM_ATTACH_MOVES.BRN_NO = P_BRN AND
P_ITEM_ATTACH_MOVES.ITEM_CODE = V_ITEM_CODE AND
MRP_ITEM_ATTACH_MOVES.TRANSM_NO =V_TRANSM_SEQ AND
MRP_ITEM_ATTACH_MOVES.TRANSD_NO = V_TRANSD_SEQ AND
MRP_ITEM_ATTACH_MOVES.WH_CODE = V_WH_CODE AND
MRP_ITEM_ATTACH_MOVES.BOM_CODE = V_BOM_CODE AND
MRP_ITEM_ATTACH_MOVES.STG_CODE = V_STG_CODE AND
MRP_ITEM_ATTACH_MOVES.LN_CODE = V_LN_CODE AND
MRP_ITEM_ATTACH_MOVES.SHF_CODE = V_SHF_CODE AND
MRP_ITEM_ATTACH_MOVES.JOB_CODE = V_JOB_CODE AND
MRP_ITEM_ATTACH_MOVES.WORK_ORDER = V_WORK_ORDER AND
NVL(MRP_ITEM_ATTACH_MOVES.APP_FLG,0) = 0 AND
P_MSG_NO := 2323;--Error in inserting Inventory Movement
P_MSG_NO := VMSG_NO;

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
This procedure return year and period of passed date by condition that year and period is open and active
PROCEDURE FNC_GET_PRD_YR (P_CMP S_CMPNY.CMP_NO%TYPE ,P_BRN S_BRN.BRN_NO%TYPE,P_DATE DATE , PO_YR OUT MRP_YEAR.YER_CODE%TYPE, PO_PRD OUT MRP_SGS_PERIOD_COSTONG.PERIOD_CODE%TYPE ,PO_MSG_NO OUT NUMBER)
SELECT M.YER_CODE, D.PERIOD_CODE
INTO PO_YR,PO_PRD
FROM MRP_SGS_PERIOD_COSTONG D,MRP_YEAR M ---
yer table and period table
AND D.DATE_T >= P_DATE
AND D.DATE_F <= P_DATE
AND M.CMP_NO =P_CMP
AND M.BRN_NO =P_BRN
AND M.P_CLS = 0 -- 0 open 1 close
AND M.P_CNTU = 0 -- 0 acitve 1 unactive
AND D.P_CLS
= 0 -- 0 open 1 close
AND D.P_CNTU = 0 -- 0 acitve 1 unactive
AND TO_CHAR (P_DATE, 'YYYY') = M.YER_CODE ;
WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
PO_YR := NULL;
PO_PRD := NULL;
PO_MSG_NO := 2316; --
--Entry Date Dont have Year Or Period Active Or Open Or It not in Production Periods So Make sure From Production Period
PO_MSG_NO := 2316;
END FNC_GET_PRD_YR;
FUNCTION FNC_CHK_VDATE(P_CMP S_CMPNY.CMP_NO%TYPE ,P_BRN S_BRN.BRN_NO%TYPE,P_DATE DATE , PO_MSG_NO OUT NUMBER) RETURN NUMBER IS
VFOND NUMBER := 0 ;
INTO VFOND

This procedure for the Reproducing Products Scraps to the Its Assemblyes .
Update The Records of Trans Type = 4 As following

PROCEDURE UPDATE_MOVE(VCMP_NO S_BRN.CMP_NO%TYPE, VBRN_NO S_BRN.BRN_NO%TYPE, PROCESS NUMBER , VSP_SQ MRP_SFC_SP_MSTR.SP_SQ%TYPE , VIM_SQ MRP_SFC_WHM_ITEMS_MOVE.IM_SQ%TYPE DEFAULT NULL , VTRANSM_SEQ MRP_SFC_WHM_ITEMS_MOVE.TRANSM_SEQ%TYPE DEFAULT NULL ,
VTRANSD_SEQ MRP_SFC_WHM_ITEMS_MOVE.TRANSD_SEQ%TYPE DEFAULT NULL , VSTS MRP_SFC_WHM_ITEMS_MOVE.SP_STS%TYPE DEFAULT NULL ) IS
IF PROCESS =1 THEN -- IN INSERT TO UPDATE ALL TRANSATION RELATED WITH DETAILS
SET SP_SQ = VSP_SQ ,
SP_STS = VSTS
WHERE IM_SQ = VIM_SQ
AND TRANSM_SEQ = VTRANSM_SEQ
AND TRANSD_SEQ = VTRANSD_SEQ
AND TRANS_TYPE = 4;
ELSIF PROCESS =0 THEN -- IN DELETE
IF VIM_SQ IS NOT NULL AND VTRANSM_SEQ IS NOT NULL AND VTRANSD_SEQ IS NOT NULL THEN --DETAILS
SET SP_SQ =NULL
, SP_STS =NULL
WHERE IM_SQ =VIM_SQ
AND TRANSM_SEQ=VTRANSM_SEQ
AND TRANSD_SEQ=VTRANSD_SEQ
AND TRANS_TYPE= 4
AND SP_SQ =VSP_SQ ;
ELSE --MASTR
ELSIF PROCESS =2 THEN -- IN APPROVE
SET SP_STS =VSTS
ELSIF PROCESS =3 THEN -- IN DISAPPROVE
WHERE CMP_NO =VCMP_NO
AND TRANS_TYPE = 4

FUNCTION FNC_CHK_MOV_CODE_DPLCT (P_STM VARCHAR2 ) RETURN BOOLEAN IS
FND NUMBER;
EXECUTE IMMEDIATE ''||P_STM||'' INTO FND;
IF FND >=1 THEN
VQTY MRP_MPS_WORK_ORDR_DTLS.QTY_REC%TYPE ;
J NUMBER:=1;
SCST NUMBER:=0;-- ITEM_COST SET TO PO_FCST
RCST NUMBER:=0; -- ROW COST
VCST_PER MRP_CRP_ITEMS_DETAILS.CST_PER%TYPE ;
VCST_INDRCT MRP_CRP_ITEMS_DETAILS.CST_INDRCT%TYPE ;
P_MRP_SFC_PR_INCCST_TYPE NUMBER := GNR_PKG.FNC_GET_PRMTR_VAL(P_CMP_NO,P_BRN_NO,'MRP_SFC_PR_INCCST_TYPE') ;
P_MRP_SFC_MRQ_LVL NUMBER := GNR_PKG.FNC_GET_PRMTR_VAL(P_CMP_NO,P_BRN_NO,'MRP_SFC_MRQ_LVL');
V_BOM_MAIN MRP_BOM_BOM_MSTR.BOM_CODE%TYPE;
VMAIN_QTY NUMBER:=0;
VBATCH_QTY NUMBER:=0;
V_FND NUMBER:= 0;
V_ITEM_ROW MRP_CRP_ITEMS_DETAILS.ITEM_CODE%TYPE ;
--=6 --
--=11 Material receved cost + INDERECT COST
--=10 Material receved cost + PER
IF P_MRP_SFC_PR_INCCST_TYPE IN (6,10,11) THEN
IF P_MRP_SFC_MRQ_LVL IN (1,2) THEN
SELECT QTY_REC
INTO VMAIN_QTY
FROM MRP_MPS_WORK_ORDR_MSTR M ,MRP_MPS_WORK_ORDR_DTLS D
WHERE M.WORK_ORDER = P_WORK_ORDER
AND ITEM_MAIN = ITEM_CODE
AND ITEM_CODE = P_ITEM_MAIN
AND ROWNUM<= 1 ;
VMAIN_QTY:= 0;
IF P_MRP_SFC_MRQ_LVL =1 --
/* WHEN THE P_ITEM_CODE IS SUB PRODUCT AN LEVEL OF ORDER ON FINAL PRODUCT */
IF P_ITEM_MAIN <> P_ITEM_CODE AND NVL(VMAIN_QTY,0) > 0 THEN -- THE P_ITEM_CODE IS SUB PRODUCT
SELECT QTY_REC /NVL(VMAIN_QTY,0)
INTO VQTY
AND D.ITEM_MAIN <> D.ITEM_CODE
AND D.ITEM_CODE = P_ITEM_CODE --
AND D.BOM_CODE = P_BOM_CODE --
AND ITEM_MAIN = P_ITEM_MAIN
PO_FCST:= 0;
ELSIF P_ITEM_MAIN = P_ITEM_CODE AND NVL(VMAIN_QTY,0) > 0 THEN
VQTY := VMAIN_QTY
END IF;--P_MRP_SFC_MRQ_LVL = 1
IF P_MRP_SFC_MRQ_LVL =2 --
SELECT QTY
INTO VBATCH_QTY
FROM MRP_MPS_BATCHES
WHERE BATCH_NO = P_BATCH_NO
AND WORK_ORDER = P_WORK_ORDER
VBATCH_QTY:= 0;
IF P_ITEM_MAIN <> P_ITEM_CODE AND NVL(VMAIN_QTY,0) > 0 AND NVL(VBATCH_QTY,0) > 0 THEN -- THE P_ITEM_CODE IS SUB PRODUCT
SELECT (QTY_REC/VMAIN_QTY)*VBATCH_QTY
FROM MRP_MPS_WORK_ORDR_MSTR M ,
MRP_MPS_WORK_ORDR_DTLS D
VQTY := VBATCH_QTY;
END IF;--P_MRP_SFC_MRQ_LVL=2
VQTY:= 1;
IF VQTY IS NULL THEN
PO_FCST := 0;
FP(J).CMP := P_CMP_NO;
FP(J).BRN := P_BRN_NO;
FP(J).WRKD := P_WORK_ORDER;
FP(J).FIN_ASS := P_ITEM_CODE;
FP(J).FIN_BOM := P_BOM_CODE;
FP(J).F_ASS := P_ITEM_CODE;
FP(J).F_BOM := P_BOM_CODE;
FP(J).R_QTY := VQTY;
FP(J).R_QTY := 1;
--BOM_PKG.CALC_SFC_REQ(FP,9,GNR_PKG.FNC_SET_TRMNLUSR ,NULL);
BOM_PKG_NEW.PRC_CALCULATE_ROW_ITEMS(FP, 1, GNR_PKG.FNC_SET_
TRMNLUSR, 1,NULL);
--FP.DELETE();
FOR I IN ( SELECT ITEM_ROW ,SUM(QTY_R+QTY_S) QTY_R
WHERE USR_NAME = GNR_PKG.FNC_SET_TRMNLUSR
AND ROW_TYP <> 1
AND BOM_CODE = P_BOM_CODE
GROUP BY ITEM_ROW
INTO V_FND
AND ITEM_CODE = I.ITEM_ROW
AND TRANS_TYPE IN (2,32, 52)
V_FND := 0;
IF NVL(V_FND ,0) = 0 THEN
SELECT MV.ITEM_CODE
INTO V_ITEM_ROW
FROM MRP_SFC_WHM_ITEMS_MOVE MV,
MRP_CRP_ITEMS_CLASS_OPTIONS CLS
WHERE MV.CMP_NO = P_CMP_NO
AND MV.BRN_NO = P_BRN_NO
AND MV.WORK_ORDER = P_WORK_ORDER
AND MV.TRANS_TYPE IN (2,32)
AND MV.CMP_NO = CLS.CMP_NO
AND MV.BRN_NO = CLS.BRN_NO
AND MV.ITEM_CODE = CLS.ITEM_OPTION
V_FND:= 1;
V_ITEM_ROW := NULL;
RCST:= FNC_GET_ITM_CST (P_CMP_NO, P_BRN_NO,1,I.ITEM_ROW,2)* NVL(I.QTY_R,0) ; -- get last producion cost;
if nvl(RCST,0) = 0 then
RCST:= FNC_GET_ITM_CST (P_CMP_NO, P_BRN_NO,1,I.ITEM_ROW,1)*NVL(I.QTY_R,0) ; -- get average cost;
end if;
SELECT NVL(AVG( NVL(CST,0)),0) * NVL(I.QTY_R,0)
INTO RCST
AND ITEM_CODE = DECODE(V_ITEM_ROW, NULL, I.ITEM_ROW , V_ITEM_ROW)
AND TRANS_TYPE IN (2,32);
RCST:= 0;
SCST := SCST + RCST ;
P_MRP_SFC_PR_INCCST_TYPE =6 THEN -- COST WILL BE DIRECT RAW MATERILAL CST OF P_ITEM_CODE
PO_FCST :=
SCST/VQTY;
P_MRP_SFC_PR_INCCST_TYPE =10 THEN --THEN COST WILL BE DIRECT RAW MATERILAL CST OF P_ITEM_CODE + PRECENT
--PARAMETER 5 IN THIS FUNCTION TO GET THE PERCENT OF P_ITEM_CODE IN ITEM_DETAILS TABLE.
VCST_PER:=MRPSFC_PKG.FNC_GET_ITM_CST(P_CMP_NO,P_BRN_NO,1,P_ITEM_CODE,5);
/100 ( *
COST = ROW COST + ((PERSENTAGE /100) * ROW COST)
PO_FCST:=PO_FCST +(PO_FCST*((VCST_PER)/100))
P_MRP_SFC_PR_INCCST_TYPE =11 THEN --COST WILL BE DIRECT RAW MATERILAL CST OF P_ITEM_CODE + INDIRECT COST
--PARAMETER 5 IN THIS FUNCTION TO GET THE INDIRECT OF P_ITEM_CODE IN ITEM_DETAILS TABLE.
VCST_INDRCT:=MRPSFC_PKG.FNC_GET_ITM_CST(P_CMP_NO,P_BRN_NO,1,P_ITEM_CODE,6);
PO_FCST:=PO_FCST +NVL(VCST_INDRCT,0)
PO_FCST :=0;
--SHOW_ALT('MRP',2113);--WHEN cost is material direct cost you must request by product or batch and receive all material before production otherwise the cost will be zero and the record will NOT save
RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20031,MRP_PKG.MRP_FUNC_GET_MRP_MSG('MRP',2113));
--RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
END PRC_SET_COST_BY_COSTTYPE;

PROCEDURE PRC_SET_CST (P_CMP_NO S_CMPNY.CMP_NO%TYPE ,P_BRN_NO S_BRN.BRN_NO%TYPE , P_LANG LANG_DEF.LANG_NO%TYPE , P_ITEM_MAIN MRP_MPS_WORK_ORDR_DTLS.ITEM_CODE%TYPE , P_WORK_ORDER MRP_MPS_WORK_ORDR_MSTR.WORK_ORDER%TYPE, P_ITEM_CODE MRP_MPS_WORK_ORDR_DTLS.ITEM_CODE%TYPE , P_BOM_CODE MRP_MPS_WORK_ORDR_DTLS.BOM_CODE%TYPE , P_BATCH_NO MRP_MPS_BATCHES.BATCH_NO%TYPE , PO_CST OUT NUMBER ,P_DATE DATE DEFAULT NULL )IS
V_COST NUMBER;
V_COST_TYP NUMBER :=GNR_PKG.FNC_GET_PRMTR_VAL(P_CMP_NO,P_BRN_NO,'MRP_SFC_PR_INCCST_TYPE');
V_COST_TYP_IN_ONX NUMBER :=GNR_PKG.FNC_GET_PRMTR_VAL(P_CMP_NO,P_BRN_NO,'MRP_SFC_PR_INVENTORY_POLICY');
V_COST_TYP_FOR_ITM NUMBER :=GNR_PKG.FNC_GET_PRMTR_VAL(P_CMP_NO,P_BRN_NO,'MRP_WTAVG_TYPE');
V_INV_I_CODE VARCHAR2(30) := NULL ;
V_UNIT_CODE VARCHAR2(10) := NULL ;
/*To Set Cost of products item in sfc card screen
1-AVG Cost
2-Last Production Cost
3-StANDard cost
4-BEGINning cost
5-Direct cost - NOT ACTIVE
6-Direct Materials cost
7-Estimate cost - NOT ACTIVE
8-Estimate Materials cost - NOT ACTIVE
9- Entrance Estimate cost
10-Direct Materials cost + Percentage
11-Direct Materials cost + Indirect cost
V_COST_TYP_IN_ONX : Stock Plicity in Onyx THIS SHOULD BE LIKE ONYX SYSTEM
1 = FIFO ;
2 = AVG ;
3 = LIFO ;
V_COST_TYP_FOR_ITM : THIS ALSO SHOULD BE LIKE ONYX SYSTEM
1 = By Item ;
2 = By Item and Warehouse
IF V_COST_TYP IN (2,3,4) THEN
PO_CST :=MRPSFC_PKG.FNC_GET_ITM_CST(P_CMP_NO , P_BRN_NO ,P_LANG , P_ITEM_CODE,V_COST_TYP);
ELSIF V_COST_TYP =1 THEN --Avrage Cost
GNR_PKG.PRC_GET_ITEM_INV_DATA(P_ITEM_CODE, V_INV_I_CODE, V_UNIT_CODE) ;
IF V_COST_TYP_IN_ONX =2 THEN --AVG
IF V_COST_TYP_FOR_ITM =1 THEN --BY ITEM
SELECT IAS_ITM_PKG.GET_GRAND_WTAVG(1,V_INV_I_CODE, NULL) INTO PO_CST FROM DUAL;
ELSIF V_COST_TYP_FOR_ITM =2 THEN--BY ITEM and warehouse
SELECT Get_Wcode_Revaluate_Cost (V_INV_I_CODE, P_DATE, NULL) INTO PO_CST FROM DUAL;
ELSE --FIFO or LIFO ( lifo is not using in onyx any more)
SELECT LAST_INCOMING_PRICE(1,V_INV_I_CODE, 1,NULL,1) INTO PO_CST FROM DUAL;
MRPSFC_PKG.PRC_SET_COST_BY_COSTTYPE (P_CMP_NO , P_BRN_NO , P_ITEM_MAIN , P_WORK_ORDER, P_ITEM_CODE , P_BOM_CODE , P_BATCH_NO , V_COST ) ;
SELECT DECODE( V_COST_TYP , 6,V_COST,
10,V_COST,
11,V_COST,
9 ,PO_CST)
INTO PO_CST
END PRC_SET_CST;
/*To Get Scrap Percentage */
FUNCTION FNC_GET_SCRP_QTY( P_CMP_NO S_BRN.CMP_NO%TYPE, P_BRN_NO S_BRN.BRN_NO%TYPE, P_ITEM_CODE MRP_CRP_ITEMS_DETAILS.ITEM_CODE%TYPE,P_ITEM_SCRAP MRP_CRP_ITEMS_DETAILS.ITEM_CODE%TYPE, P_QTY MRP_SFC_WIP_MASTER_SCRAP.QTY%TYPE ) RETURN NUMBER IS
VQTY MRP_BOM_SCRAPS.QTY%TYPE;
VQTYS MRP_BOM_SCRAPS.QTYS%TYPE;
SELECT QTY,QTYS
INTO VQTY,VQTYS
FROM MRP_BOM_SCRAPS
WHERE ITEM_CODE = P_ITEM_CODE
AND ITEM_SCRAP = P_ITEM_SCRAP
AND BRN_NO = P_BRN_NO;
VQTY :=0;
VQTYS:=0;
IF VQTY <> 0
THEN RETURN P_QTY * ( VQTYS/VQTY);
END FNC_GET_SCRP_QTY;
UNCTION FNC_GET_ITM_QTYHND ( P_CMP S_BRN.CMP_NO%TYPE, P_BRN S_BRN.BRN_NO%TYPE, P_ITM MRP_CRP_ITEMS_DETAILS.ITEM_CODE%TYPE ,P_WH MRP_CRP_WAREHOUSES_MSTR.WH_CODE%TYPE DEFAULT NULL) RETURN NUMBER IS
VQTY NUMBER;
EXECUTE IMMEDIATE ' SELECT NVL(SUM(NVL(QTY,0)),0)
WHERE CMP_NO = :P_CMP
AND BRN_NO = :P_BRN
AND ITEM_CODE = : P_ITM
AND WH_CODE = NVL(:P_WH,WH_CODE) '
USING P_CMP, P_BRN, P_ITM, P_WH;
RETURN (VQTY);
THEN RETURN (0);
END FNC_GET_ITM_QTYHND;
FUNCTION FNC_GET_CRD_BATCH (P_CMP S_BRN.CMP_NO%TYPE, P_BRN S_BRN.BRN_NO%TYPE, P_SHF MRP_SGS_SHOPS_FLOOR_CODING.SHF_CODE%TYPE ,P_SF_SQ MRP_SFC_WIP_MASTER.SF_SEQ%TYPE) RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
SELECT BATCH_NO
INTO V_BATCH_NO
AND SHF_CODE=P_SHF
AND SF_SEQ =P_SF_SQ;
RETURN V_BATCH_NO;
END FNC_GET_CRD_BATCH;
FUNCTION FNC_GET_ITM_QTYHND_CRD ( P_CMP S_BRN.CMP_NO%TYPE, P_BRN S_BRN.BRN_NO%TYPE,P_WH MRP_CRP_WAREHOUSES_MSTR.WH_CODE%TYPE DEFAULT NULL, P_ITM MRP_CRP_ITEMS_DETAILS.ITEM_CODE%TYPE , P_WO MRP_MPS_WORK_ORDR_MSTR.WORK_ORDER%TYPE,P_SFCRD MRP_SFC_WIP_MASTER.SF_SEQ%TYPE ) RETURN NUMBER IS
VQTY NUMBER:=0;
VQTY_1 NUMBER:=0;
AND WORK_ORDER = : P_WO
AND WH_CODE = NVL(:P_WH,WH_CODE)
AND TRANSM_SEQ =:P_SFCRD
AND TRANS_TYPE=6
USING P_CMP, P_BRN, P_ITM, P_WO,P_WH,P_SFCRD ;
AND SF_SEQ =:P_SFCRD
AND TRANS_TYPE=1
INTO VQTY_1
USING P_CMP, P_BRN, P_ITM, P_WH, P_WO,P_SFCRD ;
RETURN (VQTY-VQTY_1);
END FNC_GET_ITM_QTYHND_CRD;

Function validate_pass(pass varchar2) return varchar2 is
p_len number;
p varchar2(20);
cur_chr number;
if pass is null then
return null;
p_len := length(pass) ;
for i in 1 .. p_len loop
cur_chr := ascii(substr(pass,i,1));
p := p||CHR(cur_chr + P_LEN);
end loop;
return(p);

Function GIVE_AVG_COST(P_CMP_NO NUMBER, P_BRN_NO NUMBER, P_ITEM VARCHAR2, PFDATE DATE , PTDATE DATE) RETURN NUMBER IS
tmpVar NUMBER;
V NUMBER;
tmpVar := 0;
SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V
FROM MRP_SFC_MATERIALS_RECEIVE_DTLS D,
WHERE M.MRC_SQ = D.MRC_SQ AND
M.CMP_NO = D.CMP_NO AND
M.CMP_NO = P_CMP_NO AND
D.ITEM_CODE = P_ITEM AND
M.MRC_DATE between PFDATE AND PTDATE ;
IF NVL(V,0) > 0 THEN
ECT AVG(CST) INTO tmpVar
SELECT AVG(CST) INTO tmpVar
D.ITEM_CODE IN
( SELECT ITEM_OPTION FROM MRP_CRP_ITEMS_CLASS_OPTIONS WHERE MRP_ITEM_CODE = P_ITEM ) ;
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN TMPVAR:= 0;
RETURN tmpVar;
-- Consider logging the error and then re-raise
END GIVE_AVG_COST;

Function GET_MAT_BAL(V_CMP NUMBER ,
V_WR VARCHAR2) RETURN NUMBER IS
V_CMP_NO NUMBER := NVL(V_CMP , 0) ;
V_BRN_NO NUMBER := NVL(V_BRN , 0) ;
V_YER_CODE NUMBER := NVL(V_YER , 0) ;
V_PRD_CODE NUMBER := NVL(V_PRD , 0) ;
V_WH_CODE VARCHAR2(100) := NVL(V_WH , 'NULL') ;
V_ITEM_CODE VARCHAR2(100) := NVL(V_ITEM , 'NULL') ;
V_WORK_ORDER VARCHAR2(100) := NVL(V_WO , 'NULL') ;
V_SHIFT_CODE NUMBER := NVL(V_SHIFT , 0) ;
V_SHF_CODE NUMBER := NVL(V_SHF , 0) ;
V_LN_CODE VARCHAR2(100) := NVL(V_LN , 'NULL') ;
V_STG_CODE VARCHAR2(100) := NVL(V_STG , 'NULL') ;
V_JOB_CODE VARCHAR2(100) := NVL(V_JOB , 'NULL') ;
V_RCE_SER NUMBER := NVL(V_RCE , 0) ;
V_CMP_NO1 NUMBER := V_CMP_NO ;
V_BRN_NO1 NUMBER := V_BRN_NO ;
V_YER_CODE1 NUMBER := V_YER_CODE ;
V_PRD_CODE1 NUMBER := V_PRD_CODE ;
V_WH_CODE1 VARCHAR2(100) := V_WH_CODE ;
V_ITEM_CODE1 VARCHAR2(100) := V_ITEM_CODE ;
V_WORK_ORDER1 VARCHAR2(100) := V_WORK_ORDER ;
V_SHIFT_CODE1 NUMBER := V_SHIFT_CODE ;
V_SHF_CODE1 NUMBER := V_SHF_CODE ;
V_LN_CODE1 VARCHAR2(100) := V_LN_CODE ;
V_STG_CODE1 VARCHAR2(100) := V_STG_CODE ;
V_JOB_CODE1 VARCHAR2(100) := V_JOB_CODE ;
V_RCE_SER1 NUMBER := V_RCE_SER ;
V_CMP_NO2 NUMBER := V_CMP_NO ;
V_BRN_NO2 NUMBER := V_BRN_NO ;
V_YER_CODE2 NUMBER := V_YER_CODE ;
V_PRD_CODE2 NUMBER := V_PRD_CODE ;
V_WH_CODE2 VARCHAR2(100) := V_WH_CODE ;
V_ITEM_CODE2 VARCHAR2(100) := V_ITEM_CODE ;
V_WORK_ORDER2 VARCHAR2(100) := V_WORK_ORDER ;
V_SHIFT_CODE2 NUMBER := V_SHIFT_CODE ;
V_SHF_CODE2 NUMBER := V_SHF_CODE ;
V_LN_CODE2 VARCHAR2(100) := V_LN_CODE ;
V_STG_CODE2 VARCHAR2(100) := V_STG_CODE ;
V_JOB_CODE2 VARCHAR2(100) := V_JOB_CODE ;
V_RCE_SER2 NUMBER := V_RCE_SER ;
V_SQL VARCHAR2(7000) :=
' SELECT NVL(SUM(QTY),0)
WHERE DECODE(:V_CMP_NO , 0 , 0 , CMP_NO) = DECODE(:V_CMP_NO1 , 0 , 0 , :V_CMP_NO2 )
AND DECODE(:V_BRN_NO , 0 , 0 , BRN_NO) = DECODE(:V_BRN_NO1 , 0 , 0 , :V_BRN_NO2 )
AND DECODE(:V_YER_CODE , 0 , 0 , YER_CODE) = DECODE(:V_YER_CODE1 , 0 , 0 , :V_YER_CODE2 )
AND DECODE(:V_PRD_CODE , 0 , 0 , PERIOD_CODE) = DECODE(:V_PRD_CODE1 , 0 , 0 , :V_PRD_CODE2 )
AND DECODE(:V_WH_CODE , ''NULL'' , ''NULL'' , WH_CODE) = DECODE(:V_WH_CODE1 , ''NULL'' , ''NULL'' , :V_WH_CODE2 )
AND DECODE(:V_ITEM_CODE , ''NULL'' , ''NULL'' , ITEM_CODE) = DECODE(:V_ITEM_CODE1 , ''NULL'' , ''NULL'' , :V_ITEM_CODE2 )
AND DECODE(:V_WORK_ORDER , ''NULL'' , ''NULL'' , WORK_ORDER)= DECODE(:V_WORK_ORDER1 , ''NULL'' , ''NULL'' , :V_WORK_ORDER2)
AND DECODE(:V_SHIFT_CODE , 0 , 0 , SHIFT_CODE)= DECODE(:V_SHIFT_CODE1 , 0 , 0 , :V_SHIFT_CODE2)
AND DECODE(:V_SHF_CODE , 0 , 0 , SHF_CODE) = DECODE(:V_SHF_CODE1 , 0 , 0 , :V_SHF_CODE2 )
AND DECODE(:V_LN_CODE , ''NULL'' , ''NULL'' , LN_CODE) = DECODE(:V_LN_CODE1 , ''NULL'' , ''NULL'' , :V_LN_CODE2 )
AND DECODE(:V_STG_CODE , ''NULL'' , ''NULL'' , STG_CODE) = DECODE(:V_STG_CODE1 , ''NULL'' , ''NULL'' , :V_STG_CODE2 )
AND DECODE(:V_JOB_CODE , ''NULL'' , ''NULL'' , JOB_CODE) = DECODE(:V_JOB_CODE1 , ''NULL'' , ''NULL'' , :V_JOB_CODE2 )
AND DECODE(:V_RCE_SER , 0 , 0 , RCE_SER) = DECODE(:V_RCE_SER1 , 0 , 0 , :V_RCE_SER2 )
AND TRANS_DATE BETWEEN TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(NVL(:V_FDATE , TRANS_DATE) , ''DD/MM/YYYY''),''DD/MM/YYYY'')
AND TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(NVL(:V_TDATE , TRANS_DATE) , ''DD/MM/YYYY''),''DD/MM/YYYY'') ' || V_WR ;
V_BAL NUMBER(30,3) ;
V_SQL

Function GET_ITEM_YQTY_NEW(P_ASSEMBLER IN VARCHAR2, P_CC_CODE IN VARCHAR2 DEFAULT NULL ,
P_CODE2 NUMBER) RETURN NUMBER IS
Q NUMBER;
C_LVL NUMBER:= 0;
V_MRP NUMBER ;
Q := 0;
SELECT CC_LVL INTO C_LVL FROM MRP_PCM_COST_CENTER
WHERE CC_CODE = P_CC_CODE ;
SELECT MRP_PCM_SEPARATED INTO V_MRP
FROM MRP_SGS_GENERAL_PARAMETARS
WHERE ROWNUM<= 1;
--- ?? ???? ??? ?????? ?????? ?? ?? ??? ????? ???? ????
IF (C_LVL = 1) OR ( P_CC_CODE IS NULL ) THEN
IF V_MRP = 0 THEN -- ?????? ???
SELECT SUM( ACT_QTY) INTO Q
FROM MRP_PCM_COSTING_SUMMARY_YIELD
WHERE ASSEMBLER = P_ASSEMBLER AND
DECODE(P_CC_CODE,NULL,'1',CC_CODE) = DECODE(P_CC_CODE,NULL,'1',P_CC_CODE) AND
YER_CODE = P_YER AND
PERIOD_CODE BETWEEN P_CODE AND P_CODE2;
SELECT SUM( Y.ACT_QTY) INTO Q
FROM MRP_PCM_COSTING_SUMMARY_YIELD Y,
MRP_PCM_COST_CENTER_SOURCE S ,
MRP_BOM_BOM_STAGES BS
WHERE Y.CMP_NO = S.CMP_NO AND
Y.BRN_NO = S.BRN_NO AND
Y.CC_CODE = S.CC_CODE AND
Y.ASSEMBLER = P_ASSEMBLER AND
DECODE(P_CC_CODE,NULL,'1',Y.CC_CODE) = DECODE(P_CC_CODE,NULL,'1',P_CC_CODE) AND
Y.YER_CODE = P_YER AND
Y.PERIOD_CODE BETWEEN P_CODE AND P_CODE2 AND
DECODE(P_SHF_CODE,NULL ,0 , S.SHF_CODE) = DECODE(P_SHF_CODE,NULL,0,P_SHF_CODE) AND
DECODE(P_LN_CODE, NULL ,'-1' , NVL(S.LN_CODE,'-1') ) = DECODE(P_LN_CODE,NULL ,'-1',DECODE(S.LN_CODE,NULL,'-1',P_LN_CODE) ) AND
DECODE(P_STG_CODE,NULL ,'-1' , NVL(S.STG_CODE,'-1') ) = DECODE(
P_STG_CODE,NULL,'-1',DECODE(S.STG_CODE,NULL,'-1',P_STG_CODE) ) AND
-- 25-04-2010
BS.CMP_NO = S.CMP_NO AND
BS.BRN_NO = S.BRN_NO AND
BS.ITEM_CODE = Y.ASSEMBLER AND
DECODE(S.SHF_CODE,NULL ,0 , BS.SHF_CODE) = DECODE(S.SHF_CODE,NULL,0, S.SHF_CODE) AND
DECODE(S.LN_CODE, NULL ,'-1' , BS.LN_CODE) = DECODE(S.LN_CODE,NULL ,'-1',S.LN_CODE ) AND
DECODE(S.STG_CODE,NULL ,'-1' , BS.STG_CODE ) = DECODE(S.STG_CODE,NULL,'-1',S.STG_CODE) AND
DECODE(P_SHF_CODE,NULL ,0 , BS.SHF_CODE) = DECODE(P_SHF_CODE,NULL,0, P_SHF_CODE) AND
DECODE(P_LN_CODE, NULL ,'-1' , BS.LN_CODE) = DECODE(P_LN_CODE ,NULL,'-1',P_LN_CODE) AND
DECODE(P_STG_CODE,NULL ,'-1', BS.STG_CODE) = DECODE(P_STG_CODE,NULL,'-1',P_STG_CODE) AND
BS.ITEM_CODE = P_ASSEMBLER;
-- ?? ???? ????? ???? ???? ?????? ??????
SELECT SUM(Y.ACT_QTY) INTO Q
MRP_PCM_COST_CENTER_TREE T
WHERE T.CC_CODE = Y.CC_CODE AND
DECODE(P_CC_CODE,NULL,'1',T.CC_MAIN) = DECODE(P_CC_CODE,NULL,'1',P_CC_CODE) AND
Y.PERIOD_CODE BETWEEN P_CODE AND P_CODE2 ;
MRP_PCM_COST_CENTER_TREE T ,
DECODE(P_LN_CODE, NULL ,'-1' , S.LN_CODE) = DECODE(P_LN_CODE,NULL ,'-1',P_LN_CODE) AND
DECODE(P_STG_CODE,NULL ,'-1' , S.STG_CODE) = DECODE(P_STG_CODE,NULL,'-1',P_STG_CODE) AND
DECODE(P_SHF_CODE,NULL ,0 , BS.SHF_CODE) = DECODE(P_SHF_CODE,NULL,0,P_SHF_CODE) AND
DECODE(P_LN_CODE, NULL ,'-1' , BS.LN_CODE) = DECODE(P_LN_CODE,NULL ,'-1',P_LN_CODE) AND
DECODE(P_STG_CODE,NULL ,'-1' , BS.STG_CODE) = DECODE(P_STG_CODE,NULL,'-1',P_STG_CODE) AND
RETURN NVL(Q,0);
RAISE ;
END GET_ITEM_YQTY_NEW;

Function GET_ITEM_BAL_COST(P_CMP NUMBER , P_BRN NUMBER ,
P_PERIOD NUMBER, P_PERIOD2 NUMBER) RETURN NUMBER IS

SELECT SUM(AMT) INTO V_AMT
MRP_PCM_COSTING_SUMMARY
CMP_NO = P_CMP AND
BRN_NO = P_BRN AND
DOC_TYPE = 2 AND
MRP_FNC_PKG.GET_ITEM_YQTY2( CMP_NO,BRN_NO,
ASSEMBLER, CC_CODE,
NULL,NULL,NULL,
YER_CODE,
P_PERIOD,P_PERIOD2) > 0
AND PERIOD_CODE BETWEEN P_PERIOD AND P_PERIOD2 AND YER_CODE = P_YER_CODE
AND ASSEMBLER = P_ITEM_CODE AND
DECODE(P_CC_CODE , NULL,'0', CC_CODE) = DECODE(P_CC_CODE,NULL,'0',P_CC_CODE) AND
DECODE(P_ACC_CODE , NULL,'0', ACC_CODE) = DECODE(P_ACC_CODE,NULL,'0',P_ACC_CODE);
RETURN V_AMT ;

Function Formula_Description(P_LANG NUMBER, P_Dcr Varchar2 ) RETURN Varchar2 IS
DISC VARCHAR2(1000):='';
FORMLA_DESC VARCHAR2(2000):='';
FORMULA VARCHAR2(200);
TEMP_FROMLA VARCHAR2(2000):='';
LNGTH NUMBER:=0;
TXT VARCHAR2(200):='';
X NUMBER:=0;
J NUMBER;
V_FORMULA VARCHAR2(500);
SELECT TXT_FORMULA INTO V_FORMULA
FROM MRP_PCM_DISTRIBUTION_CRITERION
WHERE DCR_CODE = P_DCR ;
TEMP_FROMLA := V_FORMULA ; --- temproray store for formula syntax
SELECT COUNT(*) INTO X --- check if this formula is there or not
FROM MRP_PCM_DISTRIBUTION_CR_LINK
WHERE DCR_CODE = P_Dcr ;
IF NVL(X,0) > 0 THEN
FOR I IN(SELECT DV_CODE
WHERE DCR_CODE = P_Dcr )
LOOP --- select all accoding value to fomula
FORMULA :='['||I.DV_CODE ||']';
SELECT DECODE(P_LANG,1,DV_DESC_A,NVL(DV_DESC_E,DV_DESC_A) ) INTO DISC -- catch the according varible
FROM MRP_PCM_DISTRIBUTION_VARIABLES
WHERE DV_CODE = I.DV_CODE;
SELECT REPLACE(TEMP_FROMLA,FORMULA,DISC)
INTO FORMLA_DESC --- replace varible cod eby name
WHERE MRP_PCM_DISTRIBUTION_CRITERION.DCR_CODE = P_Dcr ;
TEMP_FROMLA := FORMLA_DESC;
----------------------------
RETURN(FORMLA_DESC);
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN RETURN('');
