Function CHK_APP_TRX(V_CMP NUMBER , V_BRN NUMBER , V_DATE DATE , TRX_ST NUMBER) RETURN NUMBER IS
V_ST NUMBER := 0 ;
** Created by Mohammad Allaw in 02/08/2006
** 0 ---> Ok
** 1 ---> There's Some Materials Recieve Transaction Not Approve
** 2 ---> There's Some Materials Transmutation Transaction Not Approve
** 3 ---> There's Some Materials Refund Transaction Not Approve
** 4 ---> There's Some Materials Finish Goods Transaction Not Approve
** 5 ---> There's Some Shop Floor Card Transaction Not Approve
** 6 ---> There's Some Materials Adjustment Transaction Not Approve
** -1 ---> Error
** Chk Materials Recieve
SELECT NVL(COUNT(*),0)
INTO V_ST
AND MRC_DATE <= V_DATE;
--AND P_STS = 0 ;
IF V_ST > 0 THEN
RETURN(1) ;
** Chk Materials Transmutation
FROM MRP_SFC_MATERIALS_TRANSMT_MSTR
AND MT_TYPE = 31
AND MT_DATE <= V_DATE
AND APP_DATE IS NULL ;
RETURN(2) ;
** Chk Materials Refund
AND MT_TYPE = 3
RETURN(3) ;
** Chk Materials Finish Goods
AND MT_TYPE = 1
RETURN(4) ;
** Chk Shop Floor Card
AND SF_DATE <= V_DATE
RETURN(5) ;
** Materials Adjustment
AND ADJ_DATE <= V_DATE
RETURN(6) ;
Raise_application_error(-20021,'Error in FUNCTION CHK_APP_TRX :255' || sqlerrm);
RETURN(-1) ;
Function CHECK_ONYX_PRIVILAGE(P_MRP_BRN NUMBER, P_ONYX_USR IN VARCHAR2 ) RETURN NUMBER IS
USR2 VARCHAR2(30) := USER;
GRANT_STM VARCHAR2(500):= NULL;
SEPRATE NUMBER;
ONX_VER NUMBER;
RETURN(1); --
SELECT MRP_PCM_SEPARATED,MRP_ONX_VERSION
INTO SEPRATE, ONX_VER
FROM MRP_SGS_GENERAL_PARAMETARS WHERE BRN_NO = P_MRP_BRN ;
IF SEPRATE = 0 THEN -- PCM ONLY WITOUT MRP
IF NVL(ONX_VER,0) = 0 THEN -- LINK WITH OLD ONYX VERSION
select COUNT(*) INTO C
from all_tab_privs
where UPPER(table_schema) = UPPER(P_ONYX_USR)
and UPPER(grantee) = UPPER(USR2)
and UPPER(Table_Name) IN
('MEASUREMENT',
'GROUP_DETAILS',
'ITEM_DETAILS',
'ACCOUNT',
'ACCOUNT_TYPES',
'DETAIL_JOURNAL',
'COST_CENTERS',
'EX_RATE',
'ITEM_PRICE',
'PRICING_LEVELS',
'ITEM_SALES_PLAN',
'MASTER_PERIODS',
'DETAIL_PERIODS' )
and Upper(privilege) = 'SELECT' ;
'IAS_PARA_GEN',
'IAS_PARA_GL',
'IAS_PARA_INV',
'MEASUREMENT',
'IAS_POST_DTL',
'IAS_ITEM_PRICE',
'IAS_PRICING_LEVELS',
'IAS_SALES_PLAN_MST' ,
'IAS_SALES_PLAN_DTL',
'DETAIL_PERIODS')
IF NVL(ONX_VER,0) = 0 AND NVL(C,0) >= 13 THEN
ELSIF NVL(ONX_VER,0) = 1 AND NVL(C,0) >= 17 THEN
ELSE RETURN (0);
ELSIF SEPRATE = 1 THEN -- MRP IS FULL
'COST_CENTER_TYPES',
'BILLS',
'BILL_DETAIL',
'CUSTOMER',
'PRIC
ING_LEVELS',
'STORAGE',
'GRN_DETAIL',
'P_ORDER',
'P_ORDER_DETAIL',
'SALES_ORDER',
'ORDER_DETAIL',
'IAS_OUTGOING_MST',
'IAS_OUTGOING_DTL',
'IAS_PI_BILL_MST',
'IAS_SORDER_TYPES',
IF (NVL(ONX_VER,0) = 0 AND NVL(C,0) >= 23) THEN
ELSIF (NVL(ONX_VER,0) = 1 AND NVL(C,0) >= 28) THEN
ELSIF SEPRATE = 2 THEN -- MRP WITOUT PCM
IF (NVL(ONX_VER,0) = 0 AND NVL(C,0) >= 16) THEN
ELSIF (NVL(ONX_VER,0) = 1 AND NVL(C,0) >= 21) THEN
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN RETURN(0);
END CHECK_ONYX_PRIVILAGE;
Function cc_is_root(P_CC_CODE VARCHAR2) RETURN NUMBER IS
Root NUMBER:= 0;
V_cc_main Varchar2(10);
IF P_CC_CODE is null then
ROOT:= -1 ;
Select cc_main into V_cc_main
From MRP_PCM_COST_CENTER
IF V_CC_MAIN IS NOT NULL THEN
Root:= 0;
Root:= 1;
RETURN Root;
END cc_is_root;
Function CALC_ITEM_BAL_COST(P_CMP NUMBER ,
P_PERIOD2 NUMBER) RETURN NUMBER IS
( Sum(AMT0) / SUM(distinct Qty) ) INTO V_AMT
ASSEMBLER,CC_ROW , QTY,
(Qty /MRP_FNC_PKG.GET_ITEM_FQTY(P_CMP, P_BRN, LVL, ASSEMBLER,CC_ROW,P_YER_CODE,P_PERIOD,P_PERIOD2) ) * ( Amt0) AMT0
from
SELECT T.CC_CODE ,
T.ITEM_CODE,YER_CODE,
MRP_FNC_PKG.GET_ITEM_YQTY2(t.cmp_no,
t.brn_no,
t.item_code,
t.cc_code ,
s.YER_CODE,
P_PERIOD,P_PERIOD2) Qty,
S.ASSEMBLER, S.CC_CODE CC_ROW , T.LVL,
SUM( DECODE(1,1,s.amtl,s.amt) ) amt0
FROM MRP_PCM_COSTING_SUMMARY S,
T.CMP_NO = P_CMP AND
T.BRN_NO = P_BRN AND
T.CC_ROW = S.CC_CODE AND
T.ITEM_ROW = S.ASSEMBLER AND
T.CMP_NO = S.CMP_NO AND
T.BRN_NO = S.BRN_NO AND
S.DOC_TYPE = 1 AND
MRP_FNC_PKG.GET_ITEM_YQTY2(S.CMP_NO ,
S.BRN_NO ,
S.ASSEMBLER,
S.CC_CODE,
P_PERIOD,P_PERIOD2) > 0 AND
S.YER_CODE = P_YER_CODE AND
S.PERIOD_CODE BETWEEN P_PERIOD AND P_PERIOD2 AND
T.ITEM_CODE = P_ITEM_CODE AND
DECODE(P_CC_CODE , NULL,'0',T.CC_CODE) = DECODE(P_CC_CODE,NULL,'0' ,P_CC_CODE ) AND
DECODE(P_ACC_CODE , NULL,'0',S.ACC_CODE) = DECODE(P_ACC_CODE,NULL,'0',P_ACC_CODE)
GROUP BY S.CMP_NO, S.BRN_NO,T.CC_CODE, T.ITEM_CODE, S.ASSEMBLER,T.LVL, S.CC_CODE ,T.ROW_QTY,s.YER_CODE
Function ACC_TAB( P_CMP NUMBER DEFAULT 1, P_BRN NUMBER, P_ACC IN VARCHAR2 , P_TAB_TYPE IN NUMBER) RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
V_CLASS VARCHAR2(10):= NULL;
SELECT CASE WHEN P_TAB_TYPE = 1 THEN CLS_PRP
WHEN P_TAB_TYPE = 2 THEN CLS_PROD
WHEN P_TAB_TYPE = 3 THEN CLS_FUNC
WHEN P_TAB_TYPE = 4 THEN CLS_QTY
END TAB
INTO V_CLASS
FROM MRP_PCM_ACCOUNTS_DEF
WHERE ACC_CODE = P_ACC AND
ACC_CLAS = 'ONX' AND
RETURN V_CLASS ;
END ACC_TAB;
Function Acc_Class(P_CMP NUMBER DEFAULT 1, P_BRN NUMBER, P_ACC VARCHAR2, P_CLS NUMBER, P_LANG NUMBER DEFAULT 1 ) RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
V_CLASS VARCHAR2(80):= NULL;
SELECT DECODE(P_LANG,1,NVL(C.CLS_DESC_A,C.CLS_DESC_F) ,NVL(C.CLS_DESC_F,C.CLS_DESC_A) )
FROM MRP_PCM_ACCOUNTS_DEF D ,
MRP_PCM_ELEMENT_CLASS C
WHERE D.ACC_CODE = P_ACC AND
D.BRN_NO = P_BRN AND
DECODE(P_CLS ,1,D.CLS_PRP
,2,D.CLS_PROD
,3,D.CLS_FUNC
,4,D.CLS_QTY) = C.CLS_CODE ;
-- Consider logging the err
or and then re-raise
END Acc_Class;

FUNCTION GET_VAR_VALUE(V_CODE IN VARCHAR2 , ind_calculat IN NUMBER,
PERIOD IN NUMBER, YEAR IN NUMBER) RETURN NUMBER IS
CC NUMBER:= 0;
VAL NUMBER:= 0;
SELECT COUNT(*) INTO CC
FROM MRP_PCM_VARIABLES_VALUES V
WHERE V.dv_code = V_CODE AND
V.PERIOD_CODE = PERIOD AND YER_CODE = YEAR;
IF NVL(CC,0) = 0 THEN
RETURN(-2222);
IF ind_calculat IN (1,2,3,4,5,6) THEN
DECODE(ind_calculat ,
1,SUM(V.CV_VALUE),2,SUM(V.CV_VALUE),
3,AVG(V.CV_VALUE),4,AVG(V.CV_VALUE),
5,MAX(V.CV_VALUE),6,MAX(V.CV_VALUE),0
ELSIF ind_calculat IN (7,8) THEN
SELECT CV_VALUE
V.PERIOD_CODE = PERIOD AND V.YER_CODE = YEAR AND
ROWNUM = CC;
ELSIF ind_calculat IN (9,10) THEN
ROWNUM = 1 ;
RETURN(VAL);
RETURN(-4444);

--Steps
--[Colculate the New Avarg cost ]

--[Set The Last/After Avareg cost into Movement Table ]
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
V_QTY_HND Number := MRP_PKG.MRP_FUNC_GET_ITEM_QTYHND(V_ITEM_CODE,V_CMP,V_BRN,V_WH_COD);
V_CAVG Number := MRP_PKG.MRP_FUNC_GET_ITEM_AVGCST(V_ITEM_CODE,V_CMP,V_BRN);
V_NAVG Number :=((V_CAVG * V_QTY_HND) + (V_QTY * V_CST)) / (V_QTY + V_QTY_HND);
Update MRP_CRP_ITEMS_DETAILS
Set CST_AVG = v_NAVG
Where cmp_no = V_cmp
And brn_no = V_brn
And item_code = V_ITEM_CODE;
If sql%notfound then
raise_application_error(-20001,'Error in Updating MRP_CRP_ITEMS_DETAILS :10'|| sqlerrm);
Update MRP_SFC_WHM_ITEMS_MOVE

AVGCST_AFTER = V_NAVG
And IM_SQ = V_SEQ;
if sql%notfound then
raise_application_error(-20001,'Error in Updating MRP_SFC_WHM_ITEMS_MOVE, MAYBE NO DATA FOUND:11'|| sqlerrm);

Procedure MRP_FUNC_GET_YERPRD(V_DATE DATE , V_YER IN OUT Number , V_PRD IN OUT Number) IS
SELECT D.YER_CODE , D.PERIOD_CODE
INTO V_YeR , V_PRD
FROM MRP_SGS_PERIOD_COSTONG D,MRP_YEAR M -- ADD BY SAWSAN 27-1-2007
WHERE DATE_T >= V_DATE
AND DATE_F <= V_DATE
AND TO_CHAR(V_DATE,'YYYY') = M.YER_CODE -- ADD BY SAWSAN 27-1-2007
AND M.P_CLS =0 -- ADD BY SAWSAN 27-1-2007
AND M.P_CNTU =0 -- ADD BY SAWSAN 27-1-2007
AND D.YER_CODE =M.YER_CODE-- ADD BY SAWSAN 27-1-2007
AND ROWNUM <=1 ;
--AND D.P_CLS =0 -- ADD BY SAWSAN 27-1-2007
--AND D.P_CNTU =0 ; -- ADD BY SAWSAN 27-1-2007
V_YER :=NULL; -- ADD BY SAWSAN 27-1-2007
V_PRD :=NULL; -- ADD BY SAWSAN 27-1-2007
Raise_application_error(-20021,'Error in Procedure MRP_FUNC_GET_YERPRD :70'||sqlerrm);
Raise_application_error(-20021,'Error in Procedure MRP_FUNC_GET_YERPRD :80'||sqlerrm);

Function genTranId return VARCHAR2 IS
cTranId varchar2(16);
Temptran varchar2(16);
cnt number(4);
select max(substr(TRAN_ID,4,6))
into cTranId
from MRP_PCM_DAILY_TRANS_MAST
where substr(TRAN_ID,1,3)='PCM';
if length(cTranId)>0 then
cnt:=TO_NUMBER(cTranId)+1;
cnt:=1;
cTranId:='PCM'+TO_CHAR(cnt);
cTranId:='PCM1';
return cTranId ;

FUNCTION GET_REP_DESC ( REP_NAME IN VARCHAR2 , LANG IN NUMBER) RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
R_DESC VARCHAR2(255);
--6-6-2010
DECODE( LANG,1,REP_DESC_A,REP_DESC_F) INTO R_DESC
FROM MRP_REPORTS
WHERE UPPER(REP_CODE) = UPPER(REP_NAME);
FUNCTION GET_REP_TAIL ( REP_NAME IN VARCHAR2 , LANG IN NUMBER) RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
R_TAIL VARCHAR2(255);
SELECT DECODE( LANG,1,rep_footnote_a,rep_footnote_f) INTO R_TAIL
RETURN(R_TAIL);
FUNCTION GET_REP_ORIENTATION ( REP_NAME IN VARCHAR2 ) RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
R_ORIENT VARCHAR2(20);
SELECT REP_ORIENTATION INTO R_ORIENT
If R_ORIENT = 1 Then
R_ORIENT:= 'Portrait';
ElsIf R_ORIENT = 2 Then
R_ORIENT:= 'Landscape';
RETURN(R_ORIENT);
RETURN('Portrait');

FUNCTION GET_DIGIT ( REP_NAME IN VARCHAR2, FV IN NUMBER ) RETURN NUMBER IS
R_NUM Number ;
FWV Number;
select Rep_Num_digit InTo R_NUM
From MRP_REPORTS
IF R_NUM = 1 THEN
FWV := Fv ;
ELSIF R_NUM = 2 THEN
FWV := FV / 1000;
ELSIF R_NUM = 3 T
FWV := FV / 1000000;
RETURN(FWV);
RETURN(FV);

FUNCTION GET_LABLE(REP_NAME IN VARCHAR2 , LAB IN VARCHAR2,
DL IN VARCHAR2 ,LNG IN NUMBER ) RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
R_LAB VARCHAR2(100):= NULL;
SELECT DSC INTO R_LAB
FROM MRP_REP_LAB
WHERE UPPER(TAB_NME) = UPPER(REP_NAME) AND
UPPER(LAB_NME) = UPPER(LAB) AND
LNG_NO = LNG;
RETURN(R_LAB);
EXCEPTION WHEN no_data_found THEN
RETURN(DL);

FUNCTION MRP_FUNC_GET_MRP_MSG (V_MSG_CODE IAS_SYS.MRP_MSGS.MSG_CODE%type,V_MSG_NUM IAS_SYS.MRP_MSGS.MSG_NUM%TYPE)RETURN IAS_SYS.MRP_MSGS.MSG_TEXT%type as
V_msg IAS_SYS.MRP_MSGS.MSG_TEXT%TYPE;
SELECT MSG_TEXT --DECODE(MSG_ARABIC,1,MSG_LATIN)
INTO V_MSG
FROM IAS_SYS.MRP_MSGS
WHERE MSG_CODE=V_MSG_CODE
AND MSG_NUM=V_MSG_NUM
AND LANG_NO =1;
RETURN V_MSG;
FUNCTION MRP_FUNC_GET_ITEM_COST(V_ITEM_CODE MRP_CRP_ITEMS_DETAILS.ITEM_CODE%TYPE , V_CST_TYPE NUMBER) RETURN NUMBER IS
IF V_CST_TYPE IN (1,2,3,4) THEN
SELECT DECODE(V_CST_TYPE,
1,CST_AVG,
2,CST_BEGIN,
3,CST_LAST_PROD,
4,CST_STANDR)
WHERE ITEM_CODE=V_ITEM_CODE;
RETURN V_CST;
RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20009,MRP_FUNC_GET_MRP_MSG ('MDB',4 ) || sqlerrm);
RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20009,MRP_FUNC_GET_MRP_MSG ('MDB',2) || V_ITEM_CODE || sqlerrm);
RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20009,MRP_FUNC_GET_MRP_MSG ('MDB',3) || sqlerrm);
END MRP_PKG;

PROCEDURE BUILD_PRODUCTS_ACCOUNTS(P_BRN IN NUMBER) IS

select *
Where BRN_NO = P_BRN AND

( select Item_code From MRP_CRP_ITEMS_CATEGORY
Where CTGR in (1,2) ) and
item_code ||'/1' not in ( select acc_code From mrp_pcm_accounts_def) ;

DECODE(SS.Stg_code,NULL,'-1',Stg_code) =
DECODE(SS.Stg_code,NULL,'-1',B1.Stg_code) AND
B1.ITEM_ROW = PP.ITEM_CODE ;
exception when no_data_found then
V_CNT := 0;
FROM MRP_PCM_ITEMS_TREE
WHERE CMP_NO = B.CMP_NO AND
BRN_NO = B.BRN_NO AND
ITEM_CODE = B.F_ITEM AND
ITEM_ROW = B1.ITEM_ROW AND
CC_CODE = B.CC_CODE AND
CC_ROW = VCC_CODE2 AND
ROWNUM <=1;
IF NVL(V_CNT,0) = 0 THEN
(B.CMP_NO, B.BRN_NO, B.CC_CODE ,B.F_ITEM, B1.ITEM_ROW,VCC_CODE2,B1.QTY_N ,B1.LVL );
V_ORDER:= V_ORDER + 1;
WHERE CMP_NO = 1 AND
BRN_NO = V_BRN_NO AND
USR_NAME = P_COM_USR ;
PROCEDURE FILL_ITEM_TREE(P_BRN_NO IN NUMBER, P_BOM_CODE IN VARCHAR2 DEFAULT NULL, P_ITEM_CODE IN VARCHAR2 DEFAULT NULL)IS
C NUMBER;
V_STG VARCHAR2(10);
CURSOR T_ITM IS SELECT CMP_NO, BRN_NO, BOM_CODE, ITEM_CODE, STG_CODE FROM MRP_BOM_BOM_STAGES
WHERE BRN_NO = P_BRN_NO
AND BOM_CODE = Decode(P_BOM_CODE,Null,BOM_CODE,P_BOM_CODE)
AND ITEM_CODE = Decode(P_ITEM_CODE,Null,ITEM_CODE,P_ITEM_CODE);
CURSOR T_ROW (V_BOM_CODE VARCHAR2, V_ITEM_CODE VARCHAR2)IS
SELECT DISTINCT CMP_NO, BRN_NO, BOM_CODE, BOM_ROW, ITEM_CODE, ITEM_ROW, QTY, STG_CODE, ROW_ORDER
FROM MRP_BOM_ROW_VIEW
WHERE (CMP_NO, BRN_NO, ITEM_CODE, BOM_CODE)IN
(SELECT CMP_NO, BRN_NO, ITEM_CODE, BOM_CODE FROM MRP_BOM_ROW_VIEW
CONNECT BY PRIOR RB_CODE=IB_CODE
START WITH CMP_NO = CMP_NO AND BRN_NO = BRN_NO
AND BOM_CODE = V_BOM_CODE
AND ITEM_CODE = V_ITEM_CODE)
AND BOM_ROW IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ROW_ORDER DESC;
DELETE FROM MRP_BOM_BOM_TREE
WHERE BRN_NO =P_BRN_NO
AND BOM_CODE =NVL(P_BOM_CODE,BOM_CODE)
AND ITEM_CODE =NVL(P_ITEM_CODE,ITEM_CODE);
FOR I IN T_ITM LOOP
C:=0;
INSERT INTO MRP_BOM_BOM_TREE(CMP_NO, BRN_NO, STG_CODE, BOM_CODE, ITEM_CODE, BOM_ROW, ITEM_ROW, ROW_QTY, LVL) VALUES
(I.CMP_NO, I.BRN_NO, I.STG_CODE, I.BOM_CODE, I.ITEM_CODE, I.BOM_CODE, I.ITEM_CODE, 1, C);
FOR R IN T_ROW(I.BOM_CODE, I.ITEM_CODE) LOOP
C:=C+1;
SELECT STG_CODE INTO V_STG FROM MRP_BOM_BOM_STAGES WHERE CMP_NO=1 AND BRN_NO = 1
AND BOM_CODE=R.BOM_ROW AND ITEM_CODE=R.ITEM_ROW;
(I.CMP_NO, I.BRN_NO, V_STG, I.BOM_CODE, I.ITEM_CODE, R.BOM_ROW, R.ITEM_ROW, R.QTY, C);
RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR (-20441, 'Err When FILL_ITEM_TREE : '||SQLERRM);

Function Period_of_varible(P_CMP_NO NUMBER, P_BRN_NO NUMBER, Period in number , Year in Number,calc in number ) return number is
CURSOR PERIODS IS
SELECT period_code
where yer_code = Year AND
BRN_NO = P_BRN_NO
ORDER BY 1 ;
PRV_PER NUMBER := Period;
P PERIODS%ROWTYPE;
IF calc MOD 2 = 0 THEN -- GET PREVIOUS PERIOD
OPEN PERIODS;
FETCH PERIODS INTO P;
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
WHILE (PERIODS%FOUND) AND (P.PERIOD_CODE != PRV_PER ) LOOP
IF P.PERIOD_CODE > 1 THEN
PRV_PER := P.PERIOD_CODE-1;
PRV_PER := P.PERIOD_CODE ;
CLOSE PERIODS;
RETURN( PRV_PER );

SUM_DR_AMT_e:=0;

THERE_IS_DETAILS:= 0;
DELETE From MRP_PCM_DAILY_TRANS_DETAILS D

AND YER_CODE = YER_CODE

D.CMP_NO = 1 AND
D.BRN_NO = P_BRN_NO;
----------
DELETE FROM MRP_PCM_DAILY_TRANS_MAST
AND YER_CODE = P_YER_CODE
AND TRAN_ID NOT IN
( SELECT DISTINCT TRAN_ID FROM MRP_PCM_DAILY_TRANS_DETAILS
AND BRN_NO = P_BRN_NO);
IF (CC_PCM_TYPE = 0) AND (CC_ACC IS NOT NULL) THEN
INSERT INTO MRP_PCM_DAILY_TRANS_MAST
( CMP_NO ,

IF CC_LINK = 2 THEN -- LINK WITH ACCOUNTS
K:= 0;
KK:= 0;
SELECT COUNT(*) INTO K

WHERE BRN_NO = P_BRN_NO;
IF NVL(K,0) = 0 THEN
ERR:= 2;
-----------------------------------------------------------------
FOR J IN
( SELECT BRN_NO, A_CODE , AMT FROM VIEW_JOURNAL1

A_CODE IN

MRP_PCM_ACCOUNTS_DEF DF
WHERE ACC.CMP_NO = 1 AND ACC.BRN_NO = P_BRN_NO AND
DF.ACC_CODE = ACC.ACC_CODE AND
CC:= 0;
TRAN_TYPE_VAR:='';
K:= K + 1;
SELECT DISTINCT CC_CODE INTO CC_CODE_VAR
FROM MRP_PCM_MRP_ONX_CCCONTROL
A_CODE = J.A_CODE AND
CC_CODE IN ( SELECT DISTINCT CC_CODE FROM MRP_PCM_COST_CENTER
WHERE CMP_NO = 1 AND BRN_NO = P_BRN_NO );
Err:= 3;
INTO CC
FROM MRP_PCM_MRP_ONX_ACCCONTROL
WHERE CMP_NO =1 AND
ACC_CODE IN ( SELECT ACC_CODE FROM MRP_PCM_ACCOUNTS_DEF WHERE CMP_NO = 1 AND BRN_NO = P_BRN_NO );
IF NVL(CC,0) = 1 THEN
SELECT DISTINCT ACC_CODE
INTO ACC_MRP
ACC_CODE IN ( SELECT ACC_CODE FROM MRP_PCM_ACCOUNTS_DEF
WHERE CMP_NO =1 AND BRN_NO = P_BRN_NO );
If (NVL(J.AMT ,0) <> 0) and (CC_CODE_VAR is not null) Then
THERE_IS_DETAILS:= 1;
IF J.AMT < 0 THEN
TRAN_TYPE_VAR := 'C';
SUM_CR_AMT_e:= SUM_CR_AMT_e + J.AMT ;
TRAN_TYPE_VAR := 'D';
SUM_DR_AMT_e:= SUM_DR_AMT_e + J.AMT;
INSERT_DAILY(CC_ACC, V_Tran_Id , ACC_MRP , CC_CODE_VAR , J.AMT ,TRAN_TYPE_VAR , P_BRN_NO, CC_ACTIVE );
Else ---- ONYX LINK WITH COST CENTER -----------------------------------
FROM VIEW_JOURNAL2
FOR J IN ( SELECT DISTINCT
A_CODE ,cost_cntr_no,
CC_code, AMT
(1, BRN_NO, A_CODE , CC_CODE ) IN

WHERE OA.CMP_NO = E.CMP_NO AND
OA.BRN_NO = E.BRN_NO AND
E.CMP_NO = DF.CMP_NO AND
E.BRN_NO = DF.BRN_NO AND
OA.BRN_NO = P_BRN_NO AND
OA.CMP_NO = 1 AND
OA.ACC_CODE = E.ACC_CODE AND

DF.ACC_CODE = OA.ACC_CODE AND
DECODE(P_THEORY,3,'VAR','ALL' ) = DECODE(P_THEORY,3,DF.CLS_QTY ,'ALL' ) AND
DECODE(P_THEORY,4,'DRT','ALL' ) = DECODE(P_THEORY,4,DF.CLS_PROD ,'ALL' )
WHERE A_CODE = J.A_CODE AND CMP_NO = 1 AND BRN_NO = P_BRN_NO ;
Err:= 4;
If NVL(J.AMT,0) <> 0 then
SUM_CR_AMT_e:= SUM_CR_AMT_e + J.AMT;

------------------ end point ----------------------------------
IF THERE_IS_DETAILS = 1 THEN

Procedure Fill_Summary_Yeild (P_CMP IN NUMBER,
P_BRN IN NUMBER,
Err IN Out Number )IS
----- Varibles
Pcm_seprated NUMBER ; --- ( 0 : seprate , 1 : not Seprated );
Item VARCHAR2(100);
Ac_Qty NUMBER ;
Of_Qty NUMBER ;
Percent NUMBER := 50;
DV_COUNT NUMBER;
D_V VARCHAR2(30);
c_items NUMBER;
SUB NUMBER:= 0; -- INITAIL VALUE ( THERE IS SUBPRODUCT OR NOT )
---------- Begin Procedure
select mrp_pcm_separated
Into Pcm_seprated
from MRP_SGS_GENERAL_PARAMETARS
WHERE CMP_NO = P_CMP AND BRN_NO = P_BRN;
SAVEPOINT D_Fill_Summary_Yeild ;
RETURN_DATE(p_cmp,p_brn,P_PERIOD, P_YEAR, F_DATE, T_DATE );
DELETE MRP_PCM_COSTING_SUMMARY_YIELD Y
WHERE Y.YER_CODE = P_YEAR and
Y.PERIOD_CODE = P_PERIOD and
Y.BRN_NO = P_BRN and
Y.CMP_NO = P_CMP ;
SELECT dv_code
INTO D_V
WHERE DV_TYPE = 10 AND BASEDON = 2;
IF D_V IS NULL THEN
err:= 5;
D_V:= NULL;
------------------------------
C_items:= 0;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.item_code)
INTO c_items
FROM mrp_pcm_cntr_products p
WHERE P.brn_no = P_BRN ;
IF NVL(c_items,0) = 0 THEN
ERR:= 3;
ROLLBACK TO D_Fill_Summary_Yeild ;
FOR j IN (SELECT V.cc_code,V.item_code, SUM( Nvl(V.CV_VALUE,0) ) VAL
WHERE V.CMP_NO = P_CMP
AND V.brn_no = P_BRN
AND V.yer_code = P_YEAR
AND V.period_code = P_period
AND item_code IS NOT NULL
AND v.dv_code = D_V
Group By V.cc_code,V.item_code
Having SUM(Nvl(V.CV_VALUE,0) ) > 0
INSERT INTO MRP_PCM_COSTING_SUMMARY_YIELD (cmp_no ,
brn_no ,
cc_code ,
yer_code ,
period_code ,
assembler ,
assembly ,
act_qty ,
ofst_qty ,
ofst_per )
( P_CMP ,
j.cc_code ,
P_YEAR ,
j.item_code ,
j.VAL ,
ERR:= 1;
EXIT WHEN ERR = 1;
SUB:= 1;
FOR FG IN ( SELECT DISTINCT P.item_code, P.cc_code
FROM mrp_pcm_cntr_products P,
MRP_PCM_VARIABLES_VALUES V
WHERE P.brn_no = V.BRN_NO AND P.CMP_NO = V.CMP_NO AND
P.CC_CODE = V.CC_CODE AND P.ITEM_CODE = V.ITEM_CODE AND
P.brn_no = P_BRN AND P.CMP_NO = P_CMP AND
( P.CMP_NO , P.BRN_NO,P.ITEM_CODE ) IN --
( select CMP_NO , BRN_NO, Item_code From MRP_CRP_ITEMS_CATEGORY
Where CTGR = 1 AND brn_no = V.BRN_NO AND CMP_NO = V.CMP_NO ) AND
( P.CMP_NO , P.BRN_NO,P.ITEM_CODE ) NOT IN --
Where CTGR = 2 AND brn_no = V.BRN_NO AND CMP_NO = V.CMP_NO)
Of_qty := 0;
IF Pcm_seprated = 0 THEN -- PCM IS SEPRATED
--- FIND SUB PRODUCT (SP.ITEM_CODE) FOR THE FINISH GOOD PRODUCT (FG.ITEM_CODE).
FOR SP IN ( SELECT V.item_code ,O.OFFSET , SUM(NVL(V.cv_value,0)) Val
MRP_CRP_ITEMS_CLASS_OPTIONS O
V.brn_NO = P_brn
AND V.CMP_NO = P_cmp
AND V.yer_code = P_Year
AND V.period_code = P_Period
AND V.ITEM_CODE = O.ITEM_OPTION
AND V.CMP_NO = O.CMP_NO
AND V.BRN_NO = O.BRN_NO
AND O.MRP_ITEM_CODE = fg.item_code
AND V.DV_CODE = D_V
AND NOT exists
( SELECT DISTINCT assembler
where assembler = V.ITEM_CODE AND
brn_no = P_brn AND CMP_NO =P_cmp )
GROUP BY V.item_code,O.OFFSET
Of_qty := of_qty + Sp.OffSet * Nvl(Sp.Val,0) ;
If Nvl(Of_qty,0) <> 0 Then
Update MRP_PCM_COSTING_SUMMARY_YIELD
Set Ofst_qty = NVL(Ofst_qty,0) + Of_qty
Where Assembler = FG.Item_Code AND
CMP_NO = P_CMP AND BRN_NO = P_BRN;
Err:= 2;
ROLLBACK TO D_Fill_Summary_Yeild;
PROCEDURE GET_STANDARD_CONST_ACCOUNT( P_CMP IN NUMBER ,
Err IN OUT NUMBER) IS
CURSOR STD_CNST1 IS
C.CMP_NO, C.BRN_NO, P.YER_CODE, P.PERIOD_CODE,
C.CC_CODE,C.ACC_CODE ,
P.AMT , C.CUR_CODE
FROM MRP_PCM_STD_COST_CONSTANT C ,
MRP_PCM_STD_COST_CONS_PERIOD P ,
mrp_pcm_cost_center CC
WHERE C.seq = P.seq AND
C.cc_code = CC.cc_code AND
P.yer_code = P_YER AND
P.period_code = P_PERIOD AND
CC.cc_ctgry = 0 AND -- PRODUCTIVE CENTERS
C.CMP_NO = P_CMP AND
c.brn_no = P_brn
ORDER BY 1,2,3,4,5,6;
CURSOR STD_CNST2 IS
P.amt, C.CUR_CODE
CC.cc_ctgry = 1 AND -- Services CENTERS
Cc_center VARCHAR2(30);
A_CODE NUMBER;
STD_COST NUMBER;
C_TYPE NUMBER;
PRD_VAL NUMBER;
PRD_PER NUMBER;
S NUMBER;
cper NUMBER;
V_CURR VARCHAR2(10):= GET_CURRENCY(P_BRN);
STD_CURR VARCHAR2(10);
V_RATE1 NUMBER;
V_RATE2 NUMBER;
-- CHECK IF THERE IS ANY STANDARD CONSTANT COST OR NOT
SELECT Count(*) into C
C.brn_no = P_brn;
Err:= 0;
RETURN ;
SELECT DISTINCT CUR_CODE INTO STD_CURR
FROM MRP_PCM_STD_COST_CONSTANT WHERE CMP_NO = P_CMP AND BRN_NO = P_BRN ;
IF STD_CURR = V_CURR THEN
V_RATE1:= 1; --
V_RATE2:= 1/STOCK_RATE_CURR(P_BRN); --
V_RATE1 := STOCK_RATE_CURR(P_BRN);--
V_RATE2 := 1 ; --
SAVEPOINT SP_STANDARD_CONST ;
SELECT MAX(NVL(sum_sq,0)) INTO S
FROM MRP_PCM_COSTING_SUMMARY;
FOR J IN STD_CNST1
FOR Q IN ( SELECT ca.cc_beneficial, CA.Item_Beneficiary , CA.ACC_CODE,
(CA.per/100) * J.AMT PER_P
FROM MRP_PCM_CRITERIONS_CAL CA
WHERE ca.CMP_NO = J.CMP_NO And
ca.brn_no = ca.brn_no And
ca.yer_code = j.yer_code And
ca.period_code = j.PERIOD_CODE And
ca.cc_beneficial = j.cc_code And
ca.typ = 2 And
( ca.acc_code is not null and
1 <= Exact_Percent(j.cmp_no, j.brn_no , j.period_code, j.yer_code,J.ACC_CODE, J.CC_CODE, ca.typ) and
Ca.acc_Code = j.acc_code
( ca.acc_code is null and
0 = Exact_Percent(j.cmp_no, j.brn_no , j.period_code,j.yer_code, J.ACC_CODE, J.CC_CODE, ca.typ)
------------------ PRODUCTIVE COST CENTER TYPE ----------------
FROM MRP_PCM_COSTING_SUMMARY
WHERE J.CMP_NO = CMP_NO AND
J.BRN_NO = BRN_NO AND
J.YER_CODE = YER_CODE AND
J.PERIOD_CODE = PERIOD_CODE AND
J.ACC_CODE = ACC_CODE AND
Q.item_beneficiary = ASSEMBLER AND
J.CC_CODE = CC_CODE ;
UPDATE MRP_PCM_COSTING_SUMMARY
SET amt_s = ( NVL(amt_s,0 ) + Q.PER_P) * V_RATE2 ,
amtl_s = ( NVL(amtl_s,0) + Q.PER_P) * V_RATE1
J.CC_CODE = CC_CODE AND
Q.item_beneficiary = ASSEMBLER ;
-------- SERVICE COST CENTER TYPE
FOR H IN STD_CNST2
CPER:= 0;
FOR K IN ( SELECT ca.cc_beneficial, CA.CC_BENEFICIARY , CA.ACC_CODE,
(CA.per/100) * H.AMT PER_S
WHERE ca.CMP_NO = H.CMP_NO And
ca.yer_code = H.yer_code And
ca.period_code = H.PERIOD_CODE And
ca.cc_beneficial = H.cc_code And
ca.typ = 1 And
( ca.ac
c_code is not null and
1 <= Exact_Percent(H.cmp_no, H.brn_no , H.period_code,H.yer_code, H.ACC_CODE, H.CC_CODE, 1) and
Ca.acc_Code = H.acc_code
0 = Exact_Percent(H.cmp_no, H.brn_no ,H.period_code, H.yer_code, H.ACC_CODE, H.CC_CODE, 1)
FOR G IN ( SELECT ca.cc_beneficial, CA.Item_Beneficiary , CA.ACC_CODE,
(CA.per/100) * K.PER_S PER_P
ca.cc_beneficial = K.CC_BENEFICIARY And
1 <= Exact_Percent(H.cmp_no, H.brn_no , H.period_code, H.yer_code, H.ACC_CODE, K.CC_BENEFICIARY, ca.typ) and
0 = Exact_Percent(H.cmp_no, H.brn_no ,H.period_code, H.yer_code,H.ACC_CODE, K.CC_BENEFICIARY, ca.typ)
PRD_val := G.PER_P;
WHERE CMP_NO = H.CMP_NO AND
BRN_NO = H.BRN_NO AND
YER_CODE = H.YER_CODE AND
PERIOD_CODE = H.PERIOD_CODE AND
ACC_CODE = H.ACC_CODE AND
CC_CODE = G.cc_beneficial AND -- ADED 8/4/2007
ref_cc_code = H.cc_code AND
ASSEMBLER = G.item_beneficiary ;
SET amt_s = (NVL(amt_s,0 ) + PRD_val) * V_RATE2,
amtl_s =(NVL(amtl_s,0) + PRD_val) * V_RATE1
REF_CC_CODE = H.cc_code AND
ROLLBACK TO SP_STANDARD_CONST ;
Err IN OUT NUMBER ) IS
ACC_ASS VARCHAR2(60);
Q NUMBER:= 0;
SQ NUMBER:= 0;
V_CURR VARCHAR2(10):= GET_CURRENCY(P_BRN) ;
QTY NUMBER;
V_QTYF NUMBER;
V_AMT NUMBER;
WHERE cmp_no = P_CMP AND
brn_no = P_BRN AND
yer_code = P_YER AND
ASSEMBLER = ASSEMBLER AND
S:= NVL(S,0);
SAVEPOINT D_GET_STANDARD_ACCOUNT ;
FOR I IN ( SELECT CMP_NO, BRN_NO, CC_CODE, ASSEMBLER, ACC_CODE, YER_CODE,PERIOD_CODE
WHERE YER_CODE =P_YER AND PERIOD_CODE = P_PER AND
MRP_FNC_PKG.ACC_TAB( CMP_NO , BRN_NO , ACC_CODE , 4) = 'VAR'
ORDER BY CMP_NO, BRN_NO, CC_CODE, ASSEMBLER, ACC_CODE
Q:= 0;
SQ:= SQ+1;
SELECT QTY INTO Q -- Yield_Qty 3/6/2009
WHERE cmp_no = I.CMP_NO AND
brn_no = I.BRN_nO AND
yer_code = I.YER_CODE AND
ASSEMBLER = I.ASSEMBLER AND
CC_CODE = I.CC_CODE AND
YER_CODE = P_YER
; -- ADDED 8/4/2007
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN QTY:= 0;
IF Q > 0 THEN
SELECT P.amt/ Q INTO V_AMT
FROM MRP_PCM_STD_COST_VAR_DLS D ,
MRP_PCM_STD_COST_VAR_PERIOD P
WHERE I.cmp_no = d.cmp_no AND
I.brn_no = d.brn_no AND
I.yer_code = d.yer_code AND
I.assembler = d.assembler AND
I.CC_CODE = D.CC_MAIN AND
d.seq_scvd = p.seq_scvd AND
D.assembler = assemblY AND
D.ACc_CODE = I.ACC_CODE AND
P.PERIOD_CODE = P_PER ;
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN V_AMT := 0;
SELECT DISTINCT ACT_QTY INTO V_QTYF -- Yield_Qty 3/6/2009
period_code = I.period_code AND
CC_CODE = I.CC_CODE ; -- ADDED 8/4/2007
V_QTYF := 0;
IF NVL( V_AMT,0) > 0 THEN
SET AMTL_S = ( V_AMT * V_QTYF ) * V_RATE1, -- ROUND((I.AMT/I.qty)* Q,3) ,
AMT_S = ( V_AMT * V_QTYF ) * V_RATE2 -- ROUND((I.AMT/I.qty)* Q,3)
I.CMP_NO = CMP_NO AND
I.BRN_NO = BRN_NO AND
I.YER_CODE = YER_CODE AND
I.PERIOD_CODE = PERIOD_CODE AND
I.ACC_CODE = ACC_CODE AND
I.CC_CODE = CC_CODE AND
I.ASSEMBLER = ASSEMBLER AND
AMT_S = 0;
Err := 1;

FUNCTION MRP_FUNC_GET_VARIABLE_VALUE( V_CMP NUMBER ,
V_DV_CODE VARCHAR2) RETURN NUMBER IS
V_POS1 NUMBER ;
V_POS2 NUMBER ;
V_IND_CALC NUMBER ;
V_IND_ONCE NUMBER;
V_VAR_VALUE NUMBER ;
V_VAR_SEQ NUMBER ;
---------------------------------------------
V_YER1 NUMBER := V_YER ;
V_PRD1 NUMBER := V_PRD ;
V_PARAM VARCHAR2(1):= '1';
---> GET VARIABLE CALCULATION TYPE
SELECT IND_CALCULAT, IND_ONCE
INTO V_IND_CALC, V_IND_ONCE
WHERE DV_CODE = V_DV_CODE ;
---> GET PREV_PRD WHEN V_IND_CALC FOR PREVIOUS PERIODS
IF V_IND_CALC IN (2,4,6,8,10) THEN
V_ERR_POS := 4 ;
INTO V_YER1 , V_PRD1
WHERE CMP_NO = V_CMP AND BRN_NO = V_BRN AND
YER_CODE = V_YER AND
SEQ =
(SELECT MAX(SEQ)
PERIOD_CODE < V_PRD);
YER_CODE = V_YER-1 AND
DE = V_YER AND
PERIOD_CODE > V_PRD);
-------------------------------------------
---------------- CALCALUTE VARAIBE VALUES --------------------------------
V_ERR_POS := 5 ;
IF NVL(V_IND_ONCE ,0) = 1 THEN -- IF VARIABLE VALUE IS INUPT ONCE ONLY AS ITS DEFINED THEN GET THE LAST RECORD INPUT
SELECT MAX(CV_SQE)
INTO V_VAR_SEQ
AND CC_CODE = V_CC_CODE
AND DECODE(V_BENF_TP , 2 , ITEM_CODE , '1' ) = DECODE(V_BENF_TP , 2 , V_ITEM_CODE , '1' )

V_VAR_VALUE:= 0;
INTO V_VAR_VALUE

AND CMP_NO = V_CMP
AND DV_CODE = V_DV_CODE
AND DECODE(V_BENF_TP , 2 , ITEM_CODE , '1' ) = DECODE(V_BENF_TP , 2 , V_ITEM_CODE , '1' ) ;
ELSE -- VARIABLE INUPT IS NOT ONCE AS ITS DEFINED THEN TAKE THE LAST RECORD INPUT
1 -2
IF V_IND_CALC IN (1,2,3,4,5,6) THEN
SELECT DECODE(V_IND_CALC ,
1,SUM(CV_VALUE),2,SUM(CV_VALUE),
3,AVG(CV_VALUE),4, AVG(CV_VALUE),
5,MAX(CV_VALUE),6, MAX(CV_VALUE),0
AND DECODE(V_BENF_TP , 2 , ITEM_CODE , V_PARAM ) = DECODE(V_BENF_TP , 2 , V_ITEM_CODE , V_PARAM )
AND YER_CODE = V_YER1
AND PERIOD_CODE = V_PRD1 ;
ELSIF V_IND_CALC IN (7,8) THEN
SELECT V.CV_VALUE
WHERE V.CMP_NO = V_CMP AND
V.BRN_NO = V_BRN AND
V.dv_code = V_DV_CODE AND
V.CC_CODE = V_CC_CODE AND
DECODE(V_BENF_TP , 2 , V.ITEM_CODE , V_PARAM ) = DECODE(V_BENF_TP , 2 , V_ITEM_CODE , V_PARAM ) AND
V.YER_CODE = V_YER1 AND
V.PERIOD_CODE = V_PRD1 AND
V.CV_SQE IN
( SELECT MAX(CV_SQE) FROM MRP_PCM_VARIABLES_VALUES
WHERE CMP_NO = V_CMP AND
BRN_NO = V_BRN AND
dv_code = V_DV_CODE AND
CC_CODE = V_CC_CODE AND
DECODE(V_BENF_TP , 2 , ITEM_CODE , V_PARAM ) = DECODE(V_BENF_TP , 2 , V_ITEM_CODE , V_PARAM ) AND
YER_CODE = V_YER1 AND
PERIOD_CODE = V_PRD1
9-10
ELSIF V_IND_CALC IN( 9,10) THEN
( SELECT MIN(CV_SQE) FROM MRP_PCM_VARIABLES_VALUES
RETURN(V_VAR_VALUE);

/* GET THE FORMULA RESULT */
--Creation Date : 29/08/2005
Updated By ABDULLAH omar in 4/11/2006
Last update in 7/2/2011
F_TEXT VARCHAR2) RETURN NUMBER IS
V_VAR_STM VARCHAR2(2000) ;
FORMULA_VALUE NUMBER;
V_DV_CODE VARCHAR2(30) ;
FORMULA_TEXT VARCHAR2(2000) := F_TEXT ;
V_POS1 := INSTR(FORMULA_TEXT , '[') ;
WHILE V_POS1 <> 0 LOOP
V_POS2 := INSTR(FORMULA_TEXT , ']') ;
V_DV_CODE := SUBSTR(FORMULA_TEXT , V_POS1 + 1 , (V_POS2-V_POS1) - 1) ;
(SELE
CT MAX(SEQ)
---> REPLACE THE VARIABLE CODE BY VALUE
V_ERR_POS := 6 ; -- ERROR POS IF HAPPEND
FORMULA_TEXT := REPLACE(FORMULA_TEXT , SUBSTR(FORMULA_TEXT , V_POS1 , (V_POS2-V_POS1)+1) , TO_CHAR(NVL(V_VAR_VALUE,0))) ;
---> JUMP TO NEXT VARIABLE IN THE FORMULA
V_ERR_POS := 7 ;-- ERROR POS IF HAPPEND
---> GET THE FORMULA RESULT VALUE
V_ERR_POS := 8 ;
-- dbms_output.put_line(FORMULA_TEXT);
FORMULA_VALUE := MRP_FUNC_GET_FORMULA_RESULT(FORMULA_TEXT) ;
---> IF THERE'S ANY ERROR RETURN ERROR AND END FUNCTION
RETURN(NVL(FORMULA_VALUE,0) ) ;
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS then

FORMULA_TEXT VARCHAR2(2000) := ' SELECT ' || F_TEXT || ' FROM DUAL ' ;
F_RES_VALUE NUMBER ;
Into F_RES_VALUE ;

CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE REP_PKG AS
FUNCTION PRC_GET_WO_QTY_PRD(P_CMP_NO S_CMPNY.CMP_NO%TYPE,
P_PRD_TYP MRP_SFC_WIP_MASTER_YIELD.PRD_TYPE%TYPE
END REP_PKG;
CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE BODY REP_PKG IS
P_PRD_TYP MRP_SFC_WIP_MASTER_YIELD.PRD_TYPE%TYPE --1 FINAL PRODUCT 0 STG PRD
YQTY NUMBER:=0;
SQTY NUMBER:=0;
/* This function used in MRPREPMPS001_3 REPORT*/
INTO YQTY
CMP_NO = P_CMP_NO
AND PRD_TYPE =P_PRD_TYP
GROUP BY CMP_NO,BRN_NO,SHF_CODE,WORK_ORDER;
YQTY:=0;
SELECT SUM(ITEM_QTY)
GROUP BY CMP_NO,BRN_NO,SHF_CODE,WORK_ORDER ;
SQTY:=0;
RETURN YQTY+SQTY;

PROCEDURE MAIN_PROG(PT IN OUT PRORTY,PRT PRORTY_REC,CMP NUMBER,BRN NUMBER,USR VARCHAR2,WIP VARCHAR2,INV VARCHAR2,FRC VARCHAR2) IS

PROCEDURE TEMP(ITM VARCHAR2,QY NUMBER) IS
BOM := DEFAULT_BOM(ITM);
SET USR_NAME = P_USR||'*'||P_USR
FP(1).CMP := P_CMP_NO;
FP(1).BRN := P_BRN_NO;
FP(1).FIN_ASS := ITM;
FP(1).FIN_BOM := BOM;
FP(1).F_ASS := ITM;
FP(1).F_BOM := BOM;
FP(1).R_QTY := QY;
-- BOM_PKG.LISTING_ITEM_ROW_FROM_MAIN_BOM(FP,3,P_USR,2,NULL);
-- BOM_PKG.CALCULATE_ROW_STANDARD_QTY(3,P_USR,2,NULL);
BOM_PKG_NEW.PRC_CALCULATE_ROW_ITEMS(FP,1,P_USR,1,NULL);
DELETE MRP_MRP_SEIZED_MATERIALS
SET USR_NAME = P_USR
WHERE USR_NAME = P_USR||'*'||P_USR
RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20002,SQLERRM||' TEMP');
FUNCTION CATG(ITM_ROW VARCHAR2) RETURN NUMBER IS
SELECT CTGR
INTO GR
WHERE ITEM_CODE = ITM_ROW
AND (CTGR = 8 OR CTGR = 2);
RETURN (GR);
FUNCTION DIVISIBILITY( Req_QTY NUMBER,IROW VARCHAR2) RETURN NUMBER IS
OLD_R NUMBER;
NEW_R NUMBER := Req_QTY;
SELECT DIVISIBILITY
FROM MRP_CRP_I
TEMS_DETAILS
WHERE ITEM_CODE = IROW;
IF DIV <> 0 THEN
OLD_R := Req_QTY;
NEW_R := ROUND(Req_QTY,0);
ADDTON := NEW_R - OLD_R;
IF ADDTON < 0 THEN
NEW_R := NEW_R + 1;
RETURN(NEW_R);
PROCEDURE CHK_CLAS IS
FOR I IN 1..MA.COUNT LOOP
IF MA(I).TYP = 8 THEN
FOR K IN ( SELECT ITEM_OPTION,OFFSET FROM MRP_CRP_ITEMS_CLASS_OPTIONS
WHERE MRP_ITEM_CODE = MA(I).MRT
GR := CATG(K.ITEM_OPTION);
R_Q := DIVISIBILITY(MA(I).QTY * K.OFFSET,K.ITEM_OPTION);
INSRT_MA(MA,MAR,MA(I).MAIN,K.ITEM_OPTION,
MA(I).MRT , --//CLASS
1 , --//ME
GR ,
R_Q ,
0 , --// WIP
0 , --// Onyx
0 , --// Forcast
0 , --// Addition from Sub Assembly
MA.COUNT+1 );
RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20003,SQLERRM||' CHK_CLAS');
PROCEDURE INSRT_ON_HAND IS
FLG NUMBER;
LEV NUMBER;
QTYN NUMBER;
WIP NUMBER := 0;
IF MA(I).TYP <> 8 THEN
SELECT DISTINCT LVL
INTO LEV
AND ITEM_CODE = MA(I).MAIN;
SELECT NVL(QTY_N,0)
INTO QTYN
AND ITEM_ROW = MA(I).MRT
AND OPTIONAL = 1
AND LVL < LEV;
FLG := QTYN;
FOR J IN 1..MA.COUNT LOOP -- // To calculate how many duplicated
-- the same material
IF MA(I).MRT = MA(J).MRT THEN
IF QTYN IS NULL THEN
FLG := FLG + 1;
FLG := FLG + MA(I).QTY;
QTYN := NULL;
IF CHK_WIP = 0 THEN -- // Check the on hand in WIP
WIP := ON_HAND_WIP(MA(I).MRT,FLG);
IF CHK_INV = 0 THEN -- // Check the on hand in Onyx
INVTRY := ON_HAND_ONYX(MA(I).MRT,FLG);
IF CHK_FRCT = 0 THEN -- // Check the on hand in forcasting
FRCST := ON_HAND_FORCAST(MA(I).MRT,FLG);
IF FLG > 1 THEN
MA(I).WIP := WIP * MA(I).QTY;
MA(I).ONYX := INVTRY * MA(I).QTY;
MA(I).FRCT := FRCST * MA(I).QTY;
MA(I).WIP := WIP;
MA(I).ONYX := INVTRY;
MA(I).FRCT := FRCST;
IF LEVL IS NULL THEN
LEVL := LEV;
ELSIF LEVL < LEV THEN
RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20004,SQLERRM||' INSRT_ON_HAND');
PROCEDURE CHK_ME IS
C NUMBER:=1;
FLG NUMBER:=0;
TEMP1 VARCHAR2(200);
TEMP2 NUMBER;
TEMP3 NUMBER;
INDX NUMBER;
T NUMBER;
R VARCHAR2(200);
IF MA(I).TYP = 8 AND MA(I).ME = 1 THEN
MEA := ME_ARY();
FOR J IN 1..MA.COUNT LOOP
IF MA(J).CLAS = MA(I).MRT THEN
IF MA(J).QTY > 0 THEN
INSRT_ME(MEA,MER,MA(J).MRT,(MA(J).WIP +
MA(J).ONYX +
MA(J).FRCT)/MA(J).QTY,
C );
C := C + 1;
END LOOP; --// END J
FOR V IN 1..MEA.COUNT LOOP
FOR L IN V+1..MEA.COUNT LOOP
IF MEA(V).QTY < MEA(L).QTY THEN
TEMP1 := MEA(V).ME;
TEMP2 := MEA(V).QTY;
TEMP3 := MEA(V).IDX;
MEA(V).ME := MEA(L).ME;
MEA(V).QTY := MEA(L).QTY;
MEA(V).IDX := MEA(L).IDX;
MEA(L).ME := TEMP1;
MEA(L).QTY := TEMP2;
MEA(L).IDX := TEMP3;
FOR V IN 2..MEA.COUNT LOOP
IF MEA(V).IDX > MEA(L).IDX THEN
FOR H IN 2..MEA.COUNT LOOP
MA.DELETE(MEA(H).IDX);
FOR Z IN (MEA(H).IDX)+1..MA.COUNT+1 LOOP
MA(Z-1).MRT := MA(Z).MRT;
MA(Z-1).BOM := MA(Z).BOM;
MA(Z-1).CLAS := MA(Z).CLAS;
MA(Z-1).ME := MA(Z).ME;
MA(Z-1).TYP := MA(Z).TYP;
MA(Z-1).QTY := MA(Z).QTY;
MA(Z-1).WIP := MA(Z).WIP;
MA(Z-1).ONYX := MA(Z).ONYX;
MA(Z-1).FRCT := MA(Z).FRCT;
MA(Z-1).QTYA := MA(Z).QTYA;
MA.DELETE(Z);
FOR A IN 1..MEA.COUNT LOOP
MEA(A).IDX := MEA(A).IDX - 1;
T := MA.COUNT;
IF T = I THEN
END LOOP; --// END I
RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20005,SQLERRM||' CHK_ME');
PROCEDURE CALC_ON_HAND IS
SM NUMBER;
ER VARCHAR2(200);
IF MA(I).QTY > 0 THEN -- This line added in 15-01-2008
MA(I).QTYA := TRUNC(( MA(I).WIP +
MA(I).ONYX +
MA(I).FRCT ) / MA(I).QTY, 0);
ER := '*' ||MA(I).QTYA;
END IF;-- This line added in 15-01-2008
IF MA(I).MRT = MA(J).CLAS THEN
SM := SM +
MA(J).QTYA;
MA(I).QTYA := SM;
RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20006,NULL);
PROCEDURE POSSIBLE_PRODUCTION_QTY IS
FLG NUMBER:= 0;
T_QTY NUMBER:= NULL;
T_MTR VARCHAR2(200);
T_BOM VARCHAR2(200);
T_MAN VARCHAR2(200);
INDX NUMBER := 1;
IF MA(I).CLAS IS NULL THEN
IF T_QTY IS NULL THEN
T_QTY := MA(I).QTYA;
T_MTR := MA(I).MRT;
OM := MA(I).BOM;
T_MAN := MA(I).MAIN;
ELSIF T_QTY > MA(I).QTYA THEN
T_BOM := MA(I).BOM;
IF T_QTY > 0 THEN
RESERVED(T_QTY);
IF T_BOM IS NULL THEN
FOR J IN 1..SMA.COUNT LOOP
IF T_MAN = SMA(J).SUB THEN
ELSIF T_MAN = SMA(J).MAIN THEN
FLG := 2;
IF FLG = 0 AND SMA.COUNT = 0 AND MAIN_ARR = 0 THEN
MAIN_ARR:= 1;
INSRT_MAIN(MNA,MNR,T_MAN,T_QTY,MNA.COUNT+1);
ELSIF FLG = 2 AND MAIN_ARR = 0 THEN
SMA(1).QTY := SMA(1).QTY + T_QTY;
INSRT_MAIN(MNA,MNR,SMA(1).MAIN,SMA(1).QTY,MNA.COUNT+1);
POSSIBLE_QTY_PRODUCER(T_MAN,T_QTY);
IF P_LVL IS NULL THEN
P_LVL := SMA.COUNT+1;
WHILE P_LVL <> 0 LOOP
IF P_LVL > 1 THEN
SUB_PRODUCT(SMA(P_LVL-1).MAIN,NULL,0);
SUB_PRODUCT(SMA(P_LVL).MAIN,NULL,0);
P_LVL := P_LVL - 1;
IF P_LVL = 0 AND MAIN_ARR = 0 THEN
P_LVL := NULL;
ELSE --// IF T_BOM IS NOT NULL
IF SMA(J).MAIN = T_MAN THEN
SMA(J).QTY := SMA(J).QTY + T_QTY;
FLG := 3;
INDX := J;
IF FLG = 0 OR FLG = 3 THEN
INSRT_SUB_MAIN(SMA,SMR,T_MTR,T_MAN,T_QTY,SMA.COUNT+1);
IF T_QTY <> 0 THEN
IF INDX = 1 THEN
INDX := 2;
SUB_PRODUCT(SMA(INDX-1).MAIN,NULL,0);
SUB_PRODUCT(T_MTR,T_BOM,NULL);
RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20007,SQLERRM||' POSSIBLE_PRODUCTION_QTY');
PROCEDURE UNGROUP_ON_HAND_QTY_FOR_SUB_PR IS
Q_Y NUMBER;
FOR I IN 1..LEVL-1 LOOP
FOR K IN(
SELECT ITEM_CODE,QTY,SM_TYPE
MRP_MRP_SEIZED_MATERIALS
WHERE QTY <> 0
AND USR_NAME = P_USR
AND ITEM_CODE IN(
SELECT DISTINCT ITEM_CODE
AND OPTIONAL= 1
AND BOM_CODE IN( SELECT BOM_ROW
AND LVL = 1
)LOOP
TEMP(K.ITEM_CODE,K.QTY);
FOR J IN ( SELECT ITEM_ROW,QTY_N
AND LVL
= 1 )LOOP
INTO Q_Y
WHERE ITEM_CODE = J.ITEM_ROW
AND SM_TYPE = K.SM_TYPE;
UPDT_SIZED_MTR( J.ITEM_ROW, K.SM_TYPE, J.QTY_N + Q_Y);
UPDT_SIZED_MTR( K.ITEM_CODE, K.SM_TYPE, 0);
RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20008,SQLERRM||' UNGROUP_ON_HAND_QTY_FOR_SUB_PR');
PROCEDURE SUB_PRODUCT(IC VARCHAR2,BM VARCHAR2,DFT NUMBER) IS
FOR J IN (SELECT R.ITEM_CODE,R.ITEM_ROW,R.BOM_ROW,
ROUND((
(R.QTY/M.BOM_QTY) +
((R.QTY/M.BOM_QTY)*R.SCRAP_PER/100)*1/(1-(R.SCRAP_PER/100))--//SCRAP
)*R.QTY_F,7
)QTY,R.MUT_EXC
MRP_BOM_BOM_ROW R,
R.BOM_CODE = DECODE(BM,NULL,R.BOM_CODE,BM )AND
M.IND_DEFAULT = DECODE(DFT,NULL,M.IND_DEFAULT,0 )AND
R.OPTIONAL = 1 )LOOP
GR := CATG(J.ITEM_ROW);
R_Q := DIVISIBILITY(J.QTY,J.ITEM_ROW);
INSRT_MA(MA,MAR,J.ITEM_CODE,J.ITEM_ROW,
J.BOM_ROW ,
NULL , --//CLASS
J.MUT_EXC ,
MA.COUNT+1);
RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20009,SQLERRM||' SUB_PRODUCT');
PROCEDURE POSSIBLE_QTY_PRODUCER(T_MAN VARCHAR,T_QTY NUMBER) IS
--// Insert possible quantity producer from the sub product
IF T_MAN <> SMA(1).MAIN THEN
IF CHK_WIP = 0 THEN
INSRT_SIZED_MTR(T_MAN,3,T_QTY);
ELSIF CHK_INV = 0 THEN
INSRT_SIZED_MTR(T_MAN,4,T_QTY);
ELSIF CHK_FRCT = 0 THEN
INSRT_SIZED_MTR(T_MAN,5,T_QTY);
FUNCTION CHK_SIZED_MTR( MTR VARCHAR2, TYP NUMBER)RETURN NUMBER IS
AND ITEM_CODE = MTR
AND SM_TYPE = TYP;
PROCEDURE RESERVED(V_QTY NUMBER)
WIP NUMBER;
INV NUMBER;
FCT NUMBER;
CLAS VARCHAR2(200):= 'TEMPORARY';
T VARCHAR2(200);
T := MA(I).CLAS||'***'||MA(I).MRT;
IF MA(I).CLAS IS NOT NULL AND CLAS <> MA(I).CLAS THEN
CLAS:= MA(I).CLAS;
ELSIF MA(I).CLAS IS NULL THEN
IF MA(I).TYP <> 8 AND FLG = 0 THEN
QTY := (V_QTY*MA(I).QTY);
WIP := MA(I).WIP - QTY;
IF WIP <= 0 THEN
IF CHK_SIZED_MTR(MA(I).MRT,3) = 0 THEN
INSRT_SIZED_MTR(MA(I).MRT,3,WIP);
WIP := CHK_SIZED_MTR(MA(I).MRT,3) - QTY;
UPDT_SIZED_MTR (MA(I).MRT,3,WIP);
IF CHK_INV = 0 THEN
INV := MA(I).ONYX - QTY;
IF INV <= 0 THEN
INV := 0;
IF CHK_SIZED_MTR(MA(I).MRT,4) = 0 THEN
INSRT_SIZED_MTR(MA(I).MRT,4,INV);
INV := CHK_SIZED_MTR(MA(I).MRT,4) - QTY;
UPDT_SIZED_MTR (MA(I).MRT,4,INV);
IF CHK_FRCT = 0 THEN
FCT := MA(I).FRCT - QTY;
IF FCT <= 0 THEN
FCT := 0;
IF CHK_SIZED_MTR(MA(I).MRT,5) = 0 THEN
INSRT_SIZED_MTR(MA(I).MRT,5,FCT);
FCT := CHK_SIZED_MTR(MA(I).MRT,5) - QTY;
UPDT_SIZED_MTR (MA(I).MRT,5,FCT);
RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20010,SQLERRM||' RESERVED');
PROCEDURE INSRT_SIZED_MTR( MTR VARCHAR2, TYP NUMBER, V_QTY NUMBER) IS
V_SQE NUMBER;
SELECT NVL(MAX(SQE)+1,1)
INTO V_SQE
(SQE,ITEM_CODE,QTY,SM_TYPE,SM_REF,USR_NAME,CMP_NO,BRN_NO)
VALUES(V_SQE,MTR,V_QTY,TYP,MTR||TYP,P_USR,P_CMP_NO,P_BRN_NO);
WHERE SM_REF = MTR||TYP
FUNCTION ON_HAND_FORCAST(MRT VARCHAR2,FLG NUMBER) RETURN NUMBER IS
FRCST NUMBER:=0;
FLAGE NUMBER:=0;
SELECT COUNT(MRT) -- Check If Row Qty used by anther BOM
WHERE ITEM_CODE = MRT AND SM_TYPE = 5
AND USR_NAME = P_USR; --// 5 = Reserved in Forcaast
IF FLAGE = 0 THEN
AND nvl(P_ORDER.PO_CLOSED,0)=0
AND P_ORDER_DETAIL.I_CODE='''||MRT||'''GROUP BY P_ORDER_DETAIL.I_CODE';
ELSIF FLAGE = 1 THEN
D.I_CODE ='''||MRT||'''';
FRCST := FRCST + BOM_PKG_NEW.RUN_SELECT( SEL );
FRCST := ROUND(FRCST ,7);
IF FRCST < 0 THEN --// 16/3/2011
FRCST := 0;
END IF; --// 16/3/2011
INTO FRCST
AND USR_NAME = P_USR;
FRCST := FRCST / FLG;
FUNCTION ON_HAND_ONYX( MRT VARCHAR2,FLG NUMBER ) RETURN NUMBER IS
RES_QTY NUMBER;
INVTRY NUMBER:=0;
SEL VARCHAR2(4000):=NULL;
WHERE ITEM_CODE = MRT AND SM_TYPE = 4
AND USR_NAME = P_USR; --// 4 = Reserved in Onyx
SEL := 'SELECT NVL(SUM(AVL_QTY),0) FROM STORAGE
WHERE I_CODE = '''|| MRT ||'''';
INV_SEL := BOM_PKG_NEW.RUN_SELECT( SEL );
INVTRY := ROUND(INVTRY ,7);
IF INVTRY < 0 THEN --// 16/3/2011
INVTRY := 0;
WHERE ITEM_CODE = MRT
INTO INVTRY
INVTRY := INVTRY / FLG;
RETURN(INVTRY);
FUNCTION On_Hand_WIP( MRT VARCHAR2,FLG NUMBER )RETURN NUMBER IS
WHERE ITEM_CODE = MRT AND SM_TYPE = 3
AND USR_NAME = P_USR; --// 3 = Reserved in WIP
SELECT NVL(ROUND(SUM(QTY),7),0)
WHERE ITEM_CODE = MRT;
IF WIP < 0 THEN --// 16/3/2011
AND MRS_TYPE = 0 ;
WIP := WIP - RES_QTY;
AND USR_NAME = P_
USR;
WIP := WIP / FLG;
RETURN(WIP);

FUNCTION FNC_GET_BASE_WEIGHT_UNT RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
V_UNIT_CODE MRP_CRP_UNITS_COST.UNIT_CODE%TYPE := NULL;
SELECT UNIT_CODE INTO V_UNIT_CODE
FROM MRP_CRP_UNITS_COST
WHERE NVL(WEIGHTED,0) = 1 AND NVL(BASE_WEIGHTED,0) = 1 AND
RETURN V_UNIT_CODE;
END FNC_GET_BASE_WEIGHT_UNT;
--#------------------------------------------------------------#--
FUNCTION FNC_WEIGHT_UNT( P_UNIT_CODE IN MRP_CRP_UNITS_COST.UNIT_CODE%TYPE) RETURN NUMBER IS
V_WEIGHTED MRP_CRP_UNITS_COST.WEIGHTED%TYPE:= 0;
SELECT NVL(WEIGHTED,0) INTO V_WEIGHTED
WHERE UNIT_CODE = P_UNIT_CODE AND
NVL(WEIGHTED,0) = 1 AND
RETURN V_WEIGHTED;
END FNC_WEIGHT_UNT;
FUNCTION FNC_FACTOR_WEIGHT_UNT( P_UNIT_CODE IN MRP_CRP_UNITS_COST.UNIT_CODE%TYPE) RETURN NUMBER IS
V_FACTOR_WEIGHT MRP_CRP_UNITS_COST.FACTOR_WEIGHT%TYPE:= 0;
SELECT NVL(FACTOR_WEIGHT,0) INTO V_FACTOR_WEIGHT

END FNC
_FACTOR_WEIGHT_UNT;

V_UNIT_CODE MRP_CRP_ITEMS_DETAILS.UNIT_CODE%TYPE := NULL;
V_ITEM_WEIGHT NUMBER:= 0;
G_MRP_USE_WEIGHT NUMBER := NVL(GNR_PKG.FNC_GET_PRMTR_VAL(P_CMP => P_CMP_NO, P_BRN => P_BRN_NO, P_FLD => 'MRP_USE_WEIGHT'),0);--24-02-2012
IF G_MRP_USE_WEIGHT = 1 THEN
SELECT UNIT_CODE,ITEM_WEIGHT
V_UNIT_CODE, V_ITEM_WEIGHT
NVL(WEIGHTED,0) = 1 AND ROWNUM<=1;
IF V_UNIT_CODE = WEIGHT_PKG.FNC_GET_BASE_WEIGHT_UNT THEN
RETURN P_QTY;
IF NVL(V_ITEM_WEIGHT,0) > 0 THEN
RETURN P_QTY * V_ITEM_WEIGHT;
END FNC_GET_ITEM_QTY_WEIGHT;

IF G_MRP_USE_WEIGHT = 0 THEN
( SELECT CMP_NO, BRN_NO, ITEM_ROW , QTY,
( (QTY*SCRAP_PER) / 100) *1/(1-(SCRAP_PER/100)) QTY_S
ITEM_CODE = P_ITEM_CODE

V_QTY_S_WEIGHT := V_QTY_S_WEIGHT + WEIGHT_PKG.FNC_GET_ITEM_QTY_WEIGHT(P_CMP_NO => I.CMP_NO, P_BRN_NO => I.BRN_NO , P_ITEM_CODE => I.ITEM_ROW, P_QTY=> I.QTY_S);
IF P_WEIGHT_TYPE = 1 THEN
RETURN V_QTY_WEIGHT;
ELSIF P_WEIGHT_TYPE = 2 THEN
RETURN V_QTY_S_WEIGHT;
ELSIF P_WEIGHT_TYPE = 3 THEN
